units.translation: “Scripture even censures them, and sound reasoning does too. The wise should abandon the claims of other systems and make their understanding firm.”

units.label: Verse I.16.67
units.deva: श्रद्धाभक्ती पुरस्कृत्य हित्वा सर्वम् अनार्जवम् । वेदान्तस्यैव तत्त्वार्थे व्यासस्यापि मतौ तथा
units.iast: śraddhābhaktī puraskṛtya hitvā sarvam anārjavam । vedāntasyaiva tattvārthe vyāsasyāpi matau tathā
units.translation: “With faith and devotion foremost, abandoning every form of dishonesty, one should follow the true meaning of Vedānta and the teaching of Vyāsa.”

units.label: Verse I.16.68
units.deva: इति प्रणुन्ना द्वयवादकल्पना निरात्मवादाश् च तथा हि युक्तितः । व्यपेतशङ्काः परवादतः स्थिरा मुमुक्षवो ज्ञानपथे स्युर् इत्य् उत
units.iast: iti praṇunnā dvayavādakalpanā nirātmavādāś ca tathā hi yuktitaḥ । vyapetaśaṅkāḥ paravādataḥ sthirā mumukṣavo jñānapathe syur ity uta
units.translation: “Thus the notions of duality and no-Self are refuted by reason. Free of doubts raised by other views, seekers of liberation should stand firm on the path of knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.16.69
units.deva: स्वसाक्षिकं ज्ञानम् अतीव निर्मलं विकल्पनाभ्यो विपरीतम् अद्वयम् । अवाप्य सम्यग् यदि निश्चितो भवेन् निरन्वयो निर्वृतिम् एति शाश्वतीम्
units.iast: svasākṣikaṃ jñānam atīva nirmalaṃ vikalpanābhyo viparītam advayam । avāpya samyag yadi niścito bhaven niranvayo nirvṛtim eti śāśvatīm
units.translation: “Having gained and firmly understood the self-evident knowledge—supremely pure, nondual and contrary to all imagined distinctions—one attains everlasting peace without remainder.”

units.label: Verse I.16.70
units.deva: इदं रहस्यं परमं परायणं व्यपेतदोषैर् अभिमानवर्जितैः । समीक्ष्य कार्या मतिर् आर्जवे सदा न तत्त्वदृक् स्वान्यमतिर् हि कश्चन
units.iast: idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ parāyaṇaṃ vyapetadoṣair abhimānavarjitaiḥ । samīkṣya kāryā matir ārjave sadā na tattvadṛk svānyamatir hi kaścana
units.translation: “This is the highest secret and final refuge. Those free of faults and pride should examine it; let understanding always be guided by integrity. One who sees the truth has no separate view of his own.”

units.label: Verse I.16.71
units.deva: अनेकजन्मान्तरसंचितैर् नरो विमुच्यते ऽज्ञाननिमित्तपातकैः । इदं विदित्वा परमं हि पावनं न लिप्यते व्योम इवेह कर्मभिः
units.iast: anekajanmāntarasaṃcitair naro vimucyate 'jñānanimittapātakaiḥ । idaṃ viditvā paramaṃ hi pāvanaṃ na lipyate vyoma iveha karmabhiḥ
units.translation: “After many lives, a person is freed from the sins caused by ignorance. Knowing this supreme purifier, one is no more stained by action than space.”

units.label: Verse I.16.72
units.deva: प्रशान्तचित्ताय जितेन्द्रियाय च प्रहीणदोषाय यथोक्तकारिणे । गुणान्वितायानुगताय सर्वदा प्रदेयम् एतत् सततं मुमुक्षवे
units.iast: praśāntacittāya jitendriyāya ca prahīṇadoṣāya yathoktakāriṇe । guṇānvitāyānugatāya sarvadā pradeyam etat satataṃ mumukṣave
units.translation: “This should be given to one whose mind is peaceful, senses mastered, faults relinquished, conduct as taught, and character virtuous—one who is devoted and always seeks liberation.”

units.label: Verse I.16.73
units.deva: परस्य देहे न यथाभिमानिता परस्य तद्वत् परमार्थम् ईक्ष्य च । इदं हि विज्ञानम् अतीव निर्मलं संप्राप्य मुक्तो ऽथ भवेच् च सर्वतः
units.iast: parasya dehe na yathābhimānitā parasya tadvat paramārtham īkṣya ca । idaṃ hi vijñānam atīva nirmalaṃ saṃprāpya mukto 'tha bhavec ca sarvataḥ
units.translation: “Just as one does not identify with another person’s body, so too, seeing reality, one should not identify with one’s own. Gaining this exceptionally pure knowledge, one becomes free in every way.”

units.label: Verse I.16.74
units.deva: न हीह लाभो ऽभ्यधिको ऽस्ति कश्चन स्वरूपलाभात् स इत हि नान्यतः । न देयम् ऐन्द्राद् अपि राज्यतो ऽधिकं स्वरूपलाभं त्व् अपरीक्ष्य यत्नतः
units.iast: na hīha lābho 'bhyadhiko 'sti kaścana svarūpalābhāt sa ita hi nānyataḥ । na deyam aindrād api rājyato 'dhikaṃ svarūpalābhaṃ tv aparīkṣya yatnataḥ
units.translation: “There is no greater gain than attaining one’s own nature, which comes from no other source. Without careful examination, do not give away this knowledge of the Self—even for a kingdom like Indra’s.”

units.label: Verse I.17.1
units.deva: आत्मा ज्ञेयः परो ह्य् आत्मा यस्माद् अन्यन् न विद्यते । सर्वज्ञः सर्वदृक् शुद्धस् तस्मै ज्ञेयात्मने नमः
units.iast: ātmā jñeyaḥ paro hy ātmā yasmād anyan na vidyate । sarvajñaḥ sarvadṛk śuddhas tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ
units.translation: Salutations to the Self that is to be known, the supreme Self beyond which nothing exists, all-knowing, all-seeing and pure.

units.label: Verse I.17.2
units.deva: पदवाक्यप्रमाणज्ञैर् दीपभूतैः प्रकाशितम् । ब्रह्म वेदरहस्यं यैस् तान् नित्यं प्रणतो ऽस्म्य् अहम्
units.iast: padavākyapramāṇajñair dīpabhūtaiḥ prakāśitam । brahma vedarahasyaṃ yais tān nityaṃ praṇato 'smy aham
units.translation: I always bow to those who, like lamps, have illumined the secret of the Veda, Brahman, for those who know words, sentences and the means of knowledge.

units.label: Verse I.17.3
units.deva: यद्वाक्सूर्यांशुसंपातप्रणष्टध्वान्तकल्मषः । प्रणम्य तान् गुरून् वक्ष्ये ब्रह्मविद्याविनिश्चयम्
units.iast: yadvāksūryāṃśusaṃpātapraṇaṣṭadhvāntakalmaṣaḥ । praṇamya tān gurūn vakṣye brahmavidyāviniścayam
units.translation: Having bowed to the teachers whose words, like rays of the sun, destroy the darkness of impurity, I will explain the certain meaning of the knowledge of Brahman.

units.label: Verse I.17.4
units.deva: आत्मलाभात् परो नान्यो लाभः कश्चन विद्यते । यदर्था वेदवादाश् च स्मार्ताश् चापि तु याः क्रियाः
units.iast: ātmalābhāt paro nānyo lābhaḥ kaścana vidyate । yadarthā vedavādāś ca smārtāś cāpi tu yāḥ kriyāḥ
units.translation: “There is no greater gain than attaining the Self; the Vedic teachings and the rites prescribed by tradition are all for that end.”

units.label: Verse I.17.5
units.deva: आत्मार्थो ऽपि हि यो लाभः सुखायेष्टो विपर्ययः । आत्मलाभः परः प्रोक्तो नित्यत्वाद् ब्रह्मवेदिभिः
units.iast: ātmārtho 'pi hi yo lābhaḥ sukhāyeṣṭo viparyayaḥ । ātmalābhaḥ paraḥ prokto nityatvād brahmavedibhiḥ
units.translation: “Even a gain desired for one’s own sake and happiness can prove the opposite; knowers of Brahman declare attainment of the Self supreme because it is eternal.”

units.label: Verse I.17.6
units.deva: स्वयं लब्धस्वभावत्वाल् लाभस् तस्य न चान्यतः । अन्यापेक्षस् तु यो लाभः सो ऽन्यदृष्टिसमुद्भवः
units.iast: svayaṃ labdhasvabhāvatvāl lābhas tasya na cānyataḥ । anyāpekṣas tu yo lābhaḥ so 'nyadṛṣṭisamudbhavaḥ
units.translation: “Its attainment is the Self’s own nature, gained by no other means. A gain that depends on something else arises from seeing something else as real.”

units.label: Verse I.17.7
units.deva: अन्यदृष्टिस् त्व् अविद्या स्यात् तन्नाशो मोक्ष उच्यते । ज्ञानेनैव तु सो ऽपि स्याद् विरोधित्वान् न कर्मणा
units.iast: anyadṛṣṭis tv avidyā syāt tannāśo mokṣa ucyate । jñānenaiva tu so 'pi syād virodhitvān na karmaṇā
units.translation: “Seeing something else is ignorance; its destruction is called liberation. It comes through knowledge alone, since action is not its opposite.”

units.label: Verse I.17.8
units.deva: कर्मकार्यस् त्व् अनित्यः स्याद् अविद्याकामकारणः । प्रमाणं वेद एवात्र ज्ञानस्याधिगमे स्मृतः
units.iast: karmakāryas tv anityaḥ syād avidyākāmakāraṇaḥ । pramāṇaṃ veda evātra jñānasyādhigame smṛtaḥ
units.translation: “What action produces is impermanent and has ignorance and desire as its cause. The Veda is accepted here as the means of knowledge for attaining knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.17.9
units.deva: ज्ञानैकार्थपरत्वात् तं वाक्यम् एकं ततो विदुः । एकत्वं ह्य् आत्मनो ज्ञेयं वाक्यार्थप्रतिपत्तितः
units.iast: jñānaikārthaparatvāt taṃ vākyam ekaṃ tato viduḥ । ekatvaṃ hy ātmano jñeyaṃ vākyārthapratipattitaḥ
units.translation: “Because a single sentence is devoted to knowledge, they understand it as one teaching; through understanding its meaning, the unity of the Self is to be known.”

units.label: Verse I.17.10
units.deva: वाच्यभेदात् तु तद्भेदः कल्प्यो वाच्यो ऽपि तच्छ्रुतेः । त्रयं त्व् एतत् ततः प्रोक्तं रूपं नाम च कर्म च
units.iast: vācyabhedāt tu tadbhedaḥ kalpyo vācyo 'pi tacchruteḥ । trayaṃ tv etat tataḥ proktaṃ rūpaṃ nāma ca karma ca
units.translation: “Since words differ, a difference in their referents is imagined, though scripture speaks of them together. Thus the three are taught: form, name and action.”

units.label: Verse I.17.11
units.deva: असद् एतत् त्रयं तस्माद् अन्योन्येन हि कल्पितम् । कृतो वर्णो यथा शब्दाच् छ्रुतो ऽन्यत्र धिया बहिः
units.iast: asad etat trayaṃ tasmād anyonyena hi kalpitam । kṛto varṇo yathā śabdāc chruto 'nyatra dhiyā bahiḥ
units.translation: “This triad is unreal, each part imagined through the others, like the letters that make a word, heard elsewhere outside the mind.”

units.label: Verse I.17.12
units.deva: दृष्टं चापि यथा रूपं बुद्धेः शब्दाय कल्पते । एवम् एतज् जगत् सर्वं भ्रान्तिबुद्धिविकल्पितम्
units.iast: dṛṣṭaṃ cāpi yathā rūpaṃ buddheḥ śabdāya kalpate । evam etaj jagat sarvaṃ bhrāntibuddhivikalpitam
units.translation: “Just as a visible form is imagined by the intellect in the word for it, the entire world is constructed by a deluded intellect.”

units.label: Verse I.17.13
units.deva: असद् एतत् ततो युक्तं सच्चिन्मात्रं न कल्पितम् । वेदश् चापि स एवाद्यो वेद्यश् चान्यस् तु कल्पितः
units.iast: asad etat tato yuktaṃ saccinmātraṃ na kalpitam । vedaś cāpi sa evādyo vedyaś cānyas tu kalpitaḥ
units.translation: “This triad is therefore unreal; pure Being and consciousness alone are not imagined. That alone is the primal Veda; what is known as other is imagined.”

units.label: Verse I.17.14
units.deva: येन वेत्ति स वेदः स्यात् स्वप्ने सर्वं तु मायया । येन पश्यति तच् चक्षुः शृणोति श्रोत्रम् उच्यते
units.iast: yena vetti sa vedaḥ syāt svapne sarvaṃ tu māyayā । yena paśyati tac cakṣuḥ śṛṇoti śrotram ucyate
units.translation: “That by which one knows is the Veda; in a dream all is māyā. That by which one sees is called the eye, and that by which one hears, the ear.”

units.label: Verse I.17.15
units.deva: येन स्वप्नगतो वक्ति सा वाग् घ्राणं तथैव च । रसनस्पर्शने चैव मनश् चान्यत् तथेन्द्रियम्
units.iast: yena svapnagato vakti sā vāg ghrāṇaṃ tathaiva ca । rasanasparśane caiva manaś cānyat tathendriyam
units.translation: “That by which one speaks in a dream is speech; likewise there are smell, taste, touch, mind and the other faculties.”

units.label: Verse I.17.16
units.deva: कल्प्योपाधिभिर् एवैतद् भिन्नं ज्ञानम् अनेकधा । आधिभेदाद् यथा भेदो मणेर् एकस्य जायते
units.iast: kalpyopādhibhir evaitad bhinnaṃ jñānam anekadhā । ādhibhedād yathā bhedo maṇer ekasya jāyate
units.translation: “This one awareness appears divided in many ways through imagined limiting adjuncts, as one jewel seems many-colored because of the colors around it.”

units.label: Verse I.17.17
units.deva: जाग्रतश् च तथा भेदो ज्ञानस्यास्य विकल्पितः । बुद्धिस्थं व्याकरोत्य् अर्थं भ्रान्त्या तृष्णोद्भवक्रियः
units.iast: jāgrataś ca tathā bhedo jñānasyāsya vikalpitaḥ । buddhisthaṃ vyākaroty arthaṃ bhrāntyā tṛṣṇodbhavakriyaḥ
units.translation: “In waking, too, distinctions in this awareness are imagined; the intellect divides its meaning through delusion, driven by desire and action.”

units.label: Verse I.17.18
units.deva: स्वप्ने यद्वत् प्रबोधे च बहिश् चान्तस् तथैव च । आलेख्याध्ययने यद्वत् तद् अन्योन्यधियोद्भवम्
units.iast: svapne yadvat prabodhe ca bahiś cāntas tathaiva ca । ālekhyādhyayane yadvat tad anyonyadhiyodbhavam
units.translation: “As in dream and waking, and likewise in what is within and without, as in looking at a drawing and studying it, one thought arises from another.”

units.label: Verse I.17.19
units.deva: यदायं कल्पयेद् भेदं तत्कामः सन् यथाक्रतुः । यत्कामस् तत्क्रतुर् भूत्वा कृतं यत् तत् प्रपद्यते
units.iast: yadāyaṃ kalpayed bhedaṃ tatkāmaḥ san yathākratuḥ । yatkāmas tatkratur bhūtvā kṛtaṃ yat tat prapadyate
units.translation: “When a person imagines difference, desire arises; shaped by desire, one forms an intention, and then attains what one has acted to obtain.”

units.label: Verse I.17.20
units.deva: अविद्याप्रभवं सर्वम् असत् तस्माद् इदं जगत् । तद्वता दृश्यते यस्मात् सुषुप्ते न च गृह्यते
units.iast: avidyāprabhavaṃ sarvam asat tasmād idaṃ jagat । tadvatā dṛśyate yasmāt suṣupte na ca gṛhyate
units.translation: “This entire world, born of ignorance, is unreal. It is seen by one possessed by ignorance, but is not grasped in deep sleep.”

units.label: Verse I.17.21
units.deva: विद्याविद्ये श्रुतिप्रोक्ते एकत्वान्यधियौ हि नः । तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन शास्त्रे विद्या विधीयते
units.iast: vidyāvidye śrutiprokte ekatvānyadhiyau hi naḥ । tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śāstre vidyā vidhīyate
units.translation: “Scripture speaks of knowledge and ignorance: for us they are the understanding of oneness and of difference. Therefore, scripture teaches knowledge as the goal of every effort.”

units.label: Verse I.17.22
units.deva: चित्ते ह्य् आदर्शवद् यस्माच् छुद्धे विद्या प्रकाशते । यमैर् नित्यैश् च यज्ञैश् च तपोभिस् तस्य शोधनम्
units.iast: citte hy ādarśavad yasmāc chuddhe vidyā prakāśate । yamair nityaiś ca yajñaiś ca tapobhis tasya śodhanam
units.translation: “Knowledge shines in a pure mind as in a mirror. Restraints, regular rites and austerities are the means to purify it.”

units.label: Verse I.17.23
units.deva: शारीरादितपः कुर्यात् तद्विशुद्ध्यर्थम् उत्तमम् । मनआदिसमाधानं तत्तद्देहविशोषणम्
units.iast: śārīrāditapaḥ kuryāt tadviśuddhyartham uttamam । manaādisamādhānaṃ tattaddehaviśoṣaṇam
units.translation: “One should undertake bodily austerities and the rest for this supreme purification; steadiness of mind and the rest also make the body and its conditions grow lean.”

units.label: Verse I.17.24
units.deva: दृष्टं जागरितं विद्यात् स्मृतं स्वप्नं तद् एव तु । सुषुप्तं तदभवं च स्वम् आत्मानं परं पदम्
units.iast: dṛṣṭaṃ jāgaritaṃ vidyāt smṛtaṃ svapnaṃ tad eva tu । suṣuptaṃ tadabhavaṃ ca svam ātmānaṃ paraṃ padam
units.translation: “Know what is seen as waking and what is remembered as dream; deep sleep is their absence, and one’s own Self is the supreme state.”

units.label: Verse I.17.25
units.deva: सुषुप्ताख्यं तमो ऽज्ञानं बीजं स्वप्नप्रबोधयोः । स्वात्मबोधप्रदग्धं स्याद् बीजं दग्धं यथाभवम्
units.iast: suṣuptākhyaṃ tamo 'jñānaṃ bījaṃ svapnaprabodhayoḥ । svātmabodhapradagdhaṃ syād bījaṃ dagdhaṃ yathābhavam
units.translation: “The darkness called deep sleep, ignorance, is the seed of dream and waking. When knowledge of one’s own Self burns it, the seed is like a scorched seed.”

units.label: Verse I.17.26
units.deva: तद् एवैकं त्रिधा ज्ञेयं मायाबीजं पुनः क्रमात् । मायाव्य् आत्माविकारो ऽपि बहुधैको जलार्कवत्
units.iast: tad evaikaṃ tridhā jñeyaṃ māyābījaṃ punaḥ kramāt । māyāvy ātmāvikāro 'pi bahudhaiko jalārkavat
units.translation: “That one reality is understood in three ways, in sequence, as the seed of māyā. Though the Self, the possessor of māyā, is unchanged, it appears many, like the sun in water.”

units.label: Verse I.17.27
units.deva: बीजं चैकं यथा भिन्नं प्राणस्वप्नादिभिस् तथा । स्वप्नजाग्रच्छरीरेषु तद्वच् चात्मा जलेन्दुवत्
units.iast: bījaṃ caikaṃ yathā bhinnaṃ prāṇasvapnādibhis tathā । svapnajāgraccharīreṣu tadvac cātmā jalenduvat
units.translation: “As one seed appears divided through life-breath, dream and the rest, so the Self appears in dream and waking bodies like the moon reflected in water.”

units.label: Verse I.17.28
units.deva: मायाहस्तिनम् आरुह्य मायाव्य् एको यथा व्रजेत् । आगच्छंस् तद्वद् एवात्मा प्राणस्वप्नादिगो ऽचलः
units.iast: māyāhastinam āruhya māyāvy eko yathā vrajet । āgacchaṃs tadvad evātmā prāṇasvapnādigo 'calaḥ
units.translation: “Just as one magician mounts an illusory elephant and seems to travel, so the unmoving Self appears to go about in the states of breath, dream and the rest.”

units.label: Verse I.17.29
units.deva: न हस्ती न तदारूढो मायाव्य् अन्यो यथा स्थितः । न प्राणादि न तद्द्रष्टा तथा ज्ञो ऽन्यः सदा दृशिः
units.iast: na hastī na tadārūḍho māyāvy anyo yathā sthitaḥ । na prāṇādi na taddraṣṭā tathā jño 'nyaḥ sadā dṛśiḥ
units.translation: “The magician is neither the elephant nor its rider, but stands apart; likewise the knower, ever the Seer, is neither life-breath nor its witness.”

units.label: Verse I.17.30
units.deva: अबद्धचक्षुषो नास्ति माया मायाविनो ऽपि वा । बद्धाक्षस्यैव सा मायामायाव्य् एव ततो भवेत्
units.iast: abaddhacakṣuṣo nāsti māyā māyāvino 'pi vā । baddhākṣasyaiva sā māyāmāyāvy eva tato bhavet
units.translation: “There is no magic for one whose eyes are unbound, nor even for the magician; the magic appears only to one whose sight is bound, and so does the magician.”

units.label: Verse I.17.31
units.deva: साक्षाद् एव स विज्ञेयः साक्षाद् आत्मेति च श्रुतेः । भिद्यते हृदयग्रन्थिर् न चेद् इत्यादितः श्रुतेः
units.iast: sākṣād eva sa vijñeyaḥ sākṣād ātmeti ca śruteḥ । bhidyate hṛdayagranthir na ced ityāditaḥ śruteḥ
units.translation: “The Self should be known directly, for scripture says it is direct: ‘The knot of the heart is cut,’ and the rest.”

units.label: Verse I.17.32
units.deva: अशब्दादित्वतो नास्य ग्रहणं चेन्द्रियैर् भवेत् । सुखादिभ्यस् तथान्यत्वाद् बुद्ध्या वापि कथं भवेत्
units.iast: aśabdāditvato nāsya grahaṇaṃ cendriyair bhavet । sukhādibhyas tathānyatvād buddhyā vāpi kathaṃ bhavet
units.translation: “Since it has no sound and the other qualities, the senses cannot grasp it; since it differs from pleasure and the rest, how could the intellect grasp it?”

units.label: Verse I.17.33
units.deva: अदृश्यो ऽपि यथा राहुश् चन्द्रे बिम्बं यथाम्भसि । सर्वगो ऽपि तथैवात्मा बुद्धाव् एव स गृह्यते
units.iast: adṛśyo 'pi yathā rāhuś candre bimbaṃ yathāmbhasi । sarvago 'pi tathaivātmā buddhāv eva sa gṛhyate
units.translation: “Though unseen, Rāhu is seen in the moon’s disk, and a reflection is seen in water; so too, though all-pervading, the Self is apprehended in the intellect.”

units.label: Verse I.17.34
units.deva: भानोर् बिम्बं यथा चौष्ण्यं जले दृष्टं न चाम्भसः । बुद्धौ बोधो न तद्धर्मस् तथैव स्याद् विधर्मतः
units.iast: bhānor bimbaṃ yathā cauṣṇyaṃ jale dṛṣṭaṃ na cāmbhasaḥ । buddhau bodho na taddharmas tathaiva syād vidharmataḥ
units.translation: “The sun’s image and heat are seen in water, but are not properties of the water; likewise awareness is seen in the intellect, yet is not its property, because their natures differ.”

units.label: Verse I.17.35
units.deva: चक्षुर्युक्ता धियो वृत्तिर् या तां पश्यन्न् अलुप्तदृक् । दृष्टेर् द्रष्टा भवेद् आत्मा श्रुतेः श्रोता तथा श्रुतेः
units.iast: cakṣuryuktā dhiyo vṛttir yā tāṃ paśyann aluptadṛk । dṛṣṭer draṣṭā bhaved ātmā śruteḥ śrotā tathā śruteḥ
units.translation: “The intellect’s activity joined to the eye is seen by the undiminished Seer. The Self is the Seer of seeing and, as scripture says, the hearer of hearing.”

units.label: Verse I.17.36
units.deva: केवलां मनसो वृत्तिं पश्यन् मन्ता मतेर् अजः । विज्ञातालुप्तशक्तित्वात् तथा शास्त्रं न हीत्य् अतः
units.iast: kevalāṃ manaso vṛttiṃ paśyan mantā mater ajaḥ । vijñātāluptaśaktitvāt tathā śāstraṃ na hīty ataḥ
units.translation: “The thinker is unborn, seeing only the intellect’s single activity. The knower’s power is never lost; scripture does not make it an object of thought.”

units.label: Verse I.17.37
units.deva: ध्यायतीत्य् अविकारित्वं तथा लेलायतीत्य् अपि । अत्र स्तेनेति शुद्धत्वं तथानन्वागतं श्रुतेः
units.iast: dhyāyatīty avikāritvaṃ tathā lelāyatīty api । atra steneti śuddhatvaṃ tathānanvāgataṃ śruteḥ
units.translation: “It says ‘as if thinking’ and ‘as if moving’; this does not alter the Self. Scripture also says it is pure, untouched by what does not belong to it.”

units.label: Verse I.17.38
units.deva: शक्त्यलोपात् सुषुप्ते ज्ञस् तथा बोधे ऽविकारतः । ज्ञेयस्यैव विशेषस् तु यत्र वेति श्रुतेर् मतः
units.iast: śaktyalopāt suṣupte jñas tathā bodhe 'vikārataḥ । jñeyasyaiva viśeṣas tu yatra veti śruter mataḥ
units.translation: “Because the knower’s power is not lost in deep sleep, and it is changeless in waking, the difference scripture speaks of belongs only to what is known.”

units.label: Verse I.17.39
units.deva: व्यवधानाद् धि पारोक्ष्यं लोकदृष्टेर् अनात्मनः । दृष्टेर् आत्मस्वरूपत्वात् प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्म तत् स्मृतम्
units.iast: vyavadhānād dhi pārokṣyaṃ lokadṛṣṭer anātmanaḥ । dṛṣṭer ātmasvarūpatvāt pratyakṣaṃ brahma tat smṛtam
units.translation: “Ordinary experience calls the not-Self indirect because it is obscured by intervening things; but since seeing is the Self’s own nature, Brahman is known as immediate.”

units.label: Verse I.17.40
units.deva: न हि दीपान्तरापेक्षा यद्वद् दीपप्रकाशने । बोधस्यात्मस्वरूपत्वान् न बोधो ऽन्यस् तथेष्यते
units.iast: na hi dīpāntarāpekṣā yadvad dīpaprakāśane । bodhasyātmasvarūpatvān na bodho 'nyas tatheṣyate
units.translation: “As a lamp needs no other lamp to reveal its light, awareness, being the Self’s own nature, needs no other awareness.”

units.label: Verse I.17.41
units.deva: विषयत्वं विकारित्वं नानात्वं वा न हीष्यते । न हेयो नाप्य् उपादेय आत्मा नान्येन वा ततः
units.iast: viṣayatvaṃ vikāritvaṃ nānātvaṃ vā na hīṣyate । na heyo nāpy upādeya ātmā nānyena vā tataḥ
units.translation: “The Self is not an object, changing, or many; it is neither to be rejected nor acquired, nor does anything else exist apart from it.”

units.label: Verse I.17.42
units.deva: सबाह्याभ्यन्तरो ऽजीर्णो जन्ममृत्युजरातिगः । अहम् आत्मेति यो वेत्ति कुतो न्व् एव बिभेति सः
units.iast: sabāhyābhyantaro 'jīrṇo janmamṛtyujarātigaḥ । aham ātmeti yo vetti kuto nv eva bibheti saḥ
units.translation: “Whoever knows ‘I am the Self, unborn, beyond the body within and without, free of old age and death like space’—what could such a one fear?”

units.label: Verse I.17.43
units.deva: प्राग् एवैतद्विधेः कर्म वर्णित्वादेर् अपोहनात् । तद् अस्थूलादिशास्त्रेभ्यस् तत् त्वम् एवेति निश्चयात्
units.iast: prāg evaitadvidheḥ karma varṇitvāder apohanāt । tad asthūlādiśāstrebhyas tat tvam eveti niścayāt
units.translation: “Before any injunction to action, one should relinquish caste, stage of life and the rest. From scripture such as ‘not gross,’ one becomes certain: ‘You are that.’”

units.label: Verse I.17.44
units.deva: पूर्वदेहपरित्यागे जात्यादीनां प्रहाणतः । देहस्यैव तु जात्यादिस् तस्याप्य् एवं ह्य् अनात्मता
units.iast: pūrvadehaparityāge jātyādīnāṃ prahāṇataḥ । dehasyaiva tu jātyādis tasyāpy evaṃ hy anātmatā
units.translation: “When one leaves a former body, birth and status are relinquished; these belong to the body alone, which is likewise not-Self.”

units.label: Verse I.17.45
units.deva: ममाहं चेत्य् अतो ऽविद्या शरीरादिष्व् अनात्मसु । आत्मज्ञानेन हेया स्याद् असुराणाम् इति श्रुतेः
units.iast: mamāhaṃ cety ato 'vidyā śarīrādiṣv anātmasu । ātmajñānena heyā syād asurāṇām iti śruteḥ
units.translation: “The ignorance expressed by ‘mine’ and ‘I’ is attached to the body and the rest, which are not-Self; knowledge of the Self removes it, as scripture says of the demonic.”

units.label: Verse I.17.46
units.deva: दशाहाशौचकार्याणां पारिव्राज्ये निवर्तनम् । यथा ज्ञानस्य संप्राप्तौ तद्वज् जात्यादिकर्मणाम्
units.iast: daśāhāśaucakāryāṇāṃ pārivrājye nivartanam । yathā jñānasya saṃprāptau tadvaj jātyādikarmaṇām
units.translation: “Just as rites of impurity after a death cease in the life of renunciation, so too the duties of caste and the rest cease when knowledge is attained.”

units.label: Verse I.17.47
units.deva: यत्कामस् तत्क्रतुर् भूत्वा कृतं त्व् अज्ञः प्रपद्यते । यदा स्वात्मदृशः कामाः प्रमुच्यन्ते ऽमृतस् तदा
units.iast: yatkāmas tatkratur bhūtvā kṛtaṃ tv ajñaḥ prapadyate । yadā svātmadṛśaḥ kāmāḥ pramucyante 'mṛtas tadā
units.translation: “Whatever one desires, that one resolves to become, and what one resolves, one does; when desires lodged in the Self are released, one becomes immortal.”

units.label: Verse I.17.48
units.deva: आत्मरूपविधेः कार्यं क्रियादिभ्यो निवर्तनम् । न साध्यं साधनं वात्मा नित्यतृप्तः श्रुतेर् मतः
units.iast: ātmarūpavidheḥ kāryaṃ kriyādibhyo nivartanam । na sādhyaṃ sādhanaṃ vātmā nityatṛptaḥ śruter mataḥ
units.translation: “The teaching of the Self’s nature brings actions and the rest to an end. The Self is neither an effect nor a means; scripture says it is ever fulfilled.”

units.label: Verse I.17.49
units.deva: उत्पाद्याप्यविकार्याणि संस्कार्यं च क्रियाफलम् । नातो ऽन्यत् कर्मणः कार्यं त्यजेत् तस्मात् ससाधनम्
units.iast: utpādyāpyavikāryāṇi saṃskāryaṃ ca kriyāphalam । nāto 'nyat karmaṇaḥ kāryaṃ tyajet tasmāt sasādhanam
units.translation: “The results of action are things produced, obtained, changed or purified. Action has no other result; therefore one should abandon it together with its means.”

units.label: Verse I.17.50
units.deva: तापान्तत्वाद् अनित्यत्वाद् आत्मार्थत्वाच् च या बहिः । संहृत्यात्मनि तां प्रीतिं सत्यार्थी गुरुम् आश्रयेत्
units.iast: tāpāntatvād anityatvād ātmārthatvāc ca yā bahiḥ । saṃhṛtyātmani tāṃ prītiṃ satyārthī gurum āśrayet
units.translation: “Since pleasure from outside ends in pain, is impermanent and exists for the sake of the Self, one who seeks truth should gather that love into the Self and approach a teacher.”

units.label: Verse I.17.51
units.deva: शान्तं प्राज्ञं तथा मुक्तं निष्क्रियं ब्रह्मणि स्थितम् । श्रुतेर् आचार्यवान् वेद तद् विद्धीति स्मृतेस् तथा
units.iast: śāntaṃ prājñaṃ tathā muktaṃ niṣkriyaṃ brahmaṇi sthitam । śruter ācāryavān veda tad viddhīti smṛtes tathā
units.translation: “One who is peaceful, wise, free of action and established in Brahman knows through scripture and tradition, ‘You are that’; one should have a teacher.”

units.label: Verse I.17.52
units.deva: स गुरुस् तारयेद् युक्तं शिष्यं शिष्यगुणान्वितम् । ब्रह्मविद्याप्लवेनाशु स्वान्तध्वान्तमहोदधिम्
units.iast: sa gurus tārayed yuktaṃ śiṣyaṃ śiṣyaguṇānvitam । brahmavidyāplavenāśu svāntadhvāntamahodadhim
units.translation: “Such a teacher quickly carries the qualified disciple, endowed with the qualities of a disciple, across the great ocean of inner darkness on the boat of knowledge of Brahman.”

units.label: Verse I.17.53
units.deva: दृष्टिः स्पृष्टिः श्रुतिर् घ्रातिर् मतिर् विज्ञातिर् एव च । शक्तयो ऽन्याश् च भिद्यन्ते चिद्रूपत्वे ऽप्य् उपाधिभिः
units.iast: dṛṣṭiḥ spṛṣṭiḥ śrutir ghrātir matir vijñātir eva ca । śaktayo 'nyāś ca bhidyante cidrūpatve 'py upādhibhiḥ
units.translation: “Seeing, touching, hearing, smelling, thinking, knowing and the other powers are distinguished by their limiting adjuncts, though their nature is consciousness.”

units.label: Verse I.17.54
units.deva: अपायोद्भूतिहीनाभिर् नित्यं दीप्यन् रविर् यथा । सर्वगः सर्वदृक् शुद्धः सर्वं जानाति सर्वदा
units.iast: apāyodbhūtihīnābhir nityaṃ dīpyan ravir yathā । sarvagaḥ sarvadṛk śuddhaḥ sarvaṃ jānāti sarvadā
units.translation: “Like the sun, always shining without setting or rising, the Self is all-pervading, all-seeing, pure and always knows everything.”

units.label: Verse I.17.55
units.deva: अन्यदृष्टिः शरीरस्थस् तावन्मात्रो ह्य् अविद्यया । जलेन्द्वाद्युपमाभिस् तु तद्धर्मा च विभाव्यते
units.iast: anyadṛṣṭiḥ śarīrasthas tāvanmātro hy avidyayā । jalendvādyupamābhis tu taddharmā ca vibhāvyate
units.translation: “The outward cognition, residing in the body, is limited to that extent through ignorance; by examples such as the moon reflected in water, its properties are attributed to the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.17.56
units.deva: दृष्ट्वा बाह्यं निमील्याथ स्मृत्वा तत् प्रविहाय च । अथोन्मील्यात्मनो दृष्टिं ब्रह्म प्राप्नोत्य् अनध्वगः
units.iast: dṛṣṭvā bāhyaṃ nimīlyātha smṛtvā tat pravihāya ca । athonmīlyātmano dṛṣṭiṃ brahma prāpnoty anadhvagaḥ
units.translation: “Having seen what is external, then closing the eyes, recalling and relinquishing it, one opens the vision of the Self and reaches Brahman without travelling.”

units.label: Verse I.17.57
units.deva: प्राणाद्य् एवं त्रिकं हित्वा तीर्णो ऽज्ञानमहोदधिम् । स्वात्मस्थो निर्गुणः शुद्धो बुद्धो मुक्तः स्वतो हि सः
units.iast: prāṇādy evaṃ trikaṃ hitvā tīrṇo 'jñānamahodadhim । svātmastho nirguṇaḥ śuddho buddho muktaḥ svato hi saḥ
units.translation: “Setting aside the triad beginning with life-breath, one crosses the ocean of ignorance; established in one’s own Self, one is qualityless, pure, awakened and naturally free.”

units.label: Verse I.17.58
units.deva: अजो ऽहं चामरो ऽमृत्युर् अजरो ऽभय एव च । सर्वज्ञः सर्वदृक् शुद्ध इति बुद्धो न जायते
units.iast: ajo 'haṃ cāmaro 'mṛtyur ajaro 'bhaya eva ca । sarvajñaḥ sarvadṛk śuddha iti buddho na jāyate
units.translation: “I am unborn, deathless, beyond death, ageless and fearless; all-knowing, all-seeing and pure. The awakened one is not born.”

units.label: Verse I.17.59
units.deva: पूर्वोक्तं यत् तमोबीजं तन् नास्तीति विनिश्चयः । तदभावे कुतो जन्म ब्रह्मैकत्वं विजानतः
units.iast: pūrvoktaṃ yat tamobījaṃ tan nāstīti viniścayaḥ । tadabhāve kuto janma brahmaikatvaṃ vijānataḥ
units.translation: “The seed of darkness spoken of before is absent. For one who knows the oneness of Brahman, how could there be birth?”

units.label: Verse I.17.60
units.deva: क्षीरात् सर्पिर् यथोद्धृत्य क्षिप्तं तस्मिन् न पूर्ववत् । बुद्ध्यादेर् ज्ञस् तथासत्यान् न देही पूर्ववद् भवेत्
units.iast: kṣīrāt sarpir yathoddhṛtya kṣiptaṃ tasmin na pūrvavat । buddhyāder jñas tathāsatyān na dehī pūrvavad bhavet
units.translation: “As clarified butter drawn from milk, once removed, does not return to its former state, so the knower does not return to embodiment, because intellect and the rest are unreal.”

units.label: Verse I.17.61
units.deva: सत्यं ज्ञानम् अनन्तं च रसादेः पञ्चकात् परम् । स्याम् अदृश्यादिशास्त्रोक्तम् अहं ब्रह्मेति निर्भयः
units.iast: satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ ca rasādeḥ pañcakāt param । syām adṛśyādiśāstroktam ahaṃ brahmeti nirbhayaḥ
units.translation: “I am Brahman, truth, knowledge and infinity, beyond the five elements beginning with taste, as scripture says ‘unseen’ and the rest; I am fearless.”

units.label: Verse I.17.62
units.deva: यस्माद् भीताः प्रवर्तन्ते वाङ्मनःपावकादयः । तदात्मानन्दतत्त्वज्ञो न बिभेति कुतश्चन
units.iast: yasmād bhītāḥ pravartante vāṅmanaḥpāvakādayaḥ । tadātmānandatattvajño na bibheti kutaścana
units.translation: “From that reality all beings—including speech, mind and fire—act out of fear. One who knows the blissful nature of the Self fears nothing.”

units.label: Verse I.17.63
units.deva: नामादिभ्यः परे भूम्नि स्वाराज्ये चेत् स्थितो ऽद्वये । प्रणमेत् कं तदात्मज्ञो न कार्यं कर्मणा तदा
units.iast: nāmādibhyaḥ pare bhūmni svārājye cet sthito 'dvaye । praṇamet kaṃ tadātmajño na kāryaṃ karmaṇā tadā
units.translation: “If one stands in the nondual sovereignty beyond names and the rest, to whom would the knower of the Self bow? No action is required then.”

units.label: Verse I.17.64
units.deva: विराड् वैश्वानरो बाह्यः स्मरन्न् अन्तः प्रजापतिः । प्रविलीने तु सर्वस्मिन् प्राज्ञो ऽव्याकृतम् उच्यते
units.iast: virāḍ vaiśvānaro bāhyaḥ smarann antaḥ prajāpatiḥ । pravilīne tu sarvasmin prājño 'vyākṛtam ucyate
units.translation: “The cosmic person is the external waking state; within, the Lord of creatures is remembered. When all has dissolved, the unmanifest is called Prājña.”

units.label: Verse I.17.65
units.deva: वाचारम्भणमात्रत्वात् सुषुप्तादित्रिकं त्व् असत् । सत्यो ज्ञश् चाहम् इत्य् एवं सत्यसन्धो विमुच्यते
units.iast: vācārambhaṇamātratvāt suṣuptāditrikaṃ tv asat । satyo jñaś cāham ity evaṃ satyasandho vimucyate
units.translation: “The three states, including deep sleep, are unreal, being only a matter of words. Knowing ‘I am the real Knower,’ one is freed.”

units.label: Verse I.17.66
units.deva: भारूपत्वाद् यथा भानोर् नाहोरात्रे तथैव तु । ज्ञानाज्ञाने न मे स्यातां चिद्रूपत्वाविशेषतः
units.iast: bhārūpatvād yathā bhānor nāhorātre tathaiva tu । jñānājñāne na me syātāṃ cidrūpatvāviśeṣataḥ
units.translation: “As there is no day or night for the radiant sun, so knowledge and ignorance do not exist for me, whose nature is undifferentiated consciousness.”

units.label: Verse I.17.67
units.deva: शास्त्रस्यानतिशङ्क्यत्वाद् ब्रह्मैव स्याम् अहं सदा । ब्रह्मणो मे न हेयं स्याद् ग्राह्यं वेति च संस्मरेत्
units.iast: śāstrasyānatiśaṅkyatvād brahmaiva syām ahaṃ sadā । brahmaṇo me na heyaṃ syād grāhyaṃ veti ca saṃsmaret
units.translation: “Since scripture cannot be doubted, I am always Brahman alone. I should remember that nothing of Brahman is to be given up or taken up.”

units.label: Verse I.17.68
units.deva: अहम् एव च भूतेषु सर्वेष्व् एको नभो यथा । मयि सर्वाणि भूतानि पश्यन्न् एवं न जायते
units.iast: aham eva ca bhūteṣu sarveṣv eko nabho yathā । mayi sarvāṇi bhūtāni paśyann evaṃ na jāyate
units.translation: “I alone am one in all beings, like space. Seeing all beings in me, one is not born again.”

units.label: Verse I.17.69
units.deva: न बाह्यं मध्यतो वान्तर् विद्यते ऽन्यत् स्वतः क्वचित् । अबाह्यान्तःश्रुतेः किंचित् तस्माच् छुद्धः स्वयंप्रभः
units.iast: na bāhyaṃ madhyato vāntar vidyate 'nyat svataḥ kvacit । abāhyāntaḥśruteḥ kiṃcit tasmāc chuddhaḥ svayaṃprabhaḥ
units.translation: “Nothing other than the Self exists outside, within or in between. Scripture says it is neither outside nor inside; therefore it is pure and self-luminous.”

units.label: Verse I.17.70
units.deva: नेतिनेत्यादिशास्त्रेभ्यः प्रपञ्चोपशमो ऽद्वयः । अविज्ञातादिशास्त्राच् च नैव ज्ञेयो ह्य् अतो ऽन्यथा
units.iast: netinetyādiśāstrebhyaḥ prapañcopaśamo 'dvayaḥ । avijñātādiśāstrāc ca naiva jñeyo hy ato 'nyathā
units.translation: “From teachings such as ‘not this, not this,’ the world comes to rest in nonduality; from ‘unknown’ and the rest, it is clear that the Self cannot be known in any other way.”

units.label: Verse I.17.71
units.deva: सर्वस्यात्माहम् एवेति ब्रह्म चेद् विदितं परम् । स आत्मा सर्वभूतानाम् आत्मा ह्य् एषाम् इति श्रुतेः
units.iast: sarvasyātmāham eveti brahma ced viditaṃ param । sa ātmā sarvabhūtānām ātmā hy eṣām iti śruteḥ
units.translation: “If one knows Brahman as ‘I alone am the Self of all,’ the supreme Brahman is known, for scripture says, ‘This is the Self of all beings.’”

units.label: Verse I.17.72
units.deva: जीवश् चेत् परम् आत्मानं स्वात्मानं देवम् अञ्जसा । देवोपास्यः स देवानां पशुत्वाच् च निवर्तते
units.iast: jīvaś cet param ātmānaṃ svātmānaṃ devam añjasā । devopāsyaḥ sa devānāṃ paśutvāc ca nivartate
units.translation: “If the individual knows the supreme Self, the Lord, directly as its own Self, that person ceases to be a worshipping dependent, like an animal among the gods.”

units.label: Verse I.17.73
units.deva: अहम् एव सदात्मज्ञः शून्यस् त्व् अन्यैर् यथाम्बरम् । इत्य् एवं सत्यसंधत्वाद् असद्धाता न बध्यते
units.iast: aham eva sadātmajñaḥ śūnyas tv anyair yathāmbaram । ity evaṃ satyasaṃdhatvād asaddhātā na badhyate
units.translation: “I alone am ever the knower of the Self; others are empty, like space. One who is true to this is not bound by what is false.”

units.label: Verse I.17.74
units.deva: कृपणास् ते ऽन्यथैवातो विदुर् ब्रह्म परं हि ये । स्वराड् यो ऽनन्यदृक् स्वस्थस् तस्य देवा असन् वशे
units.iast: kṛpaṇās te 'nyathaivāto vidur brahma paraṃ hi ye । svarāḍ yo 'nanyadṛk svasthas tasya devā asan vaśe
units.translation: “Those who know supreme Brahman otherwise are pitiable. For the self-ruling one, who sees no other and rests in the Self, the gods are as though unreal and under his control.”

units.label: Verse I.17.75
units.deva: हित्वा जात्यादिसंबन्धं वाचो ऽन्याः सह कर्मभिः । ओम् इत्य् एवं स्वम् आत्मानं सर्वं शुद्धं प्रपद्यथ
units.iast: hitvā jātyādisaṃbandhaṃ vāco 'nyāḥ saha karmabhiḥ । om ity evaṃ svam ātmānaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhaṃ prapadyatha
units.translation: “Giving up association with caste and the rest, and all other words and actions, attain your own Self, all and pure, through the syllable Om.”

units.label: Verse I.17.76
units.deva: सेतुं सर्वव्यवस्थानाम् अहोरात्रादिवर्जितम् । तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् अधः सर्वं सकृज्ज्योतिर् अनामयम्
units.iast: setuṃ sarvavyavasthānām ahorātrādivarjitam । tiryag ūrdhvam adhaḥ sarvaṃ sakṛjjyotir anāmayam
units.translation: “The Self is the bridge that holds together every state, free of day, night and the rest; a single light, without illness, it extends across, above, below and in every direction.”

units.label: Verse I.17.77
units.deva: धर्माधर्मविनिर्मुक्तं भूतभव्यात् कृताकृतात् । स्वम् आत्मानं परं विद्याद् विमुक्तं सर्वबन्धनैः
units.iast: dharmādharmavinirmuktaṃ bhūtabhavyāt kṛtākṛtāt । svam ātmānaṃ paraṃ vidyād vimuktaṃ sarvabandhanaiḥ
units.translation: “Know your own Self as supreme, free from merit and demerit, past and future, what has been done and what has not—free from every bond.”

units.label: Verse I.17.78
units.deva: अकुर्वन् सर्वकृच् छुद्धस् तिष्ठन्न् अत्येति धावतः । मायया सर्वशक्तित्वाद् अजः सन् बहुधा मतः
units.iast: akurvan sarvakṛc chuddhas tiṣṭhann atyeti dhāvataḥ । māyayā sarvaśaktitvād ajaḥ san bahudhā mataḥ
units.translation: “Doing nothing, it is the doer of all; pure, it surpasses what runs and what stands still. Through its power over māyā it is unborn, yet is regarded as many.”

units.label: Verse I.17.79
units.deva: राजवत् साक्षिमात्रत्वात् संनिध्याद् भ्रामको यथा । भ्रामयञ् जगद् आत्माहं निष्क्रियो ऽकारको ऽद्वयः
units.iast: rājavat sākṣimātratvāt saṃnidhyād bhrāmako yathā । bhrāmayañ jagad ātmāhaṃ niṣkriyo 'kārako 'dvayaḥ
units.translation: “Like a king who causes activity merely by being present, I, the Self, make the world turn while remaining only its witness—actionless, without agency and nondual.”

units.label: Verse I.17.80
units.deva: निर्गुणं निष्क्रियं नित्यं निर्द्वन्द्वं यन् निरामयम् । शुद्धं बुद्धं तथा मुक्तं तद् ब्रह्मास्मीति धारयेत्
units.iast: nirguṇaṃ niṣkriyaṃ nityaṃ nirdvandvaṃ yan nirāmayam । śuddhaṃ buddhaṃ tathā muktaṃ tad brahmāsmīti dhārayet
units.translation: “I am that Brahman which is qualityless, actionless, eternal, free from every pair of opposites, free from illness, pure, awakened and liberated.”

units.label: Verse I.17.81
units.deva: बन्धं मोक्षं च सर्वं यत इदम् उभयं हेयम् एकं द्वयं च । ज्ञेयाज्ञेयाभ्यतीतं परमम् अधिगतं तत्त्वम् एकं विशुद्धम् । विज्ञायैतद् यथावच् छ्रुतिमुनिगदितं शोकमोहाव् अतीतः । सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत् स्याद् भवभयरहितो ब्राह्मणो ऽवाप्तकृत्यः
units.iast: bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sarvaṃ yata idam ubhayaṃ heyam ekaṃ dvayaṃ ca । jñeyājñeyābhyatītaṃ paramam adhigataṃ tattvam ekaṃ viśuddham । vijñāyaitad yathāvac chrutimunigaditaṃ śokamohāv atītaḥ । sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt syād bhavabhayarahito brāhmaṇo 'vāptakṛtyaḥ
units.translation: “Everything called bondage and liberation is to be set aside. The one supreme, pure reality is beyond both the knowable and unknowable. Knowing it as taught by scripture and sages, one goes beyond grief and delusion, becomes all-knowing and free from fear, and fulfills one’s purpose.”

units.label: Verse I.17.82
units.deva: न स्वयं स्वस्य नान्यश् च नान्यस्यात्मा च हेयगः । उपादेयो न चाप्य् एवम् इति सम्यङ्मतिः स्मृता
units.iast: na svayaṃ svasya nānyaś ca nānyasyātmā ca heyagaḥ । upādeyo na cāpy evam iti samyaṅmatiḥ smṛtā
units.translation: “The Self is not rejected by itself, nor is one Self other than another’s; no Self is to be relinquished or taken up. This is rightly understood.”

units.label: Verse I.17.83
units.deva: आत्मप्रत्यायिका ह्य् एषा सर्ववेदान्तगोचरा । ज्ञात्वैतां हि विमुच्यन्ते सर्वसंसारबन्धनैः
units.iast: ātmapratyāyikā hy eṣā sarvavedāntagocarā । jñātvaitāṃ hi vimucyante sarvasaṃsārabandhanaiḥ
units.translation: “This is the teaching of the Self, the subject of all Vedānta. Knowing it, people are freed from every bond of worldly existence.”

units.label: Verse I.17.84
units.deva: रहस्यं सर्ववेदानां देवानां चापि यत् परम् । पवित्रं परमं ह्य् एतत् तद् एतत् संप्रकाशितम्
units.iast: rahasyaṃ sarvavedānāṃ devānāṃ cāpi yat param । pavitraṃ paramaṃ hy etat tad etat saṃprakāśitam
units.translation: “This supreme and sacred truth is the secret of all the Vedas and of the gods; now it has been fully revealed.”

units.label: Verse I.17.85
units.deva: नैतद् देयम् अशान्ताय रहस्यं ज्ञानम् उत्तमम् । विरक्ताय प्रदातव्यं शिष्यायानुगताय च
units.iast: naitad deyam aśāntāya rahasyaṃ jñānam uttamam । viraktāya pradātavyaṃ śiṣyāyānugatāya ca
units.translation: “This highest secret knowledge must not be given to one who is not peaceful; it should be given to a devoted disciple who is dispassionate.”

units.label: Verse I.17.86
units.deva: ददतश् चात्मनो ज्ञानं निष्क्रियो ऽन्यो न विद्यते । ज्ञानम् इच्छन् भवेत् तस्माद् युक्तः शिष्यगुणैः सदा
units.iast: dadataś cātmano jñānaṃ niṣkriyo 'nyo na vidyate । jñānam icchan bhavet tasmād yuktaḥ śiṣyaguṇaiḥ sadā
units.translation: “There is no other, inactive Self apart from the one who gives knowledge of the Self; therefore one who desires knowledge should always be equipped with the qualities of a disciple.”

units.label: Verse I.17.87
units.deva: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं तथा ज्ञाता यस्माद् अन्यन् न विद्यते । सर्वज्ञः सर्वशक्तिर् यस् तस्मै ज्ञानात्मने नमः
units.iast: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ tathā jñātā yasmād anyan na vidyate । sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktir yas tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ
units.translation: “Since knowledge, what is known and the knower are not other than this, salutations to that Self whose nature is knowledge, all-knowing and all-powerful.”

units.label: Verse I.17.88
units.deva: विद्यया तारिताः स्मो यैर् जन्ममृत्युमहोदधिम् । सर्वज्ञेभ्यो नमस् तेभ्यो गुरुभ्यो ऽज्ञानसंकुलम्
units.iast: vidyayā tāritāḥ smo yair janmamṛtyumahodadhim । sarvajñebhyo namas tebhyo gurubhyo 'jñānasaṃkulam
units.translation: “Salutations to those all-knowing teachers who ferried us across the great ocean of birth and death, crowded with ignorance, through knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.18.1
units.deva: येनात्मना विलीयन्त उद्भवन्ति च वृत्तयः । नित्यावगतये तस्मै नमो धीप्रत्ययात्मने
units.iast: yenātmanā vilīyanta udbhavanti ca vṛttayaḥ । nityāvagataye tasmai namo dhīpratyayātmane
units.translation: Salutations to that eternal awareness, the nature of every cognition, in which thoughts arise and dissolve.

units.label: Verse I.18.2
units.deva: प्रमथ्य वज्रोपमयुक्तिसंभृतैः श्रुतेर् अरातिञ् शतशो वचो ऽसिभिः । ररक्ष वेदार्थनिधिं विशालधीर् नमो यतीन्द्राय गुरोर् गरीयसे
units.iast: pramathya vajropamayuktisaṃbhṛtaiḥ śruter arātiñ śataśo vaco 'sibhiḥ । rarakṣa vedārthanidhiṃ viśāladhīr namo yatīndrāya guror garīyase
units.translation: “With words like swords, drawn from reasoning as strong as a thunderbolt, he struck down the enemies of scripture. I bow to that great-minded king of renunciants, the teacher above all, who protected the vast treasure of the Veda’s meaning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.3
units.deva: नित्यमुक्तः सद् एवास्मीत्य् एवं चेन् न भवेन् मतिः । किमर्थं श्रावयत्य् एवं मातृवच् छ्रुतिर् आदृता
units.iast: nityamuktaḥ sad evāsmīty evaṃ cen na bhaven matiḥ । kimarthaṃ śrāvayaty evaṃ mātṛvac chrutir ādṛtā
units.translation: “If one did not have the conviction ‘I am Being, eternally free,’ why would scripture lovingly teach it like a mother?”

units.label: Verse I.18.4
units.deva: सिद्धाद् एवाहम् इत्य् अस्माद् युष्मद्धर्मो निषिध्यते । रज्ज्वाम् इवाहिधीर् युक्त्या तत् त्वम् इत्यादिशासनैः
units.iast: siddhād evāham ity asmād yuṣmaddharmo niṣidhyate । rajjvām ivāhidhīr yuktyā tat tvam ityādiśāsanaiḥ
units.translation: “From the established knowledge ‘I am,’ the properties of ‘you’ are negated through teachings such as ‘you are that,’ just as the mistaken snake is negated from the rope by reasoning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.5
units.deva: शास्त्रप्रामाण्यतो ज्ञेया धर्मादेर् अस्तिता यथा । विषापोहो यथा ध्यानाद् ध्नुतिः स्यात् पाप्मनस् तथा
units.iast: śāstraprāmāṇyato jñeyā dharmāder astitā yathā । viṣāpoho yathā dhyānād dhnutiḥ syāt pāpmanas tathā
units.translation: “As the existence of duty and the rest is known from scripture, so too one’s sin is removed through meditation, as poison is neutralized.”

units.label: Verse I.18.6
units.deva: सद् ब्रह्माहं करोमीति प्रत्ययाव् आत्मसाक्षिकौ । तयोर् अज्ञानजस्यैव त्यागो युक्ततरो मतः
units.iast: sad brahmāhaṃ karomīti pratyayāv ātmasākṣikau । tayor ajñānajasyaiva tyāgo yuktataro mataḥ
units.translation: “The thoughts ‘I am Being, Brahman’ and ‘I act’ are both witnessed by the Self; it is more reasonable to relinquish only the latter, which arises from ignorance.”

units.label: Verse I.18.7
units.deva: सद् अस्मीति प्रमाणोत्था धीर् अन्या तन्निभोद्भवा । प्रत्यक्षादिनिभा वापि बाध्यते दिग्भ्रमादिवत्
units.iast: sad asmīti pramāṇotthā dhīr anyā tannibhodbhavā । pratyakṣādinibhā vāpi bādhyate digbhramādivat
units.translation: “The cognition ‘I am Being’ arises from a means of knowledge; another cognition, though similar, or one born of perception, is sublated like mistaking direction.”

units.label: Verse I.18.8
units.deva: कर्ता भोक्तेति यच् छास्त्रं लोकबुद्ध्यनुवादि तत् । सद् अस्मीति श्रुतेर् जाता बाध्यते ऽन्यैतयैव धीः
units.iast: kartā bhokteti yac chāstraṃ lokabuddhyanuvādi tat । sad asmīti śruter jātā bādhyate 'nyaitayaiva dhīḥ
units.translation: “Scriptural statements about the doer and enjoyer merely restate the world’s common view. The cognition ‘I am Being,’ born from scripture, sublates those and the other views.”

units.label: Verse I.18.9
units.deva: सद् एव त्वम् असीत्य् उक्ते नात्मनो मुक्ततां स्थिराम् । प्रपद्यते प्रसंचक्षाम् अतो युक्त्यानुचिन्तयेत्
units.iast: sad eva tvam asīty ukte nātmano muktatāṃ sthirām । prapadyate prasaṃcakṣām ato yuktyānucintayet
units.translation: “Even when told ‘You are Being,’ one may not gain firm knowledge of the Self’s freedom merely by hearing; one should therefore reflect with reasoning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.10
units.deva: सकृद् उक्तं न गृह्णाति वाक्यार्थज्ञो ऽपि यो भवेत् । अपेक्षते ऽत एवान्यद् अवोचाम द्वयं हि तत्
units.iast: sakṛd uktaṃ na gṛhṇāti vākyārthajño 'pi yo bhavet । apekṣate 'ta evānyad avocāma dvayaṃ hi tat
units.translation: “Even a person who understands the sentence meaning may not grasp it when it is stated only once; for that reason I have explained the two sides and the need for further teaching.”

units.label: Verse I.18.11
units.deva: नियोगो ऽप्रतिपन्नत्वात् कर्मणां स यथा भवेत् । अविरुद्धो भवेत् तावद् यावत् संवेद्यतादृढा
units.iast: niyogo 'pratipannatvāt karmaṇāṃ sa yathā bhavet । aviruddho bhavet tāvad yāvat saṃvedyatādṛḍhā
units.translation: “An injunction may be valid for actions so long as the truth has not been firmly understood; until then, one’s knowledge remains incomplete.”

units.label: Verse I.18.12
units.deva: चेष्टितं च तथा मिथ्या स्वच्छन्दः प्रतिपद्यते । प्रसंख्यानम् अतः कार्यं यावद् आत्मानुभूयते
units.iast: ceṣṭitaṃ ca tathā mithyā svacchandaḥ pratipadyate । prasaṃkhyānam ataḥ kāryaṃ yāvad ātmānubhūyate
units.translation: “Conduct and the rest are likewise mistaken; one may freely take up repeated contemplation until the Self is directly experienced.”

units.label: Verse I.18.13
units.deva: सद् अस्मीति च विज्ञानम् अक्षजो बाधते ध्रुवम् । शब्दोत्थं दृढसंस्कारो दोषैश् चाक्र्ष्यते बहिः
units.iast: sad asmīti ca vijñānam akṣajo bādhate dhruvam । śabdotthaṃ dṛḍhasaṃskāro doṣaiś cākrṣyate bahiḥ
units.translation: “The senses will surely oppose the cognition ‘I am Being’; strong impressions arising from sound cognition pull the mind outward.”

units.label: Verse I.18.14
units.deva: श्रुतानुमानजन्मानौ सामान्यविषयौ यतः । प्रत्ययाव् अक्षजो ऽवश्यं विशेषार्थो निवारयेत्
units.iast: śrutānumānajanmānau sāmānyaviṣayau yataḥ । pratyayāv akṣajo 'vaśyaṃ viśeṣārtho nivārayet
units.translation: “Knowledge born of scripture and inference has a general subject; therefore perception, which concerns a particular, can sublate it.”

units.label: Verse I.18.15
units.deva: वाक्यार्थप्रत्ययि कश्चिन् निर्दुःखो नोपलभ्यते । यदि वा दृश्यते कश्चिद् वाक्यार्थश्रुतिमात्रतः
units.iast: vākyārthapratyayi kaścin nirduḥkho nopalabhyate । yadi vā dṛśyate kaścid vākyārthaśrutimātrataḥ
units.translation: “No person who understands the sentence meaning is seen to be free from sorrow. Or, if someone is seen to be free immediately from merely hearing the sentence—”

units.label: Verse I.18.16
units.deva: निर्दुःखो ऽतीतदेहेषु कृतभावो ऽनुमीयते । चर्या नो ऽशास्त्रसंवेद्या स्याद् अनिष्टं तथा सति
units.iast: nirduḥkho 'tītadeheṣu kṛtabhāvo 'numīyate । caryā no 'śāstrasaṃvedyā syād aniṣṭaṃ tathā sati
units.translation: “—one should infer that person’s cultivation in former lives; otherwise that person’s conduct would be beyond scripture, an undesirable result.”

units.label: Verse I.18.17
units.deva: सद् असीति फलं चोक्त्वा विधेयं साधनं यतः । न तद् अन्यत् प्रसंख्यानात् प्रसिद्धार्थम् इहेष्यते
units.iast: sad asīti phalaṃ coktvā vidheyaṃ sādhanaṃ yataḥ । na tad anyat prasaṃkhyānāt prasiddhārtham iheṣyate
units.translation: “Since the sentence states its result, ‘You are Being,’ what further means is to be enjoined? Nothing beyond repeated contemplation of the meaning already made known is proposed here.”

units.label: Verse I.18.18
units.deva: तस्माद् अनुभवायैव प्रसंचक्षीत यत्नतः । त्यजन् साधनतत्साध्यविरुद्धं शमनादिमान्
units.iast: tasmād anubhavāyaiva prasaṃcakṣīta yatnataḥ । tyajan sādhanatatsādhyaviruddhaṃ śamanādimān
units.translation: “Therefore, for direct experience one should strive and reflect, practising calm and the rest, and giving up whatever means or results conflict with it.”

units.label: Verse I.18.19
units.deva: नैतद् एवं रहस्यानां नेतिनेत्यवसानतः । क्रियासाध्यं पुरा श्राव्यं न मोक्षो नित्यसिद्धतः
units.iast: naitad evaṃ rahasyānāṃ netinetyavasānataḥ । kriyāsādhyaṃ purā śrāvyaṃ na mokṣo nityasiddhataḥ
units.translation: “This is not so: the secret teachings end with ‘not this, not this.’ Action is taught beforehand, but liberation is eternally accomplished.”

units.label: Verse I.18.20
units.deva: पुत्रदुःखं यथाध्यस्तं पित्रादुःखे स्व आत्मनि । अहंकर्त्रा तथाध्यस्तं नित्यादुःखे स्व आत्मनि
units.iast: putraduḥkhaṃ yathādhyastaṃ pitrāduḥkhe sva ātmani । ahaṃkartrā tathādhyastaṃ nityāduḥkhe sva ātmani
units.translation: “As a father’s grief is imagined from grief for his son, so the ego’s agency is superimposed on the Self, which is eternally free of sorrow.”

units.label: Verse I.18.21
units.deva: सो ऽध्यासो नेति नेतीति प्राप्तवत् प्रतिषिध्यते । भूयो ऽध्यासविधिः कश्चित् कुतश्चिन् नोपपद्यते
units.iast: so 'dhyāso neti netīti prāptavat pratiṣidhyate । bhūyo 'dhyāsavidhiḥ kaścit kutaścin nopapadyate
units.translation: “That superimposition is negated by the teaching ‘not this, not this’; no further injunction to superimpose anything can be justified.”

units.label: Verse I.18.22
units.deva: आत्मनीह यथाध्यासः प्रतिषेधस् तथैव च । मलाध्यासनिषेधौ खे क्रियेते च यथाबुधैः
units.iast: ātmanīha yathādhyāsaḥ pratiṣedhas tathaiva ca । malādhyāsaniṣedhau khe kriyete ca yathābudhaiḥ
units.translation: “Just as the superimposition on the Self is negated, so too is its denial carried out here, as the ignorant imagine and remove a stain from space.”

units.label: Verse I.18.23
units.deva: प्राप्तश् चेत् प्रतिषिध्येत मोक्षो ऽनित्यो भवेद् ध्रुवम् । अतो ऽप्राप्तनिषेधो ऽयं दिव्य् अग्निचयनादिवत्
units.iast: prāptaś cet pratiṣidhyeta mokṣo 'nityo bhaved dhruvam । ato 'prāptaniṣedho 'yaṃ divy agnicayanādivat
units.translation: “If something already attained were negated, liberation would surely be impermanent. This is therefore a denial of what was never attained, like the prescribed arrangement of a sacred fire.”

units.label: Verse I.18.24
units.deva: संभाव्यो गोचरे शब्दः प्रत्ययो वा न चान्यथा । न संभाव्यौ तदात्मत्वाद् अहंकर्तुस् तथैव च
units.iast: saṃbhāvyo gocare śabdaḥ pratyayo vā na cānyathā । na saṃbhāvyau tadātmatvād ahaṃkartus tathaiva ca
units.translation: “A word or cognition can concern only what lies within its scope, and not otherwise; since the Self is the very nature of the agent, it cannot be made an object.”

units.label: Verse I.18.25
units.deva: अहंकर्त्रात्मनि न्यस्तं चैतन्ये कर्तृतादि यत् । नेति नेतीति तत् सर्वं साहंकर्त्रा निषिध्यते
units.iast: ahaṃkartrātmani nyastaṃ caitanye kartṛtādi yat । neti netīti tat sarvaṃ sāhaṃkartrā niṣidhyate
units.translation: “Agency and the rest, which have been placed on the Self and consciousness, are all negated together with the agent through ‘not this, not this.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.26
units.deva: उपलब्धिः स्वयंज्योतिर् दृशिः प्रत्यक्सदक्रियः । साक्षात् सर्वान्तरः साक्षी चेता नित्यो ऽगुणो ऽद्वयः
units.iast: upalabdhiḥ svayaṃjyotir dṛśiḥ pratyaksadakriyaḥ । sākṣāt sarvāntaraḥ sākṣī cetā nityo 'guṇo 'dvayaḥ
units.translation: “Realization is self-luminous awareness: the inward Seer, Being itself, actionless, the witness, conscious, eternal, without qualities and nondual.”

units.label: Verse I.18.27
units.deva: संनिधौ सर्वदा तस्य स्यात् तदाभो ऽभिमानकृत् । आत्मात्मीयं द्वयं चातः स्याद् अहंममगोचरः
units.iast: saṃnidhau sarvadā tasya syāt tadābho 'bhimānakṛt । ātmātmīyaṃ dvayaṃ cātaḥ syād ahaṃmamagocaraḥ
units.translation: “In its constant presence, the ego creates an appearance like itself; thus the duality ‘I’ and ‘mine’ falls within the ego’s domain.”

units.label: Verse I.18.28
units.deva: जातिकर्मादिमत्त्वाद् धि तस्मिञ् शब्दास् त्व् अहंकृति । न कश्चिद् वर्तते शब्दस् तदभावात् स्व आत्मनि
units.iast: jātikarmādimattvād dhi tasmiñ śabdās tv ahaṃkṛti । na kaścid vartate śabdas tadabhāvāt sva ātmani
units.translation: “Because they apply to caste, action and the rest, words refer to the ego; no word refers to the Self, since none of those conditions belongs to it.”

units.label: Verse I.18.29
units.deva: आभासो यत्र तत्रैव शब्दाः प्रत्यग्दृशिं स्थिताः । लक्षयेयुर् न साक्षात् तम् अभिदध्युः कथंचन
units.iast: ābhāso yatra tatraiva śabdāḥ pratyagdṛśiṃ sthitāḥ । lakṣayeyur na sākṣāt tam abhidadhyuḥ kathaṃcana
units.translation: “Where a reflection appears, words established for that reflection can only point toward the inward Seer; they could never denote the Seer directly.”

units.label: Verse I.18.30
units.deva: नह्य् अजात्यादिमान् कश्चिद् अर्थः शब्दैर् निरूप्यते । आत्माभासो यतो ऽहंकृद् आत्मशब्दैस् तथोच्यते
units.iast: nahy ajātyādimān kaścid arthaḥ śabdair nirūpyate । ātmābhāso yato 'haṃkṛd ātmaśabdais tathocyate
units.translation: “No object lacking birth, caste and the rest is denoted by words. Since the ego is a reflection of the Self, words speak of it as the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.31
units.deva: उल्मुकादौ यथाग्न्यर्थाः परार्थत्वान् न चाञ्जसा । मुखाद् अन्यो मुखाभासो यथादर्शानुकारतः
units.iast: ulmukādau yathāgnyarthāḥ parārthatvān na cāñjasā । mukhād anyo mukhābhāso yathādarśānukārataḥ
units.translation: “Words for fire may be used of a firebrand for another purpose; the face, however, is distinct from its reflection, which appears by imitation in a mirror.”

units.label: Verse I.18.32
units.deva: आभासान् मुखम् अप्य् एवम् आदर्शाननुवर्तनात् । अहंकृत्य् आत्मनिर्भासो मुखाभासवद् इष्यते
units.iast: ābhāsān mukham apy evam ādarśānanuvartanāt । ahaṃkṛty ātmanirbhāso mukhābhāsavad iṣyate
units.translation: “The face is present, and the image appears in the mirror by following it; so the reflection of the Self in the ego is understood like the reflection of a face.”

units.label: Verse I.18.33
units.deva: मुखवत् स्थित आत्मान्यो ऽविविक्तौ तौ तथैव च । संसारी च स इत्य् एक आभासो यस् त्व् अहंकृति
units.iast: mukhavat sthita ātmānyo 'viviktau tau tathaiva ca । saṃsārī ca sa ity eka ābhāso yas tv ahaṃkṛti
units.translation: “The Self stands as the face, and the ego as its image; because the two are not discriminated, that single appearance is called a person in bondage.”

units.label: Verse I.18.34
units.deva: वस्तु च्छाया स्मृतेर् अन्यन् माधुर्यादि च कारणम् । ज्ञैकदेशो विकारो वा तदाभासाश्रयः परे
units.iast: vastu cchāyā smṛter anyan mādhuryādi ca kāraṇam । jñaikadeśo vikāro vā tadābhāsāśrayaḥ pare
units.translation: “The object, its shadow, memory and a cause such as sweetness—or a portion or modification of the knower—are offered as the basis of that reflection by other thinkers.”

units.label: Verse I.18.35
units.deva: अहंकर्तैव संसारी स्वतन्त्र इति केचन । अहंकारादिसंतानः संसारी नान्वयि पृथक्
units.iast: ahaṃkartaiva saṃsārī svatantra iti kecana । ahaṃkārādisaṃtānaḥ saṃsārī nānvayi pṛthak
units.translation: “Some say the ego alone is the independent person in bondage; for them the stream of ego-moments has no enduring continuity.”

units.label: Verse I.18.36
units.deva: इत्य् एवं सौगता आहुस् तत्र न्यायो विचार्यताम् । संसारिणां कथा त्व् आस्तां प्रकृतं त्व् अधुनोच्यते
units.iast: ity evaṃ saugatā āhus tatra nyāyo vicāryatām । saṃsāriṇāṃ kathā tv āstāṃ prakṛtaṃ tv adhunocyate
units.translation: “Thus the Buddhists speak. Let their reasoning be examined; we will leave aside their account of the person in bondage and return to the present subject.”

units.label: Verse I.18.37
units.deva: मुखाभासो य आदर्शे धर्मो नान्यतरस्य सः । द्वयोर् एकस्य चेद् धर्मो वियुक्ते ऽन्यतरे भवेत्
units.iast: mukhābhāso ya ādarśe dharmo nānyatarasya saḥ । dvayor ekasya ced dharmo viyukte 'nyatare bhavet
units.translation: “The reflection of a face in a mirror is not a property of either one alone; if it belonged to one, it would remain even when separated from the other.”

units.label: Verse I.18.38
units.deva: मुखेन व्यपदेशात् स मुखस्यैवेति चेन् मतम् । नादर्शानुविधानाच् च मुखे सत्य् अविभावतः
units.iast: mukhena vyapadeśāt sa mukhasyaiveti cen matam । nādarśānuvidhānāc ca mukhe saty avibhāvataḥ
units.translation: “If it is called the face’s reflection because it is described in relation to the face, that is not so: it follows the mirror, and vanishes when the face is absent.”

units.label: Verse I.18.39
units.deva: द्वयोर् एवेति चेत् तन् न द्वयोर् एवाप्य् अदर्शनात् । अदृष्टस्य सतो दृष्टिः स्याद् राहोश् चन्द्रसूर्ययोः
units.iast: dvayor eveti cet tan na dvayor evāpy adarśanāt । adṛṣṭasya sato dṛṣṭiḥ syād rāhoś candrasūryayoḥ
units.translation: “If you say it belongs to both, that too is wrong, since neither of them is itself the reflection; the unseen can be seen, as in the case of Rāhu and the sun or moon.”

units.label: Verse I.18.40
units.deva: राहोः प्राग् एव वस्तुत्वं सिद्धं शास्त्रप्रमाणतः । छायापक्षे त्व् अवस्तुत्वं तस्य स्यात् पूर्वयुक्तितः
units.iast: rāhoḥ prāg eva vastutvaṃ siddhaṃ śāstrapramāṇataḥ । chāyāpakṣe tv avastutvaṃ tasya syāt pūrvayuktitaḥ
units.translation: “Rāhu’s existence is established by scripture even before it is seen; if it were only a shadow, then by the reasoning already given it would be unreal.”

units.label: Verse I.18.41
units.deva: छायाक्रान्तेर् निषेधो ऽयं न तु वस्तुत्वसाधकः । न ह्य् अर्थान्तरनिष्ठं सद् वाक्यम् अर्थान्तरं वदेत्
units.iast: chāyākrānter niṣedho 'yaṃ na tu vastutvasādhakaḥ । na hy arthāntaraniṣṭhaṃ sad vākyam arthāntaraṃ vadet
units.translation: “This denial of an eclipse or covering does not establish Rāhu as a real object; a sentence whose subject is one thing cannot directly speak of another.”

units.label: Verse I.18.42
units.deva: माधुर्यादि च यत् कार्यम् उष्णद्रव्याद्यसेवनात् । छायाया न त्व् अदृष्टत्वाद् अपाम् एव च दर्शनात्
units.iast: mādhuryādi ca yat kāryam uṣṇadravyādyasevanāt । chāyāyā na tv adṛṣṭatvād apām eva ca darśanāt
units.translation: “Effects such as sweetness come from consuming foods and substances; they do not arise from an unseen shadow, while water alone is actually seen.”

units.label: Verse I.18.43
units.deva: आत्माभासाश्रयाश् चैवं मुखाभासाश्रया यथा । गम्यते शास्त्रयुक्तिभ्याम् आभासासत्त्वम् एव च
units.iast: ātmābhāsāśrayāś caivaṃ mukhābhāsāśrayā yathā । gamyate śāstrayuktibhyām ābhāsāsattvam eva ca
units.translation: “Likewise, scripture and reasoning show that the reflection is unreal; the Self is its basis, as the face is the basis of its image in a mirror.”

units.label: Verse I.18.44
units.deva: न दृशेर् अविकारित्वाद् आभासस्याप्य् अवस्तुतः । नाचितित्वाद् अहंकर्तुः कस्य संसारिता भवेत्
units.iast: na dṛśer avikāritvād ābhāsasyāpy avastutaḥ । nācititvād ahaṃkartuḥ kasya saṃsāritā bhavet
units.translation: “Since the Seer is changeless and the reflection unreal, and since the ego is insentient, who could be a person in bondage?”

units.label: Verse I.18.45
units.deva: अविद्यामात्र एवातः संसारो ऽस्त्व् अविवेकतः । कूटस्थेनात्मना नित्यम् आत्मवान् आत्मनीव सः
units.iast: avidyāmātra evātaḥ saṃsāro 'stv avivekataḥ । kūṭasthenātmanā nityam ātmavān ātmanīva saḥ
units.translation: “Therefore bondage is only ignorance, a failure to discriminate; it seems to belong to the Self, which is changeless, as though it were real in the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.46
units.deva: रज्जुसर्पो यथा रज्ज्वा सात्मकः प्राग् विवेकतः । अवस्तुसन्न् अपि ह्य् एष कूटस्थेनात्मना तथा
units.iast: rajjusarpo yathā rajjvā sātmakaḥ prāg vivekataḥ । avastusann api hy eṣa kūṭasthenātmanā tathā
units.translation: “A snake depends on the rope before discrimination; though unreal, it appears to rest on that ground. So too this world rests on the changeless Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.47
units.deva: आत्माभासाश्रयश् चात्मा प्रत्ययैः स्वैर् विकारवान् । सुखी दुःखी च संसारी नित्य एवेति केचन
units.iast: ātmābhāsāśrayaś cātmā pratyayaiḥ svair vikāravān । sukhī duḥkhī ca saṃsārī nitya eveti kecana
units.translation: “Some say that the Self, as the ground of its reflection, changes with its own thoughts and becomes happy or unhappy, a person in bondage, though it is eternal.”

units.label: Verse I.18.48
units.deva: आत्माभासापरिज्ञानाद् याथात्म्येन विमोहिताः । अहंकर्तारम् आत्मेति मन्यन्ते ते निरागमाः
units.iast: ātmābhāsāparijñānād yāthātmyena vimohitāḥ । ahaṃkartāram ātmeti manyante te nirāgamāḥ
units.translation: “Confused and rejecting scripture, they mistake the ego, the doer, for the Self because they do not understand the reflection of the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.49
units.deva: संसारो वस्तुसंस् तेषां कर्तृभोक्तृत्वलक्षणः । आत्माभासाश्रयाज्ञानात् संसरन्त्य् अविवेकतः
units.iast: saṃsāro vastusaṃs teṣāṃ kartṛbhoktṛtvalakṣaṇaḥ । ātmābhāsāśrayājñānāt saṃsaranty avivekataḥ
units.translation: “For them bondage is real, marked by agency and enjoyment; through ignorance of the basis of the Self’s reflection, they wander without discrimination.”

units.label: Verse I.18.50
units.deva: चैतन्याभासता बुद्धेर् आत्मनस् तत्स्वरूपता । स्याच् चेत् तं ज्ञानशब्दैश् च वेदः शास्तीति युज्यते
units.iast: caitanyābhāsatā buddher ātmanas tatsvarūpatā । syāc cet taṃ jñānaśabdaiś ca vedaḥ śāstīti yujyate
units.translation: “If the intellect is a reflection of consciousness and the Self is consciousness itself, it makes sense for the Veda to teach it through words such as ‘knowledge.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.51
units.deva: प्रकृतिप्रत्ययार्थौ यौ भिन्नाव् एकाश्रयौ यथा । करोति गच्छतीत्यादौ दृष्टौ लोकप्रसिद्धितः
units.iast: prakṛtipratyayārthau yau bhinnāv ekāśrayau yathā । karoti gacchatītyādau dṛṣṭau lokaprasiddhitaḥ
units.translation: “In ordinary usage, the different meanings of root and suffix can share one basis, as in expressions such as ‘he makes’ and ‘he goes.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.52
units.deva: नानयोर् द्व्याश्रयत्वं तु लोके दृष्टं स्मृतौ तथा । जानात्यर्थेषु को हेतुर् द्व्याश्रयत्वे निगद्यताम्
units.iast: nānayor dvyāśrayatvaṃ tu loke dṛṣṭaṃ smṛtau tathā । jānātyartheṣu ko hetur dvyāśrayatve nigadyatām
units.translation: “Ordinary speech and memory do not show two separate bases for them. Explain the reason for assigning two bases to words such as ‘knows.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.53
units.deva: आत्माभासस् तु तिङ्वाच्यो धात्वर्थश् च धियः क्रिया । उभयं चाविवेकेन जानातीत्य् उच्यते मृषा
units.iast: ātmābhāsas tu tiṅvācyo dhātvarthaś ca dhiyaḥ kriyā । ubhayaṃ cāvivekena jānātīty ucyate mṛṣā
units.translation: “The reflected Self is what the verbal ending signifies; the action of the intellect is the root’s meaning. Through lack of discrimination, both are falsely called ‘knowing.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.54
units.deva: न बुद्धेर् अवबोधो ऽस्ति नात्मनो विद्यते क्रिया । अतो नान्यतरस्यापि जानातीति च युज्यते
units.iast: na buddher avabodho 'sti nātmano vidyate kriyā । ato nānyatarasyāpi jānātīti ca yujyate
units.translation: “The intellect has no awareness, and the Self performs no action; therefore it makes no sense to say that either one separately ‘knows.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.55
units.deva: नाप्य् अतो भावशब्देन ज्ञप्तिर् इत्य् अपि युज्यते । न ह्य् आत्मा विक्रियामात्रो नित्य आत्मेतिशासनात्
units.iast: nāpy ato bhāvaśabdena jñaptir ity api yujyate । na hy ātmā vikriyāmātro nitya ātmetiśāsanāt
units.translation: “Nor does it make sense to treat knowledge as a state or modification. The Self is not merely a change, for scripture teaches that it is the eternal Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.56
units.deva: न बुद्धेर् बुद्धिवाच्यत्वं करणं न ह्य् अकर्तृकम् । नापि ज्ञायत इत्य् एवं कर्मशब्दैर् निरुच्यते
units.iast: na buddher buddhivācyatvaṃ karaṇaṃ na hy akartṛkam । nāpi jñāyata ity evaṃ karmaśabdair nirucyate
units.translation: “The intellect is not denoted as a knower, for it is an instrument and cannot act without an agent; nor is it described by the word ‘known.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.57
units.deva: न येषाम् एक एवात्मा निर्दुःखो ऽविक्रियः सदा । तेषां स्याच् छब्दवाच्यत्वं ज्ञेयत्वं चात्मनः सदा
units.iast: na yeṣām eka evātmā nirduḥkho 'vikriyaḥ sadā । teṣāṃ syāc chabdavācyatvaṃ jñeyatvaṃ cātmanaḥ sadā
units.translation: “Those who accept only one Self, ever free from sorrow and change, do not hold that the Self is always denoted by words or made an object of knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.18.58
units.deva: यदाहंकर्तुर् आत्मत्वं तदा शब्दार्थमुख्यता । नाशनायादिमत्त्वात् तु श्रुतौ तस्यात्मतेष्यते
units.iast: yadāhaṃkartur ātmatvaṃ tadā śabdārthamukhyatā । nāśanāyādimattvāt tu śrutau tasyātmateṣyate
units.translation: “If the ego were the Self, the word’s primary meaning would apply; but since it has a beginning and can perish, scripture does not accept its Selfhood.”

units.label: Verse I.18.59
units.deva: हन्त तर्हि न मुख्यार्थो नापि गौणः कथंचन । जानातीत्यादिशब्दस्य गतिर् वाच्या तथापि तु
units.iast: hanta tarhi na mukhyārtho nāpi gauṇaḥ kathaṃcana । jānātītyādiśabdasya gatir vācyā tathāpi tu
units.translation: “Then what is the force of the word ‘knows’—neither literal nor figurative? Its proper usage must still be explained.”

units.label: Verse I.18.60
units.deva: शब्दानाम् अयथार्थत्वे वेदस्याप्य् अप्रमाणता । सा च नेष्टा ततो ग्राह्या गतिर् अस्य प्रसिद्धितः
units.iast: śabdānām ayathārthatve vedasyāpy apramāṇatā । sā ca neṣṭā tato grāhyā gatir asya prasiddhitaḥ
units.translation: “If words did not convey their meanings accurately, the Veda too would be an invalid means of knowledge. That is not acceptable; therefore its usage must be understood as established.”

units.label: Verse I.18.61
units.deva: प्रसिद्धिर् मूढलोकस्य यदि ग्राह्या निरात्मता । लोकायतिकसिद्धान्तः स चानिष्टः प्रसज्यते
units.iast: prasiddhir mūḍhalokasya yadi grāhyā nirātmatā । lokāyatikasiddhāntaḥ sa cāniṣṭaḥ prasajyate
units.translation: “If the usage of ordinary, deluded people alone were accepted, the doctrine that there is no Self would follow—the unwanted conclusion of the materialists.”

units.label: Verse I.18.62
units.deva: अभियुक्तप्रसिद्धिश् चेत् पूर्ववद् दुर्विवेकता । गतिशून्यं न वेदो ऽयं प्रमाणं संवदत्य् उत
units.iast: abhiyuktaprasiddhiś cet pūrvavad durvivekatā । gatiśūnyaṃ na vedo 'yaṃ pramāṇaṃ saṃvadaty uta
units.translation: “If the usage of scholars is accepted, the old failure to discriminate remains; the Veda would then have no coherent meaning and would not convey valid knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.18.63
units.deva: आदर्शमुखसामान्यं मुखस्येष्टं हि मानवैः । मुखस्य प्रतिबिम्बो हि मुखाकारेण दृश्यते
units.iast: ādarśamukhasāmānyaṃ mukhasyeṣṭaṃ hi mānavaiḥ । mukhasya pratibimbo hi mukhākāreṇa dṛśyate
units.translation: “People accept the resemblance between a face and its image in a mirror; the reflection is seen to have the face’s form.”

units.label: Verse I.18.64
units.deva: यत्र यस्यावभासस् तु तयोर् एवाविवेकतः । जानातीति क्रियां सर्वो लोको वक्ति स्वभवतः
units.iast: yatra yasyāvabhāsas tu tayor evāvivekataḥ । jānātīti kriyāṃ sarvo loko vakti svabhavataḥ
units.translation: “Where one thing appears in another, everyone naturally says ‘it knows,’ because the two are not distinguished.”

units.label: Verse I.18.65
units.deva: बुद्धेः कर्तृत्वम् अध्यस्य जानातीति ज्ञ उच्यते । तथा चैतन्यम् अध्यस्य ज्ञत्वं बुद्धेर् इहोच्यते
units.iast: buddheḥ kartṛtvam adhyasya jānātīti jña ucyate । tathā caitanyam adhyasya jñatvaṃ buddher ihocyate
units.translation: “Agency is superimposed on the intellect, and so the knower is called one who ‘knows’; consciousness is likewise superimposed on the intellect, which is then called aware.”

units.label: Verse I.18.66
units.deva: स्वरूपं चात्मनो ज्ञानं नित्यं ज्योतिः श्रुतेर् यतः । न बुद्ध्या क्रियते तस्मान् नात्मनान्येन वा सदा
units.iast: svarūpaṃ cātmano jñānaṃ nityaṃ jyotiḥ śruter yataḥ । na buddhyā kriyate tasmān nātmanānyena vā sadā
units.translation: “Awareness is the Self’s own nature, an eternal light, as scripture teaches; it is not produced by the intellect, nor by the Self through any other means.”

units.label: Verse I.18.67
units.deva: देहे ऽहंप्रत्ययो यद्वज् जानातीति च लौकिकाः । वदन्ति ज्ञानकर्तृत्वं तद्वद् बुद्धेस् तथात्मनः
units.iast: dehe 'haṃpratyayo yadvaj jānātīti ca laukikāḥ । vadanti jñānakartṛtvaṃ tadvad buddhes tathātmanaḥ
units.translation: “Just as ordinary people say ‘I’ of the body, they speak of the intellect and Self as agents of knowing, through the same mistaken attribution.”

units.label: Verse I.18.68
units.deva: बौद्धैस् तु प्रत्ययैर् एवं क्रियमाणैश् च चिन्निभैः । मोहिताः क्रियते ज्ञानम् इत्य् आहुस् तार्किका जनाः
units.iast: bauddhais tu pratyayair evaṃ kriyamāṇaiś ca cinnibhaiḥ । mohitāḥ kriyate jñānam ity āhus tārkikā janāḥ
units.translation: “Because perceptions are produced in this way and resemble consciousness, Buddhist logicians say that cognition itself is produced.”

units.label: Verse I.18.69
units.deva: तस्माज् ज्ञाभासबुद्धीनाम् अविवेकात् प्रवर्तिताः । जानातीत्यादिशब्दश् च प्रत्ययो या च तत्स्मृतिः
units.iast: tasmāj jñābhāsabuddhīnām avivekāt pravartitāḥ । jānātītyādiśabdaś ca pratyayo yā ca tatsmṛtiḥ
units.translation: “Words such as ‘knows,’ the cognition and its memory arise through failure to distinguish the reflected knower from the intellect.”

units.label: Verse I.18.70
units.deva: आदर्शानुविधायित्वं छायाया अस्यते मुखे । बुद्धिधर्मानुकारित्वं ज्ञाभासस्य तथेष्यते
units.iast: ādarśānuvidhāyitvaṃ chāyāyā asyate mukhe । buddhidharmānukāritvaṃ jñābhāsasya tatheṣyate
units.translation: “The reflection follows the mirror, not the face; in the same way, the reflection of the knower is held to follow the properties of the intellect.”

units.label: Verse I.18.71
units.deva: बुद्धेस् तु प्रत्ययास् तस्माद् आत्माभासेन दीपिताः । ग्राहका इव भासन्ते दहन्तीवोल्मुकादयः
units.iast: buddhes tu pratyayās tasmād ātmābhāsena dīpitāḥ । grāhakā iva bhāsante dahantīvolmukādayaḥ
units.translation: “The intellect’s perceptions, lit by the reflected Self, appear to be knowers, as firebrands seem to burn.”

units.label: Verse I.18.72
units.deva: स्वयम् एवावभास्यन्ते ग्राहकाः स्वयम् एव च । इत्य् एवं ग्राहकास्तित्वं प्रतिषेधन्ति सौगताः
units.iast: svayam evāvabhāsyante grāhakāḥ svayam eva ca । ity evaṃ grāhakāstitvaṃ pratiṣedhanti saugatāḥ
units.translation: “The Buddhists deny a separate perceiver: perceptions themselves appear and grasp their objects.”

units.label: Verse I.18.73
units.deva: यद्य् एवं नान्यदृश्यास् ते किं तद्वारणम् उच्यताम् । भावाभावौ हि तेषां यौ नान्यग्राह्यौ सदा यदि
units.iast: yady evaṃ nānyadṛśyās te kiṃ tadvāraṇam ucyatām । bhāvābhāvau hi teṣāṃ yau nānyagrāhyau sadā yadi
units.translation: “If this is so, they are not seen by anything else; tell us what refutes that. Their existence and nonexistence are never objects of another knower.”

units.label: Verse I.18.74
units.deva: अन्वयी ग्राहकस् तेषाम् इत्य् एतद् अपि तत्समम् । अचितित्वस्य तुल्यत्वाद् अन्यस्मिन् ग्राहके सति
units.iast: anvayī grāhakas teṣām ity etad api tatsamam । acititvasya tulyatvād anyasmin grāhake sati
units.translation: “The claim that an enduring perceiver is present in them has the same fault, if that perceiver is as insentient as another object.”

units.label: Verse I.18.75
units.deva: अध्यक्षस्य समीपे तु सिद्धिः स्याद् इति चेन् मतम् । नाध्यक्षे ऽनुपकारित्वाद् अन्यत्रापि प्रसङ्गतः
units.iast: adhyakṣasya samīpe tu siddhiḥ syād iti cen matam । nādhyakṣe 'nupakāritvād anyatrāpi prasaṅgataḥ
units.translation: “If you say they are established by the direct witness, that does not work: the witness gains nothing from them, and the same problem follows for anything else.”

units.label: Verse I.18.76
units.deva: अर्थी दुःखी च यः श्रोता स त्व् अध्यक्षो ऽथवेतरः । अध्यक्षस्य च दुःखित्वम् अर्थित्वं च न ते मतम्
units.iast: arthī duḥkhī ca yaḥ śrotā sa tv adhyakṣo 'thavetaraḥ । adhyakṣasya ca duḥkhitvam arthitvaṃ ca na te matam
units.translation: “The listener who seeks happiness and is suffering—are these the witness or something else? You do not hold that the witness itself desires or suffers.”

units.label: Verse I.18.77
units.deva: कर्ताध्यक्षं सद् अस्मीति नैव सद्ग्रहम् अर्हति । सद् एवासीति मिथ्योक्तिः श्रुतेर् अपि न युज्यते
units.iast: kartādhyakṣaṃ sad asmīti naiva sadgraham arhati । sad evāsīti mithyoktiḥ śruter api na yujyate
units.translation: “The thought ‘I am the doer’ cannot qualify the Self as Being. Then the teaching ‘You are Being’ would be false, even according to scripture.”

units.label: Verse I.18.78
units.deva: अविविच्योभयं वक्ति श्रुतिश् चेत् स्याद् ग्रहस् तथा । अस्मदस् तु विविच्यैव त्वम् एवेति वदेद् यदि
units.iast: avivicyobhayaṃ vakti śrutiś cet syād grahas tathā । asmadas tu vivicyaiva tvam eveti vaded yadi
units.translation: “If scripture spoke of the two without distinguishing them, it would be a mere seizure of both; but if it spoke distinctly, saying ‘you alone are that’…”

units.label: Verse I.18.79
units.deva: प्रत्ययान्वयिनिष्ठत्वम् उक्तो दोषः प्रसज्यते । त्वम् इत्य् अध्यक्षनिष्ठश् चेद् अहमध्यक्षयोः कथम्
units.iast: pratyayānvayiniṣṭhatvam ukto doṣaḥ prasajyate । tvam ity adhyakṣaniṣṭhaś ced ahamadhyakṣayoḥ katham
units.translation: “…the fault already stated would follow: it would be grounded in a connected cognition. If ‘you’ refers to the witness, how could there be a relation between ego and witness?”

units.label: Verse I.18.80
units.deva: संबन्धो वाच्य एवात्र येन त्वम् इति लक्षयेत् । द्रष्टृदृश्यत्वसंबन्धो यद्य् अध्यक्षे ऽक्रिये कथम्
units.iast: saṃbandho vācya evātra yena tvam iti lakṣayet । draṣṭṛdṛśyatvasaṃbandho yady adhyakṣe 'kriye katham
units.translation: “A relation must be stated by which ‘you’ can be indicated. If it is the relation of seer and seen, how could that belong to the inactive witness?”

units.label: Verse I.18.81
units.deva: अक्रियत्वे ऽपि तादात्म्यम् अध्यक्षस्य भवेद् यदि । आत्माध्यक्षो ममास्तीति संबन्धाग्रहणे न धीः
units.iast: akriyatve 'pi tādātmyam adhyakṣasya bhaved yadi । ātmādhyakṣo mamāstīti saṃbandhāgrahaṇe na dhīḥ
units.translation: “If there is identity even though the witness is inactive, then without grasping a relation there could be no cognition ‘I have the Self as witness.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.82
units.deva: संबन्धग्रहणं शास्त्राद् इति चेन् मन्यसे न हि । पूर्वोक्ताः स्युस् त्रिधा दोषा ग्रहो वा स्यान् ममेति च
units.iast: saṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ śāstrād iti cen manyase na hi । pūrvoktāḥ syus tridhā doṣā graho vā syān mameti ca
units.translation: “If you say the relation is grasped from scripture, the three faults already explained still follow, or else there would be the thought ‘it is mine.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.83
units.deva: अदृशिर् दृशिरूपेण भाति बुद्धिर् यदा सदा । प्रत्यया अपि तस्याः स्युस् तप्तायोविस्फुलिङ्गवत्
units.iast: adṛśir dṛśirūpeṇa bhāti buddhir yadā sadā । pratyayā api tasyāḥ syus taptāyovisphuliṅgavat
units.translation: “When the intellect appears in the form of the Seer, its thoughts are like sparks from heated iron.”

units.label: Verse I.18.84
units.deva: आभासस् तदभावश् च दृशेः सीम्नो न चान्यथा । लोकस्य युक्तितः स्यातां तद्ग्रहश् च तथा सति
units.iast: ābhāsas tadabhāvaś ca dṛśeḥ sīmno na cānyathā । lokasya yuktitaḥ syātāṃ tadgrahaś ca tathā sati
units.translation: “Reflection and its absence alike belong only within the boundary of the Seer; through ordinary usage and reasoning one understands its grasp.”

units.label: Verse I.18.85
units.deva: नन्व् एवं दृशिसंक्रान्तिर् अयःपिण्डे ऽग्निवद् भवेत् । मुखाभासवद् इत्य् एतद् आदर्शे तन् निराकृतम्
units.iast: nanv evaṃ dṛśisaṃkrāntir ayaḥpiṇḍe 'gnivad bhavet । mukhābhāsavad ity etad ādarśe tan nirākṛtam
units.translation: “If consciousness were transferred to the intellect like fire to an iron ball, that was refuted by the example of the face’s reflection in a mirror.”

units.label: Verse I.18.86
units.deva: कृष्णायो रोहिताभासम् इत्य् एतद् दृष्टम् उच्यते । दृष्टदार्ष्टान्ततुल्यत्वं न तु सर्वात्मना क्वचित्
units.iast: kṛṣṇāyo rohitābhāsam ity etad dṛṣṭam ucyate । dṛṣṭadārṣṭāntatulyatvaṃ na tu sarvātmanā kvacit
units.translation: “Black iron appears red by reflecting fire; the example and what it illustrates are alike in that respect, not in every respect.”

units.label: Verse I.18.87
units.deva: तथैव चेतनाभासं चित्तं चैतन्यवद् भवेत् । मुखाभासो यथादर्श आभासश् चोदितो मृषा
units.iast: tathaiva cetanābhāsaṃ cittaṃ caitanyavad bhavet । mukhābhāso yathādarśa ābhāsaś codito mṛṣā
units.translation: “In the same way the mind appears conscious through a reflection of consciousness; the image of a face in a mirror is also only an appearance.”

units.label: Verse I.18.88
units.deva: चित्तं चेतनम् इत्य् एतच् छास्त्रयुक्तिविवर्जितम् । देहस्यापि प्रसङ्गः स्याच् चक्षुरादेस् तथैव च
units.iast: cittaṃ cetanam ity etac chāstrayuktivivarjitam । dehasyāpi prasaṅgaḥ syāc cakṣurādes tathaiva ca
units.translation: “The claim ‘the mind is conscious’ lacks the support of scripture and reasoning; the same would then follow for the body, eye and the other senses.”

units.label: Verse I.18.89
units.deva: तद् अप्य् अस्त्व् इति चेत् तन् न लोकायतिकसंगतेः । न च धीर् दृशिर् अस्मीति यद्य् आभासो न चेतसि
units.iast: tad apy astv iti cet tan na lokāyatikasaṃgateḥ । na ca dhīr dṛśir asmīti yady ābhāso na cetasi
units.translation: “If you accept that too, you arrive at materialism. But unless the intellect reflects awareness, how could it even have the thought ‘I am the Seer’?”

units.label: Verse I.18.90
units.deva: सद् अस्मीति धियो ऽभावे व्यर्थं स्यात् तत् त्वम् अस्य् अपि । युष्मदस्मद्विवेकज्ञे स्याद् अर्थवद् इदं वचः
units.iast: sad asmīti dhiyo 'bhāve vyarthaṃ syāt tat tvam asy api । yuṣmadasmadvivekajñe syād arthavad idaṃ vacaḥ
units.translation: “If the cognition ‘I am Being’ were absent, the teaching ‘you are that’ would be pointless; these words are meaningful to one who knows the distinction between ‘you’ and ‘I.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.91
units.deva: ममेदंप्रत्ययौ ज्ञेयौ युष्मद्य् एव न संशयः । अहम् इत्य् अस्मदीष्टः स्याद् अयम् अस्मीति चोभयोः
units.iast: mamedaṃpratyayau jñeyau yuṣmady eva na saṃśayaḥ । aham ity asmadīṣṭaḥ syād ayam asmīti cobhayoḥ
units.translation: “Without doubt, the thoughts ‘mine’ and ‘this’ belong to ‘you’; ‘I’ belongs to ‘we’; and both are present in the thought ‘I am this.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.92
units.deva: अन्योन्यापेक्षया तेषां प्रधानगुणतेष्यते । विशेषणविशेष्यत्वं तथा ग्राह्यं हि युक्तितः
units.iast: anyonyāpekṣayā teṣāṃ pradhānaguṇateṣyate । viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvaṃ tathā grāhyaṃ hi yuktitaḥ
units.translation: “They are held to be principal and subordinate in relation to one another; the relation of qualifier and qualified is reasonable.”

units.label: Verse I.18.93
units.deva: ममेदं द्वयम् अप्य् एतन् मध्यमस्य विशेषणम् । धनी गोमान् यथा तद्वद् देहो ऽहंकर्तुर् एव च
units.iast: mamedaṃ dvayam apy etan madhyamasya viśeṣaṇam । dhanī gomān yathā tadvad deho 'haṃkartur eva ca
units.translation: “‘Mine’ and ‘this’ together qualify the intermediate ego, as ‘wealthy’ and ‘owner of cattle’ qualify a person; so do the body and the ego.”

units.label: Verse I.18.94
units.deva: बुद्ध्यारूढं सदा सर्वं साहंकर्त्रा च साक्षिणः । तस्मात् सर्वावभासो ज्ञः किंचिद् अप्य् अस्पृशन् सदा
units.iast: buddhyārūḍhaṃ sadā sarvaṃ sāhaṃkartrā ca sākṣiṇaḥ । tasmāt sarvāvabhāso jñaḥ kiṃcid apy aspṛśan sadā
units.translation: “Everything always appears in the intellect and with the ego; therefore the knower, witness of all, reveals everything while never touching anything.”

units.label: Verse I.18.95
units.deva: प्रतिलोमम् इदं सर्वं यथोक्तं लोकबुद्धितः । अविवेकधियाम् अस्ति नास्ति सर्वं विवेकिनाम्
units.iast: pratilomam idaṃ sarvaṃ yathoktaṃ lokabuddhitaḥ । avivekadhiyām asti nāsti sarvaṃ vivekinām
units.translation: “All this, explained in reverse of ordinary belief, exists only for minds that fail to discriminate; to the discerning, everything of this kind is absent.”

units.label: Verse I.18.96
units.deva: अन्वयव्यतिरेकौ हि पदार्थस्य पदस्य च । स्याद् एतद् अहम् इत्य् अत्र युक्तिर् एवावधारणे
