units.iast: anvayavyatirekau hi padārthasya padasya ca । syād etad aham ity atra yuktir evāvadhāraṇe
units.translation: “Agreement and difference are the reasoning for the meaning of a thing and of a word; here they establish what is meant by ‘I.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.97
units.deva: नाद्राक्षम् अहम् इति अस्मिन् सुषुप्ते ऽन्यन् मनाग् अपि । न वारयति दृष्टिं स्वां प्रत्ययं तु निषेधति
units.iast: nādrākṣam aham iti asmin suṣupte 'nyan manāg api । na vārayati dṛṣṭiṃ svāṃ pratyayaṃ tu niṣedhati
units.translation: “In deep sleep, ‘I did not see anything else’ does not deny my own seeing; it denies the cognition.”

units.label: Verse I.18.98
units.deva: स्वयंज्योतिर् न हि द्रष्टुर् इत्य् एवं संविदो ऽस्तिताम् । कौटस्थ्यं च तथा तस्याः प्रत्ययस्य च लुप्तताम् । स्वयम् एवाब्रवीच् छास्त्रं प्रत्ययावगती पृथक्
units.iast: svayaṃjyotir na hi draṣṭur ity evaṃ saṃvido 'stitām । kauṭasthyaṃ ca tathā tasyāḥ pratyayasya ca luptatām । svayam evābravīc chāstraṃ pratyayāvagatī pṛthak
units.translation: “Scripture itself declares that awareness is self-luminous and the Seer changeless, that the cognition disappears, and that the cognition and awareness are distinct.”

units.label: Verse I.18.99
units.deva: एवं विज्ञातवाक्यार्थे श्रुतिलोकप्रसिद्धितः । श्रुतिस् तत् त्वम् असीत्य् आह श्रोतुर् मोहापनुत्तये
units.iast: evaṃ vijñātavākyārthe śrutilokaprasiddhitaḥ । śrutis tat tvam asīty āha śrotur mohāpanuttaye
units.translation: “When the ordinary meaning of the words has been understood from scripture and common usage, scripture says ‘you are that’ to remove the listener’s delusion.”

units.label: Verse I.18.100
units.deva: ब्रह्मा दाशरथेर् यद्वद् उक्त्यैवापानुदत् तमः । तस्य विष्णुत्वसंबोधे न यत्नान्तरम् ऊचिवान्
units.iast: brahmā dāśarather yadvad uktyaivāpānudat tamaḥ । tasya viṣṇutvasaṃbodhe na yatnāntaram ūcivān
units.translation: “Just as Brahmā removed Daśaratha’s son’s darkness by words alone, without requiring further effort to make him recognize his nature as Viṣṇu,”

units.label: Verse I.18.101
units.deva: अहंशब्दस्य या निष्ठा ज्योतिषि प्रत्यगात्मनि । सैवोक्ता सद् असीत्य् एवं फलं तत्र विमुक्तता
units.iast: ahaṃśabdasya yā niṣṭhā jyotiṣi pratyagātmani । saivoktā sad asīty evaṃ phalaṃ tatra vimuktatā
units.translation: “so the essential meaning of the word ‘I,’ the inward light, is expressed as ‘you are Being’; its fruit is liberation.”

units.label: Verse I.18.102
units.deva: श्रुतमात्रे न चेत् तत् स्यात् कार्यं तत्र भवेद् ध्रुवम् । व्यवहारात् पुरापीष्टः सद्भावः स्वयम् आत्मनः
units.iast: śrutamātre na cet tat syāt kāryaṃ tatra bhaved dhruvam । vyavahārāt purāpīṣṭaḥ sadbhāvaḥ svayam ātmanaḥ
units.translation: “If that does not arise from merely hearing, some further task would surely be required; yet even before this, ordinary usage accepts the Self’s existence as one’s own.”

units.label: Verse I.18.103
units.deva: अशनायादिनिर्मुक्त्यै तत्काला जायते प्रमा । तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्यार्थे त्रिषु कालेष्व् असंशयः
units.iast: aśanāyādinirmuktyai tatkālā jāyate pramā । tattvamasyādivākyārthe triṣu kāleṣv asaṃśayaḥ
units.translation: “For one free from hunger and the rest, valid knowledge of the meaning of ‘you are that’ arises at that very moment, without doubt, in all three times.”

units.label: Verse I.18.104
units.deva: प्रतिबन्धविहीनत्वात् स्वयं चानुभवात्मनः । जायेतैव प्रमा तत्र स्वात्मन्य् एव न संशयः
units.iast: pratibandhavihīnatvāt svayaṃ cānubhavātmanaḥ । jāyetaiva pramā tatra svātmany eva na saṃśayaḥ
units.translation: “Since there is no obstacle and awareness is itself one’s experience, valid knowledge surely arises there in one’s own Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.105
units.deva: किं सद् एवाहम् अस्मीति किं वान्यत् प्रतिपद्यते । सद् एव चेद् अहंशब्दः सता मुख्यार्थ इष्यताम्
units.iast: kiṃ sad evāham asmīti kiṃ vānyat pratipadyate । sad eva ced ahaṃśabdaḥ satā mukhyārtha iṣyatām
units.translation: “Does one then understand ‘I alone am Being,’ or something else? If the word ‘I’ means Being, let that be accepted as its primary meaning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.106
units.deva: अन्यच् चेत् सदहंग्राहप्रतिपत्तिर् मृषैव सा । तस्मान् मुख्यग्रहे नास्ति वारणावगतेर् इह
units.iast: anyac cet sadahaṃgrāhapratipattir mṛṣaiva sā । tasmān mukhyagrahe nāsti vāraṇāvagater iha
units.translation: “If it meant something else, the cognition ‘Being is what I grasp as myself’ would be false; therefore no barrier to the primary meaning remains here.”

units.label: Verse I.18.107
units.deva: प्रत्ययी प्रत्ययश् चैव यदाभासौ तदर्थता । तयोर् अचितिमत्त्वाच् च चैतन्ये कल्प्यते फलम्
units.iast: pratyayī pratyayaś caiva yadābhāsau tadarthatā । tayor acitimattvāc ca caitanye kalpyate phalam
units.translation: “Both the thinker and the thought are reflections; because neither is conscious, their result is imagined in consciousness.”

units.label: Verse I.18.108
units.deva: कूटस्थे ऽपि फलं योग्यं राजनीव जयादिकम् । तदनात्मत्वहेतुभ्यां क्रियायाः प्रत्ययस्य च
units.iast: kūṭasthe 'pi phalaṃ yogyaṃ rājanīva jayādikam । tadanātmatvahetubhyāṃ kriyāyāḥ pratyayasya ca
units.translation: “Even the changeless witness may be credited with a result, as a king is credited with victory, because action and cognition belong to what is not-Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.109
units.deva: आदर्शस् तु यदाभासो मुखाकारः स एव सः । यथैवं प्रत्ययादर्शो यदाभासस् तदा ह्य् अहम्
units.iast: ādarśas tu yadābhāso mukhākāraḥ sa eva saḥ । yathaivaṃ pratyayādarśo yadābhāsas tadā hy aham
units.translation: “The image in a mirror has the face’s form; in the same way, when a cognition appears in the mirror of the intellect, one thinks ‘I am.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.110
units.deva: इत्य् एवं प्रतिपत्तिः स्यात् सद् अस्मीति च नान्यथा । तत् त्वम् इत्य् उपदेशो ऽपि द्वाराभावाद् अनर्थकः
units.iast: ity evaṃ pratipattiḥ syāt sad asmīti ca nānyathā । tat tvam ity upadeśo 'pi dvārābhāvād anarthakaḥ
units.translation: “Thus the understanding ‘I am Being’ arises; otherwise, without this means of access, the instruction ‘you are that’ would be pointless.”

units.label: Verse I.18.111
units.deva: श्रोतुः स्याद् उपदेशश् चेद् अर्थवत्त्वं तथा भवेत् । अध्यक्षस्य न चेद् इष्टं श्रोतृत्वं कस्य तद् भवेत्
units.iast: śrotuḥ syād upadeśaś ced arthavattvaṃ tathā bhavet । adhyakṣasya na ced iṣṭaṃ śrotṛtvaṃ kasya tad bhavet
units.translation: “If the instruction is addressed to a hearer, it has meaning. If the witness is not a hearer, who would the instruction concern?”

units.label: Verse I.18.112
units.deva: अध्यक्षस्य समीपे बुद्धेर् एवेति चेन् मतम् । न तत्कृतोपकारो ऽस्ति काष्ठाद् यद्वन् न कल्प्यते
units.iast: adhyakṣasya samīpe buddher eveti cen matam । na tatkṛtopakāro 'sti kāṣṭhād yadvan na kalpyate
units.translation: “If you say it concerns the intellect because it is near the witness, the witness does not thereby help it, just as wood is not helped by mere proximity.”

units.label: Verse I.18.113
units.deva: बुद्धौ चेत् तत्कृतः कश्चिन् नन्व् एवं परिणामिता । आभासे ऽपि च को दोषः सति श्रुत्याद्यनुग्रहे
units.iast: buddhau cet tatkṛtaḥ kaścin nanv evaṃ pariṇāmitā । ābhāse 'pi ca ko doṣaḥ sati śrutyādyanugrahe
units.translation: “If the witness does something to the intellect, then the witness would change. What fault is there in saying it helps the reflection, with the support of scripture and the rest?”

units.label: Verse I.18.114
units.deva: आभासे परिणामश् चेन् न रज्ज्वादिनिभत्ववत् । सर्पादेश् च तथावोचम् आदर्शे च मुखत्ववत्
units.iast: ābhāse pariṇāmaś cen na rajjvādinibhatvavat । sarpādeś ca tathāvocam ādarśe ca mukhatvavat
units.translation: “If the reflection itself changes, there is no problem: it is like the snake imagined in a rope. I have already explained the example of the face appearing in a mirror.”

units.label: Verse I.18.115
units.deva: नात्माभासत्वसिद्धिश् चेद् आत्मनो ग्रहणात् पृथक् । मुखादेस् तु पृथक्सिद्धिर् इह त्व् अन्योन्यसंश्रयः
units.iast: nātmābhāsatvasiddhiś ced ātmano grahaṇāt pṛthak । mukhādes tu pṛthaksiddhir iha tv anyonyasaṃśrayaḥ
units.translation: “The Self’s reflection is not established, because the Self is grasped separately; the face and its reflection are separately established, while here each depends on the other.”

units.label: Verse I.18.116
units.deva: अध्यक्षस्य पृथक्सिद्धाव् आभासस्य तदीयता । आभासस्य तदीयत्वे ह्य् अध्यक्षव्यतिरिक्तता
units.iast: adhyakṣasya pṛthaksiddhāv ābhāsasya tadīyatā । ābhāsasya tadīyatve hy adhyakṣavyatiriktatā
units.translation: “If the witness were established separately, the reflection could be said to belong to it; if the reflection belonged to it, the witness would have to be distinct from that reflection.”

units.label: Verse I.18.117
units.deva: नैवं स्वप्ने पृथक्सिद्धेः प्रत्ययस्य दृशेस् तथा । रथादेस् तत्र शून्यत्वात् प्रत्ययस्यात्मना ग्रहः
units.iast: naivaṃ svapne pṛthaksiddheḥ pratyayasya dṛśes tathā । rathādes tatra śūnyatvāt pratyayasyātmanā grahaḥ
units.translation: “In a dream, however, neither the cognition nor the Seer is established separately: chariots and the rest are empty there, and cognition itself is grasped as the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.118
units.deva: अवगत्या हि संव्याप्तः प्रत्ययो विषयाकृतिः । जायते स यदाकारः स बाह्यो विषयो मतः
units.iast: avagatyā hi saṃvyāptaḥ pratyayo viṣayākṛtiḥ । jāyate sa yadākāraḥ sa bāhyo viṣayo mataḥ
units.translation: “Pervaded by awareness, a cognition arises with the form of its object; whatever form it takes is considered an external object.”

units.label: Verse I.18.119
units.deva: कर्मेप्सिततमत्वात् स तद्वान् कार्ये नियुज्यते । आकारो यत्र चार्प्येत करणं तद् इहोच्यते
units.iast: karmepsitatamatvāt sa tadvān kārye niyujyate । ākāro yatra cārpyeta karaṇaṃ tad ihocyate
units.translation: “That object is what action most desires to obtain; an agent is directed toward its result. Where a form is placed [in the intellect], that is called the instrument.”

units.label: Verse I.18.120
units.deva: यदाभासेन संव्याप्तः स ज्ञातेति निगद्यते । त्रयम् एतद् विविच्यात्र यो जानाति स आत्मवित्
units.iast: yadābhāsena saṃvyāptaḥ sa jñāteti nigadyate । trayam etad vivicyātra yo jānāti sa ātmavit
units.translation: “One pervaded by this reflection is called the knower. Distinguishing this triad, one understands the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.121
units.deva: सम्यक्संशयमिथ्योक्ताः प्रत्यया व्यभिचारिणः । एकैवावगतिस् तेषु भेदस् तु प्रत्ययार्पितः
units.iast: samyaksaṃśayamithyoktāḥ pratyayā vyabhicāriṇaḥ । ekaivāvagatis teṣu bhedas tu pratyayārpitaḥ
units.translation: “Correct, doubtful and false cognitions vary; awareness within them is one, and the distinctions are attributed to the cognitions.”

units.label: Verse I.18.122
units.deva: आधिभेदाद् यथा भेदो मणेर् अवगतेस् तथा । अशुद्धिः परिणामश् च सर्वं प्रत्ययसंश्रयात्
units.iast: ādhibhedād yathā bhedo maṇer avagates tathā । aśuddhiḥ pariṇāmaś ca sarvaṃ pratyayasaṃśrayāt
units.translation: “As a jewel appears different because of the adjuncts around it, so impurity and change alike depend on cognition.”

units.label: Verse I.18.123
units.deva: प्रथनं ग्रहणं सिद्धिः प्रत्ययानाम् इहान्यतः । आपरोक्ष्यात् तद् एवोक्तम् अनुमानं प्रदीपवत्
units.iast: prathanaṃ grahaṇaṃ siddhiḥ pratyayānām ihānyataḥ । āparokṣyāt tad evoktam anumānaṃ pradīpavat
units.translation: “The manifestation, grasping and establishment of cognitions arise from something other than the cognition; because it is immediate, this is described as inference, like a lamp.”

units.label: Verse I.18.124
units.deva: किम् अज्ञं ग्राहयेत् कश्चित् प्रमाणेन तु केनचित् । विनैव तु प्रमाणेन निवृत्त्यान्यस्य शेषतः
units.iast: kim ajñaṃ grāhayet kaścit pramāṇena tu kenacit । vinaiva tu pramāṇena nivṛttyānyasya śeṣataḥ
units.translation: “By what means of knowledge could someone make the ignorant one know? Without any means, removing the other [superimposition] alone leaves what remains.”

units.label: Verse I.18.125
units.deva: शब्देनैव प्रमाणेन निवृत्तिश् चेद् इहोच्यते । अध्यक्षस्याप्रसिद्धत्वाच् छून्यतैव प्रसज्यते
units.iast: śabdenaiva pramāṇena nivṛttiś ced ihocyate । adhyakṣasyāprasiddhatvāc chūnyataiva prasajyate
units.translation: “If one says scripture is the means by which this is removed, but the witness is not established, then emptiness alone follows.”

units.label: Verse I.18.126
units.deva: चेतनस् त्वं कथं देह इति चेन् नाप्रसिद्धितः । चेतनस्यान्यतासिद्धाव् एवं स्याद् अन्यहानतः
units.iast: cetanas tvaṃ kathaṃ deha iti cen nāprasiddhitaḥ । cetanasyānyatāsiddhāv evaṃ syād anyahānataḥ
units.translation: Objection: “How can you be conscious and the body not?” The reply: “That is not established; if consciousness were established as other than the body, then only the not-Self would be removed.”

units.label: Verse I.18.127
units.deva: अध्यक्षः स्वयम् अस्त्य् एव चेतनस्यापरोक्षतः । तुल्य एवं प्रबोधः स्याद् अज्ञस्यासत्त्ववादिना
units.iast: adhyakṣaḥ svayam asty eva cetanasyāparokṣataḥ । tulya evaṃ prabodhaḥ syād ajñasyāsattvavādinā
units.translation: “The witness exists by itself and consciousness is immediate; the ignorant person and the one who denies reality would be awakened in the same way.”

units.label: Verse I.18.128
units.deva: अहम् अज्ञासिषं चेदम् इति लोकस्मृतेर् इह । करणं कर्म कर्ता च सिद्धास् त्व् एकक्षणे किल
units.iast: aham ajñāsiṣaṃ cedam iti lokasmṛter iha । karaṇaṃ karma kartā ca siddhās tv ekakṣaṇe kila
units.translation: “From the ordinary memory ‘I knew this,’ the instrument, action and agent appear to be established all at once.”

units.label: Verse I.18.129
units.deva: प्रामाण्ये ऽपि स्मृतेः शैघ्र्याद् यौगपद्यं विभाव्यते । क्रमेण ग्रहणं पूर्वं स्मृतेः पश्चात् तथैव च
units.iast: prāmāṇye 'pi smṛteḥ śaighryād yaugapadyaṃ vibhāvyate । krameṇa grahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ smṛteḥ paścāt tathaiva ca
units.translation: “Even if memory is valid, its speed makes them seem simultaneous; first there is the apprehension, and then the memory follows.”

units.label: Verse I.18.130
units.deva: अज्ञासिषम् इदं मां चेत्य् अपेक्षा जायते ध्रुवम् । विशेषो ऽपेक्ष्यते यत्र तत्र नैवैककालता
units.iast: ajñāsiṣam idaṃ māṃ cety apekṣā jāyate dhruvam । viśeṣo 'pekṣyate yatra tatra naivaikakālatā
units.translation: “The thought ‘I knew this’ requires a relation of comparison; wherever a distinction must be considered, it is not all at once.”

units.label: Verse I.18.131
units.deva: आत्मनो ग्रहणे चापि त्रयाणाम् इह संभवात् । आत्मन्य् आसक्तकर्तृत्वं न स्यात् करणकर्मणोः
units.iast: ātmano grahaṇe cāpi trayāṇām iha saṃbhavāt । ātmany āsaktakartṛtvaṃ na syāt karaṇakarmaṇoḥ
units.translation: “Even if all three are possible in the apprehension of the Self, agency cannot attach to the Self, instrument or object.”

units.label: Verse I.18.132
units.deva: व्याप्तुम् इष्टं च यत् कर्तुः क्रियया कर्म तत् स्मृतम् । अतो हि कर्तृतन्त्रत्वं तस्येष्टं नान्यतन्त्रता
units.iast: vyāptum iṣṭaṃ ca yat kartuḥ kriyayā karma tat smṛtam । ato hi kartṛtantratvaṃ tasyeṣṭaṃ nānyatantratā
units.translation: “The object is that which the agent wishes to reach through action; therefore it depends on the agent, not on itself.”

units.label: Verse I.18.133
units.deva: शब्दाद् वानुमितेर् वापि प्रमाणाद् वा ततो ऽन्यतः । सिद्धिः सर्वपदार्थानां स्याद् अज्ञं प्रति नान्यथा
units.iast: śabdād vānumiter vāpi pramāṇād vā tato 'nyataḥ । siddhiḥ sarvapadārthānāṃ syād ajñaṃ prati nānyathā
units.translation: “For an ignorant person, all things are established by words, inference or some other means of knowledge; there is no other way.”

units.label: Verse I.18.134
units.deva: अध्यक्षस्यापि सिद्धिः स्यात् प्रमाणेन विनैव वा । विना स्वस्य प्रसिद्धिस् तु नाज्ञं प्रत्य् उपयुज्यते
units.iast: adhyakṣasyāpi siddhiḥ syāt pramāṇena vinaiva vā । vinā svasya prasiddhis tu nājñaṃ praty upayujyate
units.translation: “The witness may be established with or without a means of knowledge, but its self-establishment does not help the ignorant person.”

units.label: Verse I.18.135
units.deva: तस्यैवाज्ञत्वम् इष्टं चेज् ज्ञातत्वे ऽन्या मितिर् भवेत् । अन्यस्यैवाज्ञतायां च तद्विज्ञाने ध्रुवा भवेत्
units.iast: tasyaivājñatvam iṣṭaṃ cej jñātatve 'nyā mitir bhavet । anyasyaivājñatāyāṃ ca tadvijñāne dhruvā bhavet
units.translation: “If the witness itself is said to be ignorant, then when it is known there must be another cognition; if something else is ignorant, then knowledge of that other is certain.”

units.label: Verse I.18.136
units.deva: ज्ञातता स्वात्मलाभो वा सिद्धिः स्याद् अन्यद् एव वा । ज्ञातत्वे ऽनन्तरोक्तौ त्वं पक्षौ संस्मर्तुम् अर्हसि
units.iast: jñātatā svātmalābho vā siddhiḥ syād anyad eva vā । jñātatve 'nantaroktau tvaṃ pakṣau saṃsmartum arhasi
units.translation: “Is establishment knowledge, attainment of oneself, or something else? In speaking of knowledge, remember the two possibilities just mentioned.”

units.label: Verse I.18.137
units.deva: सिद्धिः स्यात् स्वात्मलाभश् चेद् यत्नस् तत्र निरर्थकः । सर्वलोकप्रसिद्धत्वात् स्वहेतुभ्यस् तु वस्तुनः
units.iast: siddhiḥ syāt svātmalābhaś ced yatnas tatra nirarthakaḥ । sarvalokaprasiddhatvāt svahetubhyas tu vastunaḥ
units.translation: “If establishment is attainment of oneself, effort is pointless: everyone already knows reality through its own causes.”

units.label: Verse I.18.138
units.deva: ज्ञानज्ञेयादिवादे ऽतः सिद्धिर् ज्ञातत्वम् उच्यते । अध्यक्षाध्यक्ष्ययोः सिद्धिर् ज्ञेयत्वं नात्मलाभता
units.iast: jñānajñeyādivāde 'taḥ siddhir jñātatvam ucyate । adhyakṣādhyakṣyayoḥ siddhir jñeyatvaṃ nātmalābhatā
units.translation: “In the view of knower and knowable, establishment is said to mean being known; the witness and its object are knowable, not attainment of oneself.”

units.label: Verse I.18.139
units.deva: स्पष्टत्वं कर्मकर्त्रादेः सिद्धता यदि कल्प्यते । स्पष्टतास्पष्टते स्याताम् अन्यस्यैव न चात्मनः
units.iast: spaṣṭatvaṃ karmakartrādeḥ siddhatā yadi kalpyate । spaṣṭatāspaṣṭate syātām anyasyaiva na cātmanaḥ
units.translation: “If clarity of the agent and the rest is imagined as establishment, that clarity and its absence belong to something else, never to the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.140
units.deva: अद्रष्टुर् नैव चान्धस्य स्पष्टीभावो घटस्य तु । कर्त्रादेः स्पष्टतेष्टा चेद् द्रष्टृताध्यक्षकर्तृका
units.iast: adraṣṭur naiva cāndhasya spaṣṭībhāvo ghaṭasya tu । kartrādeḥ spaṣṭateṣṭā ced draṣṭṛtādhyakṣakartṛkā
units.translation: “A pot cannot become clear to one who does not see, who is blind. If the agent and the rest are made clear, they must be clear to a seer, the witness.”

units.label: Verse I.18.141
units.deva: अनुभूतेः किम् अन्तस्मिन् स्यात् तवापेक्षया वद । अनुभवितरीष्टा स्यात् सो ऽप्य् अनुभूतिर् एव नः
units.iast: anubhūteḥ kim antasmin syāt tavāpekṣayā vada । anubhavitarīṣṭā syāt so 'py anubhūtir eva naḥ
units.translation: “Tell me what further experience you expect. If an experiencer is required, for us that experiencer is itself experience.”

units.label: Verse I.18.142
units.deva: "अभिन्नो ऽपि हि बुद्ध्यात्मा विपर्यासितदर्शनैः । ग्राह्यग्राहकसंवित्तिभेदवान् इव लक्ष्यते"
units.iast: "abhinno 'pi hi buddhyātmā viparyāsitadarśanaiḥ । grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittibhedavān iva lakṣyate"
units.translation: “Though intellect and Self are not distinct, those whose vision is reversed perceive them as though divided into grasped object and grasper.”

units.label: Verse I.18.143
units.deva: [भूतिर् येषां क्रिया सैव कारकं सैव चोच्यते । ] सत्त्वं नाशित्वम् अस्याश् चेत् सकर्तृत्वं तथेष्यताम् । न कश्चिच् चेष्यते धर्म इति चेत् पक्षहानता
units.iast: [bhūtir yeṣāṃ kriyā saiva kārakaṃ saiva cocyate । ] sattvaṃ nāśitvam asyāś cet sakartṛtvaṃ tatheṣyatām । na kaścic ceṣyate dharma iti cet pakṣahānatā
units.translation: “[For those who hold that existence itself is an action and an instrument,] if existence is momentary, agency too must be admitted. If no property is accepted, that position loses its basis.”

units.label: Verse I.18.144
units.deva: नन्व् अस्तित्वादयो धर्मा नास्तित्वादिनिवृत्तयः । न भूतेस् तर्हि नाशित्वं स्वालक्षण्यं हि ते
units.iast: nanv astitvādayo dharmā nāstitvādinivṛttayaḥ । na bhūtes tarhi nāśitvaṃ svālakṣaṇyaṃ hi te
units.translation: “Existence and the rest are properties, and nonexistence and the rest are their absences. If so, destruction cannot be a property of existence; those are its own characteristics.”

units.label: Verse I.18.145
units.deva: स्वलक्षणावधिर् नाशो नाशो ऽनाशनिवृत्तिता । अगोर् असत्त्वं गोत्वं ते न तु तद् गोः स्वलक्षणम्
units.iast: svalakṣaṇāvadhir nāśo nāśo 'nāśanivṛttitā । agor asattvaṃ gotvaṃ te na tu tad goḥ svalakṣaṇam
units.translation: “Destruction is the limit of a thing’s own character; it is the ending of what does not last. A cow’s nonexistence is not its cowhood, which is its own characteristic.”

units.label: Verse I.18.146
units.deva: क्षणवाच्यो ऽपि यो ऽर्थः स्यात् सो ऽप्य् अन्याभाव एव ते । भेदाभावे ऽप्य् अभावस्य भेदो नामभिर् इष्यते
units.iast: kṣaṇavācyo 'pi yo 'rthaḥ syāt so 'py anyābhāva eva te । bhedābhāve 'py abhāvasya bhedo nāmabhir iṣyate
units.translation: “Even the thing called a moment is only the absence of something else; though absence is not different in itself, names make it seem divided.”

units.label: Verse I.18.147
units.deva: नामभेदैर् अनेकत्वम् एकस्य स्यात् कथं तव । अपोहो यदि भिन्नानां वृत्तिस् तस्य कथं गवि
units.iast: nāmabhedair anekatvam ekasya syāt kathaṃ tava । apoho yadi bhinnānāṃ vṛttis tasya kathaṃ gavi
units.translation: “How can differences of names make one thing many for you? If exclusion belongs to distinct things, how could that same process apply to the cow?”

units.label: Verse I.18.148
units.deva: नाभावा भेदकाः सर्वे विशेषा वा कदाचन । नामजात्यादयो यद्वत् संविदस् ते ऽविशेषतः
units.iast: nābhāvā bhedakāḥ sarve viśeṣā vā kadācana । nāmajātyādayo yadvat saṃvidas te 'viśeṣataḥ
units.translation: “Differences never arise from absence or from qualities; names, classes and the rest are no different from awareness itself.”

units.label: Verse I.18.149
units.deva: प्रत्यक्षम् अनुमानं वा व्यवहारे यदीच्छसि । क्रियाकारकभेदैस् तद् अभ्युपेयं ध्रुवं भवेत्
units.iast: pratyakṣam anumānaṃ vā vyavahāre yadīcchasi । kriyākārakabhedais tad abhyupeyaṃ dhruvaṃ bhavet
units.translation: “If you want perception or inference to operate in ordinary dealings, then agency and its factors must certainly be accepted.”

units.label: Verse I.18.150
units.deva: तस्मान् नीलं तथा पीतं घटादिर् वा विशेषणम् । संविदस् तद् उपेत्यं स्याद् येन चाप्य् अनुभूयते
units.iast: tasmān nīlaṃ tathā pītaṃ ghaṭādir vā viśeṣaṇam । saṃvidas tad upetyaṃ syād yena cāpy anubhūyate
units.translation: “Blue, yellow and a pot are attributes of awareness, which receives them and by which they are experienced.”

units.label: Verse I.18.151
units.deva: रूपादीनां यथान्यः स्याद् ग्राह्यत्वाद् ग्राहकस् तथा । प्रत्ययस्य तथान्यं स्याद् व्यञ्जकत्वाच् च दीपवत्
units.iast: rūpādīnāṃ yathānyaḥ syād grāhyatvād grāhakas tathā । pratyayasya tathānyaṃ syād vyañjakatvāc ca dīpavat
units.translation: “Just as forms and the rest are distinct from the receiver because they are objects, thoughts too are distinct from their revealer, like things lit by a lamp.”

units.label: Verse I.18.152
units.deva: अध्यक्षस्य दृशेः कीदृक् संबन्धः संभविष्यति । अध्यक्ष्येण तु दृश्येन मुक्त्वान्यो द्रष्टृदृश्यताम्
units.iast: adhyakṣasya dṛśeḥ kīdṛk saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati । adhyakṣyeṇa tu dṛśyena muktvānyo draṣṭṛdṛśyatām
units.translation: “What kind of relation can there be for the witness, awareness itself, other than being the Seer of what is seen?”

units.label: Verse I.18.153
units.deva: अध्यक्षेण कृता दृष्टिर् दृश्यं व्याप्नोत्य् अथापि वा । नित्याध्यक्षकृतः कश्चिद् उपकारो भवेद् धियाम्
units.iast: adhyakṣeṇa kṛtā dṛṣṭir dṛśyaṃ vyāpnoty athāpi vā । nityādhyakṣakṛtaḥ kaścid upakāro bhaved dhiyām
units.translation: “Does the witness produce seeing, which then pervades what is seen? What benefit could the intellect receive from the eternally present witness?”

units.label: Verse I.18.154
units.deva: स चोक्तस् तन्निभत्वं प्राक् संव्याप्तिश् च घटादिषु । यथालोकादिसंव्याप्तिर् व्यञ्जकत्वाद् धियस् तथा
units.iast: sa coktas tannibhatvaṃ prāk saṃvyāptiś ca ghaṭādiṣu । yathālokādisaṃvyāptir vyañjakatvād dhiyas tathā
units.translation: “That benefit was described earlier as taking its likeness and pervading objects such as pots, just as light pervades what it reveals.”

units.label: Verse I.18.155
units.deva: आलोकस्थो घटो यद्वद् बुद्ध्यारूढो भवेत् तथा । धीव्याप्तिः स्याद् घटारोहो धियो व्याप्तौ क्रमो भवेत्
units.iast: ālokastho ghaṭo yadvad buddhyārūḍho bhavet tathā । dhīvyāptiḥ syād ghaṭāroho dhiyo vyāptau kramo bhavet
units.translation: “A pot in the light becomes present to the intellect; when the intellect pervades the pot, the pot is known. Thus the intellect’s pervasion takes place in sequence.”

units.label: Verse I.18.156
units.deva: पूर्वं स्यात् प्रत्ययव्याप्तिस् ततो ऽनुग्रह आत्मनः । कृत्स्नाध्यक्षस्य सो ऽयुक्तः कालाकाशादिवत् क्रमः
units.iast: pūrvaṃ syāt pratyayavyāptis tato 'nugraha ātmanaḥ । kṛtsnādhyakṣasya so 'yuktaḥ kālākāśādivat kramaḥ
units.translation: “First the cognition pervades the object, then the Self is said to help it. Such a sequence is unreasonable for the witness, which is complete all at once, like time or space.”

units.label: Verse I.18.157
units.deva: विषयग्रहणं यस्य कारणापेक्षया भवेत् । सत्य् एव ग्राह्यशेषे च परिणामी स चित्तवत्
units.iast: viṣayagrahaṇaṃ yasya kāraṇāpekṣayā bhavet । saty eva grāhyaśeṣe ca pariṇāmī sa cittavat
units.translation: “For one whose grasp of an object depends on a cause, the remainder of the object must be real; then that one is changing, like the mind.”

units.label: Verse I.18.158
units.deva: अध्यक्षो ऽहम् इति ज्ञानं बुद्धेर् एव विनिश्चयः । नाध्यक्षस्याविशेषत्वान् न तस्यास्ति परो यतः
units.iast: adhyakṣo 'ham iti jñānaṃ buddher eva viniścayaḥ । nādhyakṣasyāviśeṣatvān na tasyāsti paro yataḥ
units.translation: “The cognition ‘I am the witness’ is a judgment of the intellect, not of the witness, since the witness is undivided and has nothing beyond it.”

units.label: Verse I.18.159
units.deva: कर्त्रा चेद् अहम् इत्य् एवम् अनुभूयेत मुक्तता । सुखदुःखविनिर्मोको नाहंकर्तरि युज्यते
units.iast: kartrā ced aham ity evam anubhūyeta muktatā । sukhaduḥkhavinirmoko nāhaṃkartari yujyate
units.translation: “If the agent had the experience ‘I am,’ that would be liberation; but freedom from pleasure and pain cannot belong to an agent.”

units.label: Verse I.18.160
units.deva: देहादाव् अभिमानोत्थो दुःखीति प्रत्ययो ध्रुवम् । कुण्डलिप्रत्ययो यद्वत् प्रत्यगात्माभिमानिना
units.iast: dehādāv abhimānottho duḥkhīti pratyayo dhruvam । kuṇḍalipratyayo yadvat pratyagātmābhimāninā
units.translation: “The thought ‘I suffer’ certainly arises from identifying with the body, as the thought ‘I am a coiled ornament’ arises from identifying with an object.”

units.label: Verse I.18.161
units.deva: बाध्यते प्रत्ययेनेह विवेकेनाविवेकवान् । विपर्यये ऽसदन्तं स्यात् प्रमाणस्याप्रमाणतः
units.iast: bādhyate pratyayeneha vivekenāvivekavān । viparyaye 'sadantaṃ syāt pramāṇasyāpramāṇataḥ
units.translation: “A discerning cognition sublates the deluded one here; otherwise the valid means of knowledge would end in unreality and cease to be valid.”

units.label: Verse I.18.162
units.deva: दाहच्छेदविनाशेषु दुःखित्वं नान्यथात्मनः । नैव ह्य् अन्यस्य दाहादाव् अन्यो दुःखी भवेत् क्वचित्
units.iast: dāhacchedavināśeṣu duḥkhitvaṃ nānyathātmanaḥ । naiva hy anyasya dāhādāv anyo duḥkhī bhavet kvacit
units.translation: “The Self does not suffer from burning, cutting or destruction; one person never becomes unhappy from another’s burning and the rest.”

units.label: Verse I.18.163
units.deva: अस्पर्शत्वाद् अदेहत्वान् नाहं दाह्यो यतः सदा । तस्मान् मिथ्याभिमानोत्थं मृते पुत्रे मृतिर् यथा
units.iast: asparśatvād adehatvān nāhaṃ dāhyo yataḥ sadā । tasmān mithyābhimānotthaṃ mṛte putre mṛtir yathā
units.translation: “Since I am bodiless and untouched, I am never burned. Suffering is born of false identification, like the grief of a father over a dead son.”

units.label: Verse I.18.164
units.deva: कुण्डल्य् अहम् इति ह्य् एतद् बाध्येतैव विवेकिना । दुःखीति प्रत्ययस् तद्वत् केवलाहंधिया सदा
units.iast: kuṇḍaly aham iti hy etad bādhyetaiva vivekinā । duḥkhīti pratyayas tadvat kevalāhaṃdhiyā sadā
units.translation: “A discerning person sublates the thought ‘I am a coiled ornament’; likewise the thought ‘I suffer’ is always sublated by the pure cognition ‘I.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.165
units.deva: सिद्धे सुःखित्व इष्टं स्यात् तच्चक्तित्वं सदात्मनः । मिथ्याभिमानतो दुःखी तेनार्थापादनक्षयः
units.iast: siddhe suḥkhitva iṣṭaṃ syāt taccaktitvaṃ sadātmanaḥ । mithyābhimānato duḥkhī tenārthāpādanakṣayaḥ
units.translation: “Happiness should be recognized as established, for the Self is always blissful. Suffering comes from false identification; this follows by implication.”

units.label: Verse I.18.166
units.deva: अस्पर्शो ऽपि यथा स्पर्शम् अचलश् चलनादि च । अविवेकात् तथा दुःखं मानसं चात्मनीक्षते
units.iast: asparśo 'pi yathā sparśam acalaś calanādi ca । avivekāt tathā duḥkhaṃ mānasaṃ cātmanīkṣate
units.translation: “As the untouched person imagines contact, and the unmoving person imagines motion, so through lack of discrimination one sees mental pain in the Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.167
units.deva: विवेकात्मधिया दुःखं नुद्यते चलनादिवत् । अविवेकस्वभावेन मनो गच्छत्य् अनिच्छतः
units.iast: vivekātmadhiyā duḥkhaṃ nudyate calanādivat । avivekasvabhāvena mano gacchaty anicchataḥ
units.translation: “Discriminating knowledge of the Self removes sorrow, as it removes imagined motion; the mind moves by its own nature, though one does not will it.”

units.label: Verse I.18.168
units.deva: तदानुदृश्यते दुःखं नैश्चल्ये नैव तस्य तत् । प्रत्यगात्मनि तस्मात् तद् दुःखं नैवोपपद्यते
units.iast: tadānudṛśyate duḥkhaṃ naiścalye naiva tasya tat । pratyagātmani tasmāt tad duḥkhaṃ naivopapadyate
units.translation: “When the mind is still, sorrow is no longer seen. It is not the Self’s own, and so sorrow cannot belong to the inward Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.169
units.deva: त्वंसतोस् तुल्यनीडत्वान् नीलाश्ववद् इदं भवेत् । निर्दुःखवाचिना योगात् त्वंशब्दस्य तदर्थता
units.iast: tvaṃsatos tulyanīḍatvān nīlāśvavad idaṃ bhavet । nirduḥkhavācinā yogāt tvaṃśabdasya tadarthatā
units.translation: “The meanings of ‘you’ and ‘that’ have the same ground, like ‘blue’ and ‘horse’; joined to the term for freedom from sorrow, ‘you’ signifies that reality.”

units.label: Verse I.18.170
units.deva: प्रत्यगात्माभिधानेन तच्छब्दस्य युतेस् तथा । दशमस् त्वम् असीत्य् एवं वाक्यं स्यात् प्रत्यगात्मनि
units.iast: pratyagātmābhidhānena tacchabdasya yutes tathā । daśamas tvam asīty evaṃ vākyaṃ syāt pratyagātmani
units.translation: “The word ‘that’ also fits the inward Self; as in ‘You are the tenth,’ the sentence is addressed to the innermost Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.171
units.deva: स्वार्थस्य ह्य् अप्रहाणेन विशिष्टार्थसमर्पकौ । प्रत्यगात्मावगत्यन्तौ नान्यो ऽर्थो ऽर्थाद् विरोध्य् अतः
units.iast: svārthasya hy aprahāṇena viśiṣṭārthasamarpakau । pratyagātmāvagatyantau nānyo 'rtho 'rthād virodhy ataḥ
units.translation: “Without giving up their own meanings, both words convey a qualified meaning ending in the knowledge of the inward Self; no other, conflicting meaning follows.”

units.label: Verse I.18.172
units.deva: नवबुद्ध्यपहाराद् धि स्वात्मानं दशपूरणम् । अपश्यञ् ज्ञातुम् एवेच्छेत् स्वम् आत्मानं जनस् तथा
units.iast: navabuddhyapahārād dhi svātmānaṃ daśapūraṇam । apaśyañ jñātum evecchet svam ātmānaṃ janas tathā
units.translation: “As a person who has lost count of the nine wishes to know himself as the tenth who completes the ten,”

units.label: Verse I.18.173
units.deva: अविद्याबद्धचक्षुष्ट्वात् कामापहृतधीः सदा । विविक्तं दृशिम् आत्मानं नेक्षते दशमं यथा
units.iast: avidyābaddhacakṣuṣṭvāt kāmāpahṛtadhīḥ sadā । viviktaṃ dṛśim ātmānaṃ nekṣate daśamaṃ yathā
units.translation: “so the eye bound by ignorance, its understanding stolen by desire, does not see the distinct Seer, the tenth.”

units.label: Verse I.18.174
units.deva: दशमस् त्वम् असीत्य् एवं तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्यतः । स्वम् आत्मानं विजानाति कृत्स्नान्तःकरणेक्षणम्
units.iast: daśamas tvam asīty evaṃ tattvamasyādivākyataḥ । svam ātmānaṃ vijānāti kṛtsnāntaḥkaraṇekṣaṇam
units.translation: “Through sentences such as ‘You are the tenth’ and ‘You are that,’ one knows one’s own Self, the witness of the whole inner instrument.”

units.label: Verse I.18.175
units.deva: इदं पूर्वम् इदं पश्चात् पदं वाक्ये भवेद् इति । नियमो नैव वेदे ऽस्ति पदसांगत्यम् अर्थतः
units.iast: idaṃ pūrvam idaṃ paścāt padaṃ vākye bhaved iti । niyamo naiva vede 'sti padasāṃgatyam arthataḥ
units.translation: “Scripture does not require that one word come before or after another; the words connect by their meaning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.176
units.deva: वाक्ये हि श्रूयमाणानां पदानाम् अर्थसंस्मृतिः । अन्वयव्यतिरेकाभ्यां ततो वाक्यार्थबोधनम्
units.iast: vākye hi śrūyamāṇānāṃ padānām arthasaṃsmṛtiḥ । anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tato vākyārthabodhanam
units.translation: “The words heard in a sentence bring their meanings to mind; through agreement and difference the sentence meaning is then understood.”

units.label: Verse I.18.177
units.deva: यदा नित्येषु वाक्येषु पदार्थस् तु विविच्यते । वाक्यार्थज्ञानसंक्रान्त्यै तदा प्रश्नो न युज्यते
units.iast: yadā nityeṣu vākyeṣu padārthas tu vivicyate । vākyārthajñānasaṃkrāntyai tadā praśno na yujyate
units.translation: “When the meaning of words in eternal sentences has been distinguished, no further question is needed for the sentence meaning to become clear.”

units.label: Verse I.18.178
units.deva: अन्वयव्यतिरेकोक्तिः पदार्थस्मरणाय तु । स्मृत्यभावे न वाक्यार्थो ज्ञातुं शक्यो बि केनचित्
units.iast: anvayavyatirekoktiḥ padārthasmaraṇāya tu । smṛtyabhāve na vākyārtho jñātuṃ śakyo bi kenacit
units.translation: “Agreement and difference are taught so that the word meanings may be remembered; without memory, no one can understand the sentence.”

units.label: Verse I.18.179
units.deva: तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्येषु त्वंपदार्थाविवेकतः । व्यज्यते नैव वाक्यार्थो नित्यमुक्तो ऽहम् इत्य् अतः
units.iast: tattvamasyādivākyeṣu tvaṃpadārthāvivekataḥ । vyajyate naiva vākyārtho nityamukto 'ham ity ataḥ
units.translation: “In sentences such as ‘you are that,’ if the meaning of ‘you’ is not distinguished, the sentence meaning does not shine; therefore one cannot know ‘I am ever free.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.180
units.deva: अन्वयव्यतिरेकोक्तिस् तद्विवेकाय नान्यथा । त्वंपदार्थविवेके हि पाणाव् अर्पितविल्ववत्
units.iast: anvayavyatirekoktis tadvivekāya nānyathā । tvaṃpadārthaviveke hi pāṇāv arpitavilvavat
units.translation: “Agreement and difference are stated for that discrimination alone. Once the meaning of ‘you’ is distinguished, the sentence meaning is clear, like a fruit placed in the palm.”

units.label: Verse I.18.181
units.deva: वाक्यार्थो व्यज्यते चैवं केवलो ऽहंपदार्थतः । दुःखीत्य् एतदपोहेन प्रत्यगात्मविनिश्चयात्
units.iast: vākyārtho vyajyate caivaṃ kevalo 'haṃpadārthataḥ । duḥkhīty etadapohena pratyagātmaviniścayāt
units.translation: “In this way the sentence meaning is revealed as the pure meaning of ‘I,’ when ‘I am suffering’ is set aside and the inward Self is understood with certainty.”

units.label: Verse I.18.182
units.deva: तत्रैवं संभवत्य् अर्थे श्रुतहानाश्रुतार्थधीः । नैवं कल्पयितुं युक्ता पदवाक्यार्थकोविदैः
units.iast: tatraivaṃ saṃbhavaty arthe śrutahānāśrutārthadhīḥ । naivaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktā padavākyārthakovidaiḥ
units.translation: “When the meaning is possible in this way, experts in words and sentences should not invent a loss of what was heard and knowledge of what was never heard.”

units.label: Verse I.18.183
units.deva: प्रत्यक्षादीनि बाधेरन् कृष्णलादिषु पाकवत् । अक्षजादिनिभैर् एतैः कथं स्याद् वाक्यबाधनम्
units.iast: pratyakṣādīni bādheran kṛṣṇalādiṣu pākavat । akṣajādinibhair etaiḥ kathaṃ syād vākyabādhanam
units.translation: “Perception and the rest may be stronger in cases such as cooking black gram; but how could means resembling the senses sublate a scriptural sentence?”

units.label: Verse I.18.184
units.deva: दुःख्य् अस्मीति सति ज्ञाने निर्दुःखीति न जायते । प्रत्यक्षादिनिभत्वे ऽपि वाक्यान् न व्यभिचारतः
units.iast: duḥkhy asmīti sati jñāne nirduḥkhīti na jāyate । pratyakṣādinibhatve 'pi vākyān na vyabhicārataḥ
units.translation: “While the thought ‘I am suffering’ is present, the thought ‘I am free from suffering’ does not arise; yet the scriptural sentence does not err, even if it seems like perception.”

units.label: Verse I.18.185
units.deva: स्वप्ने दुःख्य् अहम् अद्यासं दाहच्छेदादिहेतुतः । तत्कालभाविभिर् वाक्यैर् न बाधः क्रियते यदि
units.iast: svapne duḥkhy aham adyāsaṃ dāhacchedādihetutaḥ । tatkālabhāvibhir vākyair na bādhaḥ kriyate yadi
units.translation: “In a dream I suffered today from burning, cutting and other causes; if a sentence heard at that time did not sublate it—”

units.label: Verse I.18.186
units.deva: समाप्तेस् तर्हि दुःखस्य प्राक् च तद्बाध इष्यताम् । न हि दुःखस्य संतानो भ्रान्तेर् वा दृश्यते क्वचित्
units.iast: samāptes tarhi duḥkhasya prāk ca tadbādha iṣyatām । na hi duḥkhasya saṃtāno bhrānter vā dṛśyate kvacit
units.translation: “—then one should accept that the sublation occurs only once suffering has ended. But no continuous stream of suffering or delusion is ever seen.”

units.label: Verse I.18.187
units.deva: प्रत्यगात्मन आत्मत्वं दुःख्य् अस्मीत्य् अस्य बाधया । दशमं नवम् अस्येव वेद चेद् अविरुद्धता
units.iast: pratyagātmana ātmatvaṃ duḥkhy asmīty asya bādhayā । daśamaṃ navam asyeva veda ced aviruddhatā
units.translation: “If one knows the inward Self by sublating ‘I suffer,’ as the tenth is known after mistaking the count of nine, there is no contradiction.”

units.label: Verse I.18.188
units.deva: नित्यमुक्तत्वविज्ञानं वाक्याद् भवति नान्यतः । वाक्यार्थस्यापि विज्ञानं पदार्थस्मृतिपूर्वकम्
units.iast: nityamuktatvavijñānaṃ vākyād bhavati nānyataḥ । vākyārthasyāpi vijñānaṃ padārthasmṛtipūrvakam
units.translation: “Knowledge of being ever-free comes from the sentence, not elsewhere; understanding the sentence meaning, too, is preceded by recalling the word meanings.”

units.label: Verse I.18.189
units.deva: अन्वयव्यतिरेकाभ्यां पदार्थः स्मर्यते ध्रुवम् । एवं निर्दुःखम् आत्मानम् अक्रियं प्रतिपद्यते
units.iast: anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ padārthaḥ smaryate dhruvam । evaṃ nirduḥkham ātmānam akriyaṃ pratipadyate
units.translation: “Through agreement and difference the word meanings are surely recalled; in this way one knows the Self as free from sorrow and action.”

units.label: Verse I.18.190
units.deva: सद् एवेत्यादिवाक्येभ्यः प्रमा स्फुटतरा भवेत् । दशमस् त्वम् असीत्य् अस्माद् यथैवं प्रत्यगात्मनि
units.iast: sad evetyādivākyebhyaḥ pramā sphuṭatarā bhavet । daśamas tvam asīty asmād yathaivaṃ pratyagātmani
units.translation: “From sentences such as ‘Being alone was this,’ knowledge becomes clear, just as from ‘You are the tenth’; so too regarding the inward Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.191
units.deva: प्रबोधेन यथा स्वाप्नं सर्वं दुःखं निवर्तते । प्रत्यगात्मधिया तद्वद् दुःखित्वं सर्वदात्मनः
units.iast: prabodhena yathā svāpnaṃ sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivartate । pratyagātmadhiyā tadvad duḥkhitvaṃ sarvadātmanaḥ
units.translation: “As waking ends all the suffering of a dream, so knowledge of the inward Self ends the Self’s imagined suffering.”

units.label: Verse I.18.192
units.deva: कृष्णलादौ प्रमाजन्म तदन्यार्थामृदुत्वतः । तत्त्वमस्यादिवाक्येषु न त्व् एवम् अविरोधतः
units.iast: kṛṣṇalādau pramājanma tadanyārthāmṛdutvataḥ । tattvamasyādivākyeṣu na tv evam avirodhataḥ
units.translation: “A valid cognition arises from properties such as the softness of a black gram; the sentence ‘you are that’ is not like this, since no such conflict is involved.”

units.label: Verse I.18.193
units.deva: वाक्ये तत् त्वम् असीत्य् अस्मिञ् ज्ञातार्थं तदसिद्वयम् । त्वमर्थस्मृत्यसाहाय्याद् वाक्यं नोत्पादयेत् प्रमाम्
units.iast: vākye tat tvam asīty asmiñ jñātārthaṃ tadasidvayam । tvamarthasmṛtyasāhāyyād vākyaṃ notpādayet pramām
units.translation: “If the meaning of ‘you’ is not recalled, the sentence ‘you are that’ cannot produce valid knowledge of its meaning.”

units.label: Verse I.18.194
units.deva: तत्त्वमोस् तुल्यनीडार्थम् असीत्य् एतत् पदं भवेत् । तच्छब्दः प्रत्यगात्मार्थस् तच्छब्दार्थस् त्वमस् तथा
units.iast: tattvamos tulyanīḍārtham asīty etat padaṃ bhavet । tacchabdaḥ pratyagātmārthas tacchabdārthas tvamas tathā
units.translation: “The word ‘are’ joins meanings with the same ground: ‘that’ means the inward Self, and ‘you’ means that same reality.”

units.label: Verse I.18.195
units.deva: दुःखित्वाप्रत्यगात्मत्वं वारयेताम् उभाव् अपि । एवं च नेतिनेत्यर्थं गमयेतां परस्परम्
units.iast: duḥkhitvāpratyagātmatvaṃ vārayetām ubhāv api । evaṃ ca netinetyarthaṃ gamayetāṃ parasparam
units.translation: “Both words remove the notions of suffering and of being other than the inward Self; thus each leads the other to the meaning of ‘not this, not this.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.196
units.deva: एवं तत् त्वम् असीत्य् अस्य गम्यमाने फले कथम् । अप्रमाणत्वम् अस्योक्त्वा क्रियापेक्षत्वम् उच्यते
units.iast: evaṃ tat tvam asīty asya gamyamāne phale katham । apramāṇatvam asyoktvā kriyāpekṣatvam ucyate
units.translation: “When the result is understood from the sentence ‘you are that,’ how can it be invalid and depend on an action?”

units.label: Verse I.18.197
units.deva: तस्माद् आद्यन्तमध्येषु कुर्व् इत्य् एतद् विरोध्य् अतः । न कल्प्यम् अश्रुतत्वाच् च श्रुतत्यागो ऽप्य् अनर्थकः
units.iast: tasmād ādyantamadhyeṣu kurv ity etad virodhy ataḥ । na kalpyam aśrutatvāc ca śrutatyāgo 'py anarthakaḥ
units.translation: “Do not imagine an injunction to act at the beginning, middle or end: it is not heard, and abandoning what is heard would be pointless.”

units.label: Verse I.18.198
units.deva: यथानुभूयते तृप्तिर् भुजेर् वाक्यान् न गम्यते । वाक्यस्य विधृतिस् तद्वद् गोशकृत्पायसीक्रिया
units.iast: yathānubhūyate tṛptir bhujer vākyān na gamyate । vākyasya vidhṛtis tadvad gośakṛtpāyasīkriyā
units.translation: “Satisfaction is not understood from the sentence ‘eat’; it is known through eating. In the same way, the sentence’s force is held to be an action that transforms cow dung into milk.”

units.label: Verse I.18.199
units.deva: सत्यम् एवम् अनात्मार्थे वाक्यात् पारोक्ष्यबोधनम् । प्रत्यगात्मनि न त्व् एवं संख्याप्राप्तिवद् अध्रुवम्
units.iast: satyam evam anātmārthe vākyāt pārokṣyabodhanam । pratyagātmani na tv evaṃ saṃkhyāprāptivad adhruvam
units.translation: “It is true that a sentence gives indirect knowledge of things other than the Self; but the inward Self is not so, as in the uncertain count of the tenth person.”

units.label: Verse I.18.200
units.deva: स्वसंवेद्यत्वपर्यायः । स्वप्रमाणक इष्यताम् । निवृत्ताव् अहमः सिद्धः स्वात्मनो ऽनुभवश् च नः
units.iast: svasaṃvedyatvaparyāyaḥ । svapramāṇaka iṣyatām । nivṛttāv ahamaḥ siddhaḥ svātmano 'nubhavaś ca naḥ
units.translation: “Let it be accepted that the Self is self-evident and has its own proof; when the ego is removed, the experience of one’s own Self is established.”

units.label: Verse I.18.201
units.deva: बुद्धीनां विषयो दुःखं ता यस्य विषया मताः । कुतो ऽस्य दुःखसंबन्धो दृशेः स्यात् प्रत्यगात्मनः
units.iast: buddhīnāṃ viṣayo duḥkhaṃ tā yasya viṣayā matāḥ । kuto 'sya duḥkhasaṃbandho dṛśeḥ syāt pratyagātmanaḥ
units.translation: “Sorrow is an object of the intellect. If the intellect’s objects are another’s, how could sorrow be related to the inward Seer, the Self?”

units.label: Verse I.18.202
units.deva: दृशिर् एवानुभूयेत स्वेनैवानुभवात्मना । तदाभासतया जन्म धियो ऽस्यानुभवः स्मृतः
units.iast: dṛśir evānubhūyeta svenaivānubhavātmanā । tadābhāsatayā janma dhiyo 'syānubhavaḥ smṛtaḥ
units.translation: “Awareness is experienced by itself, through its own nature; the intellect arises as its reflection, and that is called experience.”

units.label: Verse I.18.203
units.deva: अशनायादिनिर्मुक्तः सिद्धो मोक्षस् त्वम् एव सः । श्रोतव्यादि तवेत्य् एतद् विरुद्धं कथम् उच्यते
units.iast: aśanāyādinirmuktaḥ siddho mokṣas tvam eva saḥ । śrotavyādi tavety etad viruddhaṃ katham ucyate
units.translation: “You yourself are liberation, established and free from hunger and the rest. How, then, can scripture contradict this by saying you must hear and the rest?”

units.label: Verse I.18.204
units.deva: सेत्स्यतीत्य् एव चेत् तत् स्याच् छ्रवणादि तदा भवेत् । मोक्षस्यानित्यतैवं स्याद् विरोध्य् एवान्यथा वचः
units.iast: setsyatīty eva cet tat syāc chravaṇādi tadā bhavet । mokṣasyānityataivaṃ syād virodhy evānyathā vacaḥ
units.translation: “If liberation were attained through hearing, then it would be produced and impermanent; otherwise the sentence would contradict itself.”

units.label: Verse I.18.205
units.deva: श्रोतृश्रोतव्ययोर् भेदो यदीष्टः स्याद् भवेद् इदम् । इष्टार्थकोप एवं स्यान् न युक्तं सर्वथा वचः
units.iast: śrotṛśrotavyayor bhedo yadīṣṭaḥ syād bhaved idam । iṣṭārthakopa evaṃ syān na yuktaṃ sarvathā vacaḥ
units.translation: “If hearer and what is heard are distinct, this argument would stand; but that contradicts the very meaning one wants, so the statement is wholly unreasonable.”

units.label: Verse I.18.206
units.deva: सिद्धो मोक्षो ऽहम् इत्य् एवं ज्ञात्वात्मानं भवेद् यदि । चिकीर्षुर् यः स मूढात्मा शास्त्रं चोद्घाटयत्य् अपि
units.iast: siddho mokṣo 'ham ity evaṃ jñātvātmānaṃ bhaved yadi । cikīrṣur yaḥ sa mūḍhātmā śāstraṃ codghāṭayaty api
units.translation: “One who knows ‘I am already liberated’ yet wants to do something is deluded and contradicts scripture.”

units.label: Verse I.18.207
units.deva: न हि सिद्धस्य कर्तव्यं सकार्यस्य न सिद्धता । उभयालम्बनं कुर्वन्न् आत्मानं वञ्चयत्य् असौ
units.iast: na hi siddhasya kartavyaṃ sakāryasya na siddhatā । ubhayālambanaṃ kurvann ātmānaṃ vañcayaty asau
units.translation: “There is nothing to do for what is already accomplished; if one accepts both as true, one deceives oneself.”

units.label: Verse I.18.208
units.deva: सिद्धो मोक्षस् त्वम् इत्य् एतद् वस्तुमात्रं प्रदर्श्यते । श्रोतुस् तथात्वविज्ञाने प्रवृत्तिः स्यात् कथं त्व् इति
units.iast: siddho mokṣas tvam ity etad vastumātraṃ pradarśyate । śrotus tathātvavijñāne pravṛttiḥ syāt kathaṃ tv iti
units.translation: “The sentence ‘You are liberation’ merely shows what already exists. Why should the listener then be driven to understand that this is so?”

units.label: Verse I.18.209
units.deva: कर्ता दुःख्य् अहम् अस्मीति प्रत्यक्षेणानुभूयते । कर्ता दुःखी च मा भूवम् इति यत्नो भवेत् ततः
units.iast: kartā duḥkhy aham asmīti pratyakṣeṇānubhūyate । kartā duḥkhī ca mā bhūvam iti yatno bhavet tataḥ
units.translation: “One directly experiences ‘I am the doer; I suffer.’ Therefore one strives: ‘May I no longer be the doer or suffer.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.210
units.deva: तद्विज्ञानाय युक्त्यादि कर्तव्यं श्रुतिर् अब्रवीत् । कर्तृत्वाद्यनुवादेन सिद्धत्वानुभवाय तु
units.iast: tadvijñānāya yuktyādi kartavyaṃ śrutir abravīt । kartṛtvādyanuvādena siddhatvānubhavāya tu
units.translation: “Scripture says reasoning and the rest should be done for this understanding; it restates agency and the rest in order to let one experience what is already accomplished.”

units.label: Verse I.18.211
units.deva: निर्दुःखो निष्क्रियो ऽकामः सिद्धो मोक्षो ऽहम् इत्य् अपि । गृहीत्वैव विरुद्धार्थम् आदध्यात् कथम् एव सः
units.iast: nirduḥkho niṣkriyo 'kāmaḥ siddho mokṣo 'ham ity api । gṛhītvaiva viruddhārtham ādadhyāt katham eva saḥ
units.translation: “How could one, at the same time, accept the contradictory meaning ‘I am free from sorrow, action and desire; liberation is already accomplished’?”

units.label: Verse I.18.212
units.deva: सकामः सक्रियो ऽसिद्ध इति मे ऽनुभवः कथम् । अतो मे विपरीतस्य तद् भवान् वक्तुम् अर्हति
units.iast: sakāmaḥ sakriyo 'siddha iti me 'nubhavaḥ katham । ato me viparītasya tad bhavān vaktum arhati
units.translation: “My experience is ‘I desire, I act, I am not free.’ You should explain to me the opposite of what I experience.”

units.label: Verse I.18.213
units.deva: इहैव घटते प्रश्नो न मुक्तत्वानुभूतये । प्रमाणेन विरोधी यः सो ऽत्रार्थः प्रश्नम् अर्हति
units.iast: ihaiva ghaṭate praśno na muktatvānubhūtaye । pramāṇena virodhī yaḥ so 'trārthaḥ praśnam arhati
units.translation: “The question arises here only about this life, not about the experience of being free; whatever conflicts with a means of knowledge is what calls for a question.”

units.label: Verse I.18.214
units.deva: अहं निर्मुक्त इत्य् एष सद् असीत्य् अन्यमानजः । प्रत्यक्षाभासजन्यत्वाद् दुःखित्वं प्रश्नम् अर्हति
units.iast: ahaṃ nirmukta ity eṣa sad asīty anyamānajaḥ । pratyakṣābhāsajanyatvād duḥkhitvaṃ praśnam arhati
units.translation: “The thought ‘I am free’ arises from ‘you are Being,’ a means other than perception; suffering deserves a question because it arises from something that resembles perception.”

units.label: Verse I.18.215
units.deva: पृष्टम् आकाङ्क्षितं वाच्यं दुःखाभावम् अभीप्सितम् । कथं हीदं निवर्तेत दुःखं सर्वात्मना मम
units.iast: pṛṣṭam ākāṅkṣitaṃ vācyaṃ duḥkhābhāvam abhīpsitam । kathaṃ hīdaṃ nivarteta duḥkhaṃ sarvātmanā mama
units.translation: The questioner’s desired answer should be given: the absence of suffering. “How can this suffering of mine cease entirely?”

units.label: Verse I.18.216
units.deva: इति प्रश्नानुरूपं यद् वाच्यं दुःखनिवर्तकम् । श्रुतेः स्वात्मनि नाशङ्का प्रामाण्ये सति विद्यते
units.iast: iti praśnānurūpaṃ yad vācyaṃ duḥkhanivartakam । śruteḥ svātmani nāśaṅkā prāmāṇye sati vidyate
units.translation: “The answer to this question removes suffering; once scripture is accepted as valid, there is no doubt about one’s own Self.”

units.label: Verse I.18.217
units.deva: तस्माद् आत्मविमुक्तत्वं प्रत्याययति तद्वचः । वक्तव्यं तु तथार्थं स्याद् विरोधे ऽसति केनचित्
units.iast: tasmād ātmavimuktatvaṃ pratyāyayati tadvacaḥ । vaktavyaṃ tu tathārthaṃ syād virodhe 'sati kenacit
units.translation: “Therefore that sentence teaches the Self to be free. Its meaning should be explained in a way that meets the question, without contradiction.”

units.label: Verse I.18.218
units.deva: इतो ऽन्यो ऽनुभवः कश्चिद् आत्मनो नोपपद्यते । अविज्ञातं विजानतां विज्ञातारम् इति श्रुतेः
units.iast: ito 'nyo 'nubhavaḥ kaścid ātmano nopapadyate । avijñātaṃ vijānatāṃ vijñātāram iti śruteḥ
units.translation: “No other experience of the Self is possible, for scripture says: ‘It is unknown to those who think they know it, and known to those who do not know it.’”

units.label: Verse I.18.219
units.deva: त्वंपदार्थविवेकाय संन्यासः सर्वकर्मणाम् । साधनत्वं व्रजत्य् एव शान्तो दान्तादिशासनात्
units.iast: tvaṃpadārthavivekāya saṃnyāsaḥ sarvakarmaṇām । sādhanatvaṃ vrajaty eva śānto dāntādiśāsanāt
units.translation: “Renunciation of all actions becomes a means to distinguish the meaning of ‘you,’ as taught through calm, restraint and the rest.”

units.label: Verse I.18.220
units.deva: त्वमर्थं प्रत्यगात्मानं पश्येद् आत्मानम् आत्मनि । वाक्यार्थं तत आत्मानं सर्वं पश्यति केवलम्
units.iast: tvamarthaṃ pratyagātmānaṃ paśyed ātmānam ātmani । vākyārthaṃ tata ātmānaṃ sarvaṃ paśyati kevalam
units.translation: “One should see the inward Self, the meaning of ‘you,’ within oneself; then, through the sentence meaning, one sees the Self as all, alone.”

units.label: Verse I.18.221
units.deva: सर्वम् आत्मेति वाक्यार्थे विज्ञाते ऽस्य प्रमाणतः । असत्त्वे ह्य् अन्यमानस्य विधिस् तं योजयेत् कथम्
units.iast: sarvam ātmeti vākyārthe vijñāte 'sya pramāṇataḥ । asattve hy anyamānasya vidhis taṃ yojayet katham
units.translation: “Once the means of knowledge has shown that everything is the Self, how could an injunction join it to something else that is unreal?”

units.label: Verse I.18.222
units.deva: तस्माद् वाक्यार्थविज्ञानान् नोर्ध्वं कर्मविधिर् भवेत् । न हि ब्रह्मास्मि कर्तेति विरुद्धे भवतो धियौ
units.iast: tasmād vākyārthavijñānān nordhvaṃ karmavidhir bhavet । na hi brahmāsmi karteti viruddhe bhavato dhiyau
units.translation: “After understanding the sentence meaning there can be no further injunction to action; ‘I am Brahman’ and ‘I am the doer’ are contradictory thoughts.”

units.label: Verse I.18.223
units.deva: ब्रह्मास्मीति हि विद्येयं नैव कर्तेति बाध्यते । सकामो बद्ध इत्य् एवं प्रमाणाभासजातया
units.iast: brahmāsmīti hi vidyeyaṃ naiva karteti bādhyate । sakāmo baddha ity evaṃ pramāṇābhāsajātayā
units.translation: “The knowledge ‘I am Brahman’ is not sublated by the false notion ‘I am a doer, desiring and bound,’ which arises from an apparent means of knowledge.”

units.label: Verse I.18.224
units.deva: शास्त्राद् ब्रह्मास्मि नान्यो ऽहम् इति बुद्धिर् भवेद् दृढा । यदायुक्ता तदैवं धीर् यथा देहात्मधीर् इति
units.iast: śāstrād brahmāsmi nānyo 'ham iti buddhir bhaved dṛḍhā । yadāyuktā tadaivaṃ dhīr yathā dehātmadhīr iti
units.translation: “From scripture the firm knowledge ‘I am Brahman; I am no other’ arises; when it becomes as strong as the body-identity, this conviction is established.”

units.label: Verse I.18.225
units.deva: सभयाद् अभयं प्राप्तस् तदर्थं यतते च यः । स पुनः सभयं गन्तुं स्वतन्त्रश् चेन् न हीच्छति
units.iast: sabhayād abhayaṃ prāptas tadarthaṃ yatate ca yaḥ । sa punaḥ sabhayaṃ gantuṃ svatantraś cen na hīcchati
units.translation: “One who has reached safety from fear and strives for it again would not freely choose to return to fear.”

units.label: Verse I.18.226
units.deva: यथेष्टाचरणप्राप्तिः संन्यासादिविधौ कुतः । पदार्थाज्ञानबुद्धस्य वाक्यार्थानुभवार्थिनः
units.iast: yatheṣṭācaraṇaprāptiḥ saṃnyāsādividhau kutaḥ । padārthājñānabuddhasya vākyārthānubhavārthinaḥ
units.translation: “Why prescribe renunciation and the rest for one who is confused about the word meanings and seeks to experience the meaning of the sentence?”

units.label: Verse I.18.227
units.deva: अतः सर्वम् इदं सिद्धं यत् प्राग् अस्माभिर् ईरितम्
units.iast: ataḥ sarvam idaṃ siddhaṃ yat prāg asmābhir īritam
units.translation: Thus everything explained earlier is established.

units.label: Verse I.18.228
units.deva: यो हि यस्माद् विरक्तः स्यान् नासौ तस्मै प्रवर्तते । लोकत्रयाद् विरक्तत्वान् मुमुक्षुः किम् इतीहते
units.iast: yo hi yasmād viraktaḥ syān nāsau tasmai pravartate । lokatrayād viraktatvān mumukṣuḥ kim itīhate
units.translation: “One who has become dispassionate toward a thing does not pursue it. Dispassionate toward all three worlds, what would a seeker of liberation strive for here?”

units.label: Verse I.18.229
units.deva: क्षुधया पीड्यमानो ऽपि न विषं ह्य् अत्तुम् इच्छति । मिष्टान्नध्वस्ततृड् जानन् नामूढस् तज् जिघत्सति
units.iast: kṣudhayā pīḍyamāno 'pi na viṣaṃ hy attum icchati । miṣṭānnadhvastatṛḍ jānan nāmūḍhas taj jighatsati
units.translation: “Even when tormented by hunger, a person does not wish to eat poison; one who knows that sweet food ends thirst, and is not deluded, longs for that.”

units.label: Verse I.18.230
units.deva: वेदान्तवाक्यपुष्पेभ्यो ज्ञानामृतमधूत्तमम् । उज्जहारालिवद् यो नस् तस्मै सद्गुरवे नमः
units.iast: vedāntavākyapuṣpebhyo jñānāmṛtamadhūttamam । ujjahārālivad yo nas tasmai sadgurave namaḥ
units.translation: Salutations to the true teacher, who, like a bee gathering nectar from flowers, drew the finest honey of the nectar of knowledge from the blossoms of Vedānta.

units.label: Verse I.19.1
units.deva: प्रयुज्य तृष्णाज्वरनाशकारणं चिकित्सितं ज्ञानविरागभेषजम् । न याति कामज्वरसन्निपातजां शरीरमालाशतयोगदुःखिताम्
units.iast: prayujya tṛṣṇājvaranāśakāraṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ jñānavirāgabheṣajam । na yāti kāmajvarasannipātajāṃ śarīramālāśatayogaduḥkhitām
units.translation: “Having taken the medicine that destroys the fever of craving—the remedies of knowledge and dispassion—one does not fall into the misery of countless bodies caused by the fever of desire.”

units.label: Verse I.19.2
units.deva: अहं ममेति त्वम् अनर्थम् ईहसे परार्थम् इच्छन्ति तवान्य ईहितम् । न ते ऽर्थबोधो न हि मे ऽस्ति चार्थिता ततश् च युक्तः शम एव ते मनः
units.iast: ahaṃ mameti tvam anartham īhase parārtham icchanti tavānya īhitam । na te 'rthabodho na hi me 'sti cārthitā tataś ca yuktaḥ śama eva te manaḥ
units.translation: “You strive after the worthless thoughts ‘I’ and ‘mine’; others want your efforts for their own purposes. You do not understand the goal, and I have no desire; therefore, mind, calming you is fitting.”

units.label: Verse I.19.3
units.deva: यतो न चान्यः परमात् सनातनात् सदैव तृप्तो ऽहम् अतो न मे ऽर्थिता । सदैव मुक्तश् च न कामये हितं यतस्व चेतः प्रशमाय ते ऽधिकम्
units.iast: yato na cānyaḥ paramāt sanātanāt sadaiva tṛpto 'ham ato na me 'rthitā । sadaiva muktaś ca na kāmaye hitaṃ yatasva cetaḥ praśamāya te 'dhikam
units.translation: “Since I am always fulfilled and there is none other than the eternal Supreme, I have no desire. I am ever free and seek no benefit; mind, strive to become even more peaceful.”

units.label: Verse I.19.4
units.deva: षडूर्मिमालाभ्यतिवृत्त एव यः स एव चात्मा जगतश् च नः श्रुतेः । प्रमाणतश् चापि मया प्रवेद्यते मुधैव तस्माच् च मनस् तवेहितम्
units.iast: ṣaḍūrmimālābhyativṛtta eva yaḥ sa eva cātmā jagataś ca naḥ śruteḥ । pramāṇataś cāpi mayā pravedyate mudhaiva tasmāc ca manas tavehitam
units.translation: “I alone am beyond the six waves of change, the Self of the world, as scripture teaches and valid knowledge establishes. Your effort, mind, is in vain.”

units.label: Verse I.19.5
units.deva: त्वयि प्रशान्ते न हि सास्ति भेदधीर् यतो जगन् मोहम् उपैति मायया । ग्रहो हि मायाप्रभवस्य कारणं ग्रहाद् विमोके न हि सास्ति कस्यचित्
units.iast: tvayi praśānte na hi sāsti bhedadhīr yato jagan moham upaiti māyayā । graho hi māyāprabhavasya kāraṇaṃ grahād vimoke na hi sāsti kasyacit
units.translation: “When you are quiet, mind, the cognition of difference does not exist; through māyā the world is deluded. Grasping is the cause of what māyā produces; when grasping is released, none remains.”

units.label: Verse I.19.6
units.deva: न मे ऽस्ति मोहस् तव चेष्टितेन हि प्रबुद्धतत्त्वस् त्व् असितो ह्य् अविक्रियः । न पूर्वतत्त्वोत्तरभेदता हि नो वृथैव तस्माच् च मनस् तवेहितम्
units.iast: na me 'sti mohas tava ceṣṭitena hi prabuddhatattvas tv asito hy avikriyaḥ । na pūrvatattvottarabhedatā hi no vṛthaiva tasmāc ca manas tavehitam
units.translation: “There is no delusion in me because of what you do, mind; I am awake to reality, stainless and changeless. There is no before-and-after difference in us, so your effort is futile.”

units.label: Verse I.19.7
units.deva: यतश् च नित्यो ऽहम् अतो न चान्यथा विकारयोगे हि भवेद् अनित्यता । सदा प्रभातो ऽहम् अतो हि चाद्वयो विकल्पितं चाप्य् असद् इत्य् अवस्थितम्
units.iast: yataś ca nityo 'ham ato na cānyathā vikārayoge hi bhaved anityatā । sadā prabhāto 'ham ato hi cādvayo vikalpitaṃ cāpy asad ity avasthitam
units.translation: “I am eternal, never otherwise, for change would make me impermanent. I am always shining and nondual; what is imagined is established as unreal.”

units.label: Verse I.19.8
units.deva: अभावरूपं त्वम् असीह हे मनो निरीक्ष्यमाणे न हि युक्तितो ऽस्तिता । सतो ह्य् अनाशाद् असतो ऽप्य् अजन्मतो द्वयं च ते ऽतस् तव नास्तितेष्यते
units.iast: abhāvarūpaṃ tvam asīha he mano nirīkṣyamāṇe na hi yuktito 'stitā । sato hy anāśād asato 'py ajanmato dvayaṃ ca te 'tas tava nāstiteṣyate
units.translation: “You, mind, are held to be of the nature of nonexistence; on examination, there is no reason to say you exist. Being never perishes and nonbeing is never born, so neither is your existence established.”

units.label: Verse I.19.9
units.deva: द्रष्टा च दृश्यं च तथा च दर्शनं भ्रमः स सर्वस् तव कल्पितो हि सः । दृशेश् च भिन्नं न हि दृश्यम् ईक्ष्यते स्वपन् विबोधे च तथा न भिद्यते
units.iast: draṣṭā ca dṛśyaṃ ca tathā ca darśanaṃ bhramaḥ sa sarvas tava kalpito hi saḥ । dṛśeś ca bhinnaṃ na hi dṛśyam īkṣyate svapan vibodhe ca tathā na bhidyate
units.translation: “Seer, seen and seeing are all delusion, imagined by you. The seen is never different from seeing; as in dream, so in waking, they are not separate.”

units.label: Verse I.19.10
units.deva: विकल्पना चापि तथाद्वया भवेद् अवस्तुयोगात् तद् अलातचक्रवत् । न शक्तिभेदो ऽस्ति यतो न चात्मनां ततो ऽद्वयत्वं श्रुतितो ऽवसीयते
units.iast: vikalpanā cāpi tathādvayā bhaved avastuyogāt tad alātacakravat । na śaktibhedo 'sti yato na cātmanāṃ tato 'dvayatvaṃ śrutito 'vasīyate
units.translation: “Imagination too is nondual, since it is associated with what is unreal, like a circle made by a whirling firebrand. Since there is no division of power among the Selfs, scripture establishes nonduality.”

units.label: Verse I.19.11
units.deva: मिथश् च भिन्ना यदि ते हि चेतनाः क्षयस् तु तेषां परिमाणयोगतः । ध्रुवो भवेद् भेदवतां हि दृष्टतो जगत्क्षयश् चापि समस्तमोक्षतः
units.iast: mithaś ca bhinnā yadi te hi cetanāḥ kṣayas tu teṣāṃ parimāṇayogataḥ । dhruvo bhaved bhedavatāṃ hi dṛṣṭato jagatkṣayaś cāpi samastamokṣataḥ
units.translation: “If conscious selves were different from one another, they would be finite and surely subject to destruction; the whole world would perish, and liberation would be complete destruction.”

units.label: Verse I.19.12
units.deva: न मे ऽस्ति कश्चिन् न च सो ऽस्मि कस्यचिद् यतो ऽद्वयो ऽहं न हि चास्ति कल्पितम् । अकल्पितश् चास्मि पुरा प्रसिद्धितो विकल्पनाया द्वयम् एव कल्पितम्
units.iast: na me 'sti kaścin na ca so 'smi kasyacid yato 'dvayo 'haṃ na hi cāsti kalpitam । akalpitaś cāsmi purā prasiddhito vikalpanāyā dvayam eva kalpitam
units.translation: “I belong to no one, nor does anyone belong to me, because I am nondual and no imagined thing exists. Before imagination, duality alone was imagined.”

units.label: Verse I.19.13
units.deva: विकल्पना चाप्य् अभवे न विद्यते सद् अन्यद् इत्य् एवम् अतो न नास्तिता । यतः प्रवृत्ता तव चापि कल्पना पुरा प्रसिद्धेर् न च तद् विकल्पितम्
units.iast: vikalpanā cāpy abhave na vidyate sad anyad ity evam ato na nāstitā । yataḥ pravṛttā tava cāpi kalpanā purā prasiddher na ca tad vikalpitam
units.translation: “Imagination does not exist in what is nonexistent; therefore it is not the case that everything is nonexistent. Your ideas arose from what was already accepted as real, not from something imagined.”

units.label: Verse I.19.14
units.deva: असद् द्वयं ते ऽपि हि यद् यद् ईक्ष्यते न दृष्टम् इत्य् एव न चैव नास्तिता । यतः प्रवृत्ता सदसद्विकल्पना विचारवच् चापि तथाद्वयं च सत्
units.iast: asad dvayaṃ te 'pi hi yad yad īkṣyate na dṛṣṭam ity eva na caiva nāstitā । yataḥ pravṛttā sadasadvikalpanā vicāravac cāpi tathādvayaṃ ca sat
units.translation: “The two you see are unreal, yet this does not mean that nothing exists. From them arises the imagination of being and nonbeing; reasoning likewise shows that nonduality is real.”

units.label: Verse I.19.15
units.deva: सद् अभ्युपेतं भवतोपकल्पितं विचारहेतोर् यदि तस्य नास्तिता । विचारहानाच् च तथैव संस्थितं न चेत् तद् इष्टं नितरां सद् इष्यते
units.iast: sad abhyupetaṃ bhavatopakalpitaṃ vicārahetor yadi tasya nāstitā । vicārahānāc ca tathaiva saṃsthitaṃ na cet tad iṣṭaṃ nitarāṃ sad iṣyate
units.translation: “If the reality you imagine is accepted as the basis for reasoning, how could it be nonexistent? When reasoning ends, that reality still remains. If you do not accept it, you must accept something real.”

units.label: Verse I.19.16
units.deva: असत्समं चैव सद् इत्य् अपीति चेद् अनर्थवत्त्वात् खरशृङ्गतुल्यतः । अनर्थवत्त्वं त्व् असति ह्य् अकारणं न चैव तस्मान् न विपर्यये ऽन्यथा
units.iast: asatsamaṃ caiva sad ity apīti ced anarthavattvāt kharaśṛṅgatulyataḥ । anarthavattvaṃ tv asati hy akāraṇaṃ na caiva tasmān na viparyaye 'nyathā
units.translation: “If being were no different from nonbeing, it would be meaningless, like a hare’s horn; meaninglessness belongs to what does not exist, not the opposite.”

units.label: Verse I.19.17
units.deva: असिद्धतश् चापि विचारकारणाद् द्वयं च तस्मात् प्रसृतं हि मायया । श्रुतेः स्मृतेश् चापि तथा हि युक्तितः प्रसिद्ध्यतीत्थं न तु युज्यते ऽन्यथा
units.iast: asiddhataś cāpi vicārakāraṇād dvayaṃ ca tasmāt prasṛtaṃ hi māyayā । śruteḥ smṛteś cāpi tathā hi yuktitaḥ prasiddhyatītthaṃ na tu yujyate 'nyathā
units.translation: “Since neither side is established, both arise through māyā. Scripture, tradition and reasoning establish this; it cannot reasonably be otherwise.”

units.label: Verse I.19.18
units.deva: विकल्पनाच् चापि विधर्मकं श्रुतेः पुरा प्रसिद्धेश् च विकल्पतो ऽद्वयम् । न चेति नेतीति तथा विकल्पितं निषिध्यते ऽत्राप्य् अवशेषसिद्धये
units.iast: vikalpanāc cāpi vidharmakaṃ śruteḥ purā prasiddheś ca vikalpato 'dvayam । na ceti netīti tathā vikalpitaṃ niṣidhyate 'trāpy avaśeṣasiddhaye
units.translation: “Imagination is contrary to scripture and to what was accepted before it; nonduality precedes imagination. The teaching ‘not this, not this’ negates the imagined and reveals what remains.”

units.label: Verse I.19.19
units.deva: अकल्पिते ऽप्य् एवम् अजाद्वयाक्षरे विकल्पयन्तः सद् असच् च जन्मभिः । स्वचित्तमायाप्रभवं च ते भवं जरां च मृत्युं च नियान्ति संततम्
units.iast: akalpite 'py evam ajādvayākṣare vikalpayantaḥ sad asac ca janmabhiḥ । svacittamāyāprabhavaṃ ca te bhavaṃ jarāṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca niyānti saṃtatam
units.translation: “Those who imagine being and nonbeing, birth after birth, in what is unborn, nondual and imperishable undergo endless worldly existence, old age and death, born of the māyā of their own minds.”

units.label: Verse I.19.20
units.deva: भवाभवत्वं तु न चेद् अवस्थितिर् न तस्य चान्यस् त्व् इति जन्म नान्यथा । सतो ह्य् असत्त्वाद् असतश् च सत्त्वतो न च क्रिया कारकम् इत्य् अतो ऽप्य् अजम्
units.iast: bhavābhavatvaṃ tu na ced avasthitir na tasya cānyas tv iti janma nānyathā । sato hy asattvād asataś ca sattvato na ca kriyā kārakam ity ato 'py ajam
units.translation: “If becoming and nonbecoming were established, there would have to be a state apart from them, and birth would follow. Being from nonbeing, or nonbeing from being, cannot be established; without action or agent, the Self is unborn.”

units.label: Verse I.19.21
units.deva: अकुर्वद् इष्टं यदि वास्य कारकं न किंचिद् अन्यन् ननु नास्त्य् अकारकम् । सतो ऽविशेषाद् असतश् च सच्च्युतौ तुलान्तयोर् यद्वद् अनिश्चयान् न हि
units.iast: akurvad iṣṭaṃ yadi vāsya kārakaṃ na kiṃcid anyan nanu nāsty akārakam । sato 'viśeṣād asataś ca saccyutau tulāntayor yadvad aniścayān na hi
units.translation: “If the Self is supposed to act without acting, there is nothing else that could be an agent. There is no inactive agent apart from it; because being and nonbeing are not distinguished, neither position is certain, as with the ends of a balance.”

units.label: Verse I.19.22
units.deva: न चेत् स इष्टः सदसद्विपर्ययः कथं भवः स्यात् सदसद्व्यवस्थितौ । विभक्तम् एतद् द्वयम् अप्य् अवस्थितं न जन्म तस्माच् च मनो हि कस्यचित्
units.iast: na cet sa iṣṭaḥ sadasadviparyayaḥ kathaṃ bhavaḥ syāt sadasadvyavasthitau । vibhaktam etad dvayam apy avasthitaṃ na janma tasmāc ca mano hi kasyacit
units.translation: “If this reversal of being and nonbeing is not accepted, how could worldly becoming exist? If the two were established separately, neither would arise from the other; therefore, mind, whose world is this?”

units.label: Verse I.19.23
units.deva: अथाभ्युपेत्यापि भवं तवेच्छतो ब्रवीमि नार्थस् तव चेष्टितेन मे । न हानवृद्धी न यतः स्वतो ऽसतो भवो ऽन्यतो वा यदि वास्तिता तयोः
units.iast: athābhyupetyāpi bhavaṃ tavecchato bravīmi nārthas tava ceṣṭitena me । na hānavṛddhī na yataḥ svato 'sato bhavo 'nyato vā yadi vāstitā tayoḥ
units.translation: “Even granting the world’s existence and your desire for it, mind, I say your effort is unnecessary: nothing increases or decreases, since what is unreal cannot become or be destroyed, whether by itself or another.”

units.label: Verse I.19.24
units.deva: ध्रुवा ह्य् अनित्याश् च न चान्ययोगिनो मिथश् च कार्यं न च तेषु युज्यते । अतो न कस्यापि हि किंचिद् इष्यते स्वयं हि तत्त्वं न निरुक्तिगोचरम्
units.iast: dhruvā hy anityāś ca na cānyayogino mithaś ca kāryaṃ na ca teṣu yujyate । ato na kasyāpi hi kiṃcid iṣyate svayaṃ hi tattvaṃ na niruktigocaram
units.translation: “What is eternal and impermanent cannot be joined together, nor can actions be joined to it. Nothing is desired for anyone; reality itself is not within the reach of words.”

units.label: Verse I.19.25
units.deva: समं तु तस्मात् सततं विभातवद् द्वयाद् विमुक्तं सदसद्विकल्पितात् । निरीक्ष्य युक्त्या श्रुतितश् च बुद्धिमान् अशेषनिर्वाणम् उपैति दीपवत्
units.iast: samaṃ tu tasmāt satataṃ vibhātavad dvayād vimuktaṃ sadasadvikalpitāt । nirīkṣya yuktyā śrutitaś ca buddhimān aśeṣanirvāṇam upaiti dīpavat
units.translation: “Therefore, always equal and self-luminous, free from the imagined alternatives of being and nonbeing, the wise person reaches complete peace through reasoning and scripture, like a lamp going out.”

units.label: Verse I.19.26
units.deva: अवेद्यम् एकं यद् अनन्यवेदिनां कुतार्किकाणां च सुवेद्यम् अन्यथा । निरीक्ष्य चेत्थं त्व् अगुणग्रहो ऽगुणं न याति मोहं ग्रहदोषमुक्तितः
units.iast: avedyam ekaṃ yad ananyavedināṃ kutārkikāṇāṃ ca suvedyam anyathā । nirīkṣya cetthaṃ tv aguṇagraho 'guṇaṃ na yāti mohaṃ grahadoṣamuktitaḥ
units.translation: “The one reality is unknown to those who know no other; dialecticians know it wrongly in another way. Seeing this, one grasps nothing as having qualities and is not deluded, freed from the fault of grasping.”

units.label: Verse I.19.27
units.deva: अतो ऽन्यथा न ग्रहनाश इष्यते विमोहबुद्धेर् ग्रह एव कारणम् । ग्रहो ऽप्य् अहेतुर् ह्य् अनलस् त्व् अनिन्धनो यथा प्रशान्तिं परमां तथा व्रजेत्
units.iast: ato 'nyathā na grahanāśa iṣyate vimohabuddher graha eva kāraṇam । graho 'py ahetur hy analas tv anindhano yathā praśāntiṃ paramāṃ tathā vrajet
units.translation: “No other destruction of grasping is possible: deluded understanding is caused by grasping. But grasping has no cause; like a fire without fuel, it comes to supreme peace.”

units.label: Verse I.19.28
units.deva: विमथ्य वेदोदधितः समुद्धृतं सुरैर् महाब्धेस् तु यथा महात्मभिः । तथामृतं ज्ञानम् इदं हि यैः पुरा नमो गुरुभ्यः परम् ईक्षितं च यैः
units.iast: vimathya vedodadhitaḥ samuddhṛtaṃ surair mahābdhes tu yathā mahātmabhiḥ । tathāmṛtaṃ jñānam idaṃ hi yaiḥ purā namo gurubhyaḥ param īkṣitaṃ ca yaiḥ
units.translation: “As the great ones once churned the vast ocean and raised its nectar, so those who first saw the highest truth drew out this nectar of knowledge from the ocean of the Veda. Salutations to those teachers.”

units.label: Prose II.1.1
units.deva: II. GADYABANDHA अथ मोक्षसाधनोपदेशविधिं व्याख्यास्यामो मुमुक्षूणां श्रद्दधानानाम् अर्थिनाम् अर्थाय
units.iast: II. GADYABANDHA atha mokṣasādhanopadeśavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmo mumukṣūṇāṃ śraddadhānānām arthinām arthāya
units.translation: Now we will explain the method of instruction in the means to liberation, for the sake of seekers of liberation who have faith and truly desire it.

units.label: Prose II.1.2
units.deva: तद् इदं मोक्षसाधनं ज्ञानं साधनसाध्याद् अनित्यात् सर्वस्माद् विरक्ताय त्यक्तपुत्रवित्तलोकैषणाय प्रतिपन्नपरमहंसपारिव्राज्याय शमदमदयादियुक्ताय शास्त्रप्रसिद्धशिष्यगुणसम्पन्नाय शुचये ब्राह्मणाय विधिवद् उपसन्नाय शिष्याय जातिकर्मवृत्तविद्याभिजनैः परीक्षिताय ब्रूयत् पुनः पुनर् यावद् ग्रहणं दृढीभवति
units.iast: tad idaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ jñānaṃ sādhanasādhyād anityāt sarvasmād viraktāya tyaktaputravittalokaiṣaṇāya pratipannaparamahaṃsapārivrājyāya śamadamadayādiyuktāya śāstraprasiddhaśiṣyaguṇasampannāya śucaye brāhmaṇāya vidhivad upasannāya śiṣyāya jātikarmavṛttavidyābhijanaiḥ parīkṣitāya brūyat punaḥ punar yāvad grahaṇaṃ dṛḍhībhavati
units.translation: This knowledge that leads to liberation should be taught to a pure Brahmin disciple who has become dispassionate toward everything impermanent, produced by means and actions; who has given up the desires for children, wealth and worlds; who has undertaken the supreme life of a wandering renunciant; who possesses calm, self-restraint, compassion and the other virtues; who has the qualities of a disciple recognized by scripture; and who has approached the teacher properly. The teacher should first examine the student’s birth, conduct, learning and family, then teach repeatedly until understanding is firm.

units.label: Prose II.1.3
units.deva: श्रुतिश् च -- "परीक्ष्य ... तत्त्वतो ब्रह्मविद्याम्" इति । दृढगृहीता हि विद्यात्मनः श्रेयसे सन्तत्यै च भवति । विद्यासन्ततिश् च प्राण्यनुग्रहाय भवति नौर् इव नदीं तितीर्षोः । शास्त्रं च -- "यद्य् अप्य् अस्मा इमाम् अद्भिः परिगृहीतां धनस्य पूर्णां दद्याद् एतद् एव ततो भूयः" इति । अन्यथा च ज्ञानप्राप्त्यभावात् -- "आचार्यवान् पुरुषो वेद", "आचार्याद् धैव विद्या विदिता [साधिष्ठं प्रापत्]", "आचार्यः प्लावयिता तस्य [सम्यग्]ज्ञानं प्लव इहोच्यते" इत्यादिश्रुतिभ्यः स्मृतिभ्यश् च
units.iast: śrutiś ca -- "parīkṣya ... tattvato brahmavidyām" iti । dṛḍhagṛhītā hi vidyātmanaḥ śreyase santatyai ca bhavati । vidyāsantatiś ca prāṇyanugrahāya bhavati naur iva nadīṃ titīrṣoḥ । śāstraṃ ca -- "yady apy asmā imām adbhiḥ parigṛhītāṃ dhanasya pūrṇāṃ dadyād etad eva tato bhūyaḥ" iti । anyathā ca jñānaprāptyabhāvāt -- "ācāryavān puruṣo veda", "ācāryād dhaiva vidyā viditā [sādhiṣṭhaṃ prāpat]", "ācāryaḥ plāvayitā tasya [samyag]jñānaṃ plava ihocyate" ityādiśrutibhyaḥ smṛtibhyaś ca
units.translation: Scripture says: “After examining [the student], one should teach the knowledge of Brahman in truth.” Knowledge firmly grasped brings the good of the Self and its continuity; that continuity of knowledge benefits living beings, like a boat for one who wishes to cross a river. Scripture also says: “If one gave him this whole earth, enclosed by the ocean and filled with wealth, [it would be worth less than this knowledge].” Since knowledge is not attained otherwise, scripture declares: “A person with a teacher knows”; “knowledge learned from a teacher reaches its proper end”; “the teacher ferries one across, and right knowledge is the boat here”; and the rest.

units.label: Prose II.1.4
units.deva: शिष्यस्य ज्ञानाग्रहणं च लिङ्गैर् बुद्ध्वा तदग्रहणहेतून् अधर्मलौकिकप्रमादनित्यानित्य[वस्तु]विवेकविषयासंजातदृढपूर्वश्रुतत्वलोकचिन्तावेक्षणजात्याद्यभिमानादींस् तत्प्रतिपक्षैः श्रुतिस्मृतिविहितैर् अपनयेद् अक्रोधादिभिर् अहिंसादिभिश् च यमैर् ज्ञानाविरुद्धैश् च नियमैः
units.iast: śiṣyasya jñānāgrahaṇaṃ ca liṅgair buddhvā tadagrahaṇahetūn adharmalaukikapramādanityānitya[vastu]vivekaviṣayāsaṃjātadṛḍhapūrvaśrutatvalokacintāvekṣaṇajātyādyabhimānādīṃs tatpratipakṣaiḥ śrutismṛtivihitair apanayed akrodhādibhir ahiṃsādibhiś ca yamair jñānāviruddhaiś ca niyamaiḥ
units.translation: Recognizing from signs that the student has not grasped the teaching, the teacher should identify and remove the causes: unrighteous conduct, worldly distraction, carelessness, a lack of firm prior discrimination between the eternal and the impermanent, worldly preoccupations, pride in birth and the rest. The teacher should counter these with what scripture and tradition prescribe—with freedom from anger, nonviolence and the other disciplines that do not conflict with knowledge.

units.label: Prose II.1.5
units.deva: अमानित्वादिगुणं च ज्ञानोपायं सम्यग् ग्राहयेत्
units.iast: amānitvādiguṇaṃ ca jñānopāyaṃ samyag grāhayet
units.translation: The teacher should also help the student understand fully that humility and the other virtues are means to knowledge.

units.label: Prose II.1.6
units.deva: आचार्यश् चोहापोहग्रहणधारणशमदमदयानुग्रहादिसम्पन्नो लब्धागमो दृष्टादृष्टभोगेष्व् अनासक्तस् त्यक्तसर्वकर्मसाधनो ब्रह्मविद् ब्रह्मणि स्थितो ऽभिन्नवृत्तो दम्भदर्पकुहकशाठ्यमायामात्सर्यानृताहंकारममत्वादिदोषवर्जितः केवलपरानुग्रहप्रयोजनो विद्योपयोगार्थी पूर्वम् उपदिशेत् -- "सद् एव सोम्येदम् अग्र आसीद् एकम् एवाद्वितीयम्", "यत्र नान्यत् पश्यति", "आत्मैवेदं सर्वम्", ब्रह्मैवेदं सर्वम्", "आत्मा वा इदम् एक एवाग्र आसीत्", "सर्वं खल्व् इदं ब्रह्म" इत्य्[आद्याः] आत्मैकत्वप्रतिपादनपराः श्रुतिः
units.iast: ācāryaś cohāpohagrahaṇadhāraṇaśamadamadayānugrahādisampanno labdhāgamo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭabhogeṣv anāsaktas tyaktasarvakarmasādhano brahmavid brahmaṇi sthito 'bhinnavṛtto dambhadarpakuhakaśāṭhyamāyāmātsaryānṛtāhaṃkāramamatvādidoṣavarjitaḥ kevalaparānugrahaprayojano vidyopayogārthī pūrvam upadiśet -- "sad eva somyedam agra āsīd ekam evādvitīyam", "yatra nānyat paśyati", "ātmaivedaṃ sarvam", brahmaivedaṃ sarvam", "ātmā vā idam eka evāgra āsīt", "sarvaṃ khalv idaṃ brahma" ity[ādyāḥ] ātmaikatvapratipādanaparāḥ śrutiḥ
units.translation: The teacher should be skilled in reasoning and explanation, able to grasp and retain, peaceful, self-controlled, compassionate and generous; learned in scripture, unattached to seen and unseen enjoyments, having relinquished all means of action, a knower of Brahman established in Brahman, with a mind fixed on the nondual, free of pride, arrogance, deceit, hypocrisy, cunning, envy, falsehood, ego and possessiveness, and intent solely on helping others and on teaching knowledge. First, for the sake of teaching, the teacher should present scripture that teaches the oneness of the Self, such as: “Being alone was this in the beginning, one without a second”; “where one sees nothing else”; “all this is the Self”; “all this is Brahman”; “the Self alone was this in the beginning”; and “all this is indeed Brahman.”

units.label: Prose II.1.7
units.deva: उपदिश्य च ग्राहयेद् ब्रह्मणो लक्षणम् -- "य आत्मापहतपाप्मा", "यत् साक्षाद् अपरोक्षाद् ब्रह्म", "यो ऽशनायापिपासे", "नेति नेति", "अस्थूलम् अनणु", "स एष नेति नेति", "अदृष्टं द्रष्टृ", "विज्ञानम् आनन्दम्", "सत्यं ज्ञानम् अनन्तम्", "अदृश्ये ऽनात्म्ये", "स वा एषः", "अप्राणो ह्य् अमनाः", "सबाह्याभ्यन्तरो ह्य् अजः", "विज्ञानघन एव", "अनन्तरम् अबाह्यम्", "अन्यद् एव तद् विदिताद् अथो अविदितात्", "आकाशो वै नाम" इत्यादिश्रुतिभिः
units.iast: upadiśya ca grāhayed brahmaṇo lakṣaṇam -- "ya ātmāpahatapāpmā", "yat sākṣād aparokṣād brahma", "yo 'śanāyāpipāse", "neti neti", "asthūlam anaṇu", "sa eṣa neti neti", "adṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭṛ", "vijñānam ānandam", "satyaṃ jñānam anantam", "adṛśye 'nātmye", "sa vā eṣaḥ", "aprāṇo hy amanāḥ", "sabāhyābhyantaro hy ajaḥ", "vijñānaghana eva", "anantaram abāhyam", "anyad eva tad viditād atho aviditāt", "ākāśo vai nāma" ityādiśrutibhiḥ
units.translation: After teaching these, the teacher should help the student grasp Brahman’s defining nature through scriptural passages such as: “the Self, free from evil”; “Brahman, immediate and direct”; “that which is beyond hunger and thirst”; “not this, not this”; “neither gross nor minute”; “the Seer unseen”; “knowledge and bliss”; “reality, knowledge, infinity”; “the invisible, bodiless”; “this very one”; “without breath or mind”; “unborn within and without”; “a mass of knowledge alone”; “without inner or outer”; “other than the known and beyond the unknown”; and “what is called space.”

units.label: Prose II.1.8
units.deva: स्मृतिभिश् च -- "न जायते म्रियते वा", "नादत्ते कस्यचित् पापम्", "यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यम्", "क्षेत्रज्ञां चापि मां विद्धि", "न सत् तन् नासद् उच्यते", "अनादित्वान् निर्गुणत्वत्", "समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु", "उत्तमः पुरुषः" इत्यादिभिः श्रुत्युक्तलक्षणाविरुद्धाभिः परमात्मासंसारित्वप्रतिपादनपराभिस् तस्य सर्वेणानन्यत्वप्रतिपादनपराभिश् च
units.iast: smṛtibhiś ca -- "na jāyate mriyate vā", "nādatte kasyacit pāpam", "yathākāśasthito nityam", "kṣetrajñāṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi", "na sat tan nāsad ucyate", "anāditvān nirguṇatvat", "samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu", "uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ" ityādibhiḥ śrutyuktalakṣaṇāviruddhābhiḥ paramātmāsaṃsāritvapratipādanaparābhis tasya sarveṇānanyatvapratipādanaparābhiś ca
units.translation: The teacher should also cite traditional texts that do not conflict with these scriptural definitions, and that teach the Supreme Self is not subject to worldly existence and is not other than everything: “It is not born or does it die”; “it takes on no one’s sin”; “as space is ever present”; “know me too as the knower of the field”; “it is said to be neither being nor nonbeing”; “because it is beginningless and without qualities”; “equal in all beings”; “the supreme Person”; and the rest.

units.label: Prose II.1.9
units.deva: एवं श्रुतिस्मृतिभिर् गृहीतपरमात्मलक्षणं शिष्यं संसारसागराद् उत्तितीर्षुं पृच्छेत् -- कस् त्वम् असि सोम्येति
units.iast: evaṃ śrutismṛtibhir gṛhītaparamātmalakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyaṃ saṃsārasāgarād uttitīrṣuṃ pṛcchet -- kas tvam asi somyeti
units.translation: Having helped the student grasp the nature of the Supreme Self through scripture and tradition, and seeing that the student wishes to cross the ocean of worldly existence, the teacher should ask: “Who are you, dear one?”

units.label: Prose II.1.10
units.deva: स यदि ब्रूयात् -- ब्राह्मणपुत्रो ऽदोन्वयो ब्रह्मचार्य् आसं गृहस्थो वेदानीम् अस्मि परमहंसपरिव्राट् संसारसागराज् जन्ममृत्युमहाग्राहाद् उत्तितीर्षुर् इति
units.iast: sa yadi brūyāt -- brāhmaṇaputro 'donvayo brahmacāry āsaṃ gṛhastho vedānīm asmi paramahaṃsaparivrāṭ saṃsārasāgarāj janmamṛtyumahāgrāhād uttitīrṣur iti
units.translation: The student replies: “I am the son of a Brahmin of such-and-such family; I was a student, then a householder, and now I am a supreme wandering renunciant, seeking to cross the ocean of worldly life, full of the great creatures of birth and death.”

units.label: Prose II.1.11
